title: Nadia Sophie Seiler Rare Materials Residency
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

At the Yale Center for British Art, the resident will contribute to a significant project and take the lead on a secondary project. The primary project at the YCBA will focus on the item level organization and description of the Michael Roemer letters. The Roemer letters will be described and cataloged in ArchivesSpace. The Resident’s archival description and cataloging will apply appropriate standards, including Describing Archives: A Content Standard (DACS) and Descriptive Cataloging of Rare Materials Manuscripts (DCRM: MSS), in conjunction with subject and genre/form analysis and Library of Congress Classification (LCC).

The secondary project will come from the small collections of manuscript material that concern aspects of British art, society, and culture, primarily from the 19th and 20th century. These collections are wide-ranging and include artists’ letters and papers from all periods, ephemera, and archival collections. The Resident will be able to select a collection based on their interests.

The Resident will be fully integrated into the Archives Department and will be supervised by the Chief Archivist and receive instruction and mentorship on all archival description and cataloging activities. The Resident will also be working closely with the Archivist and Archives Assistant, and have ample opportunities to consult with various Center staff members.


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work with staff across the institutions. Ability to work independently and as part of a team and with frequent interruptions.
2. Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities with discretion and tact, and to analyze and keep track of myriad details.
3. Ability to follow and write detailed technical instructions. Ability to carefully handle fragile materials is necessary.

4. Excellent decision-making, organizational, and analytical skills to manage resources and projects effectively. Well-organized, accurate, and able to follow through on assignments.

5. Proficient computer literacy skills required, and familiarity with library systems preferred.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Recent master’s degree (2025 or 2026) from a program accredited by the American Library Association required.

2. Coursework or experience in MARC cataloging required.

3. Proven experience interning or working within an archive or special collections environment preferred.

4. Background in 18th, 19th, or 20th-century British art and culture an asset.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Supports and coordinates a range of academic programs. 2. Works on various programs throughout the year; including researching and writing of highly confidential material and working with other departments within the University. 3. Interacts with faculty, students and staff within and outside of the University. 4. May perform other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Career Opportunities with Identity Digital

Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer

The Data & Analytics team builds and manages data systems, analyzes information to generate insights, and develops machine learning models to support automated decisioning. As a Data Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer, you will work across (and connect) the expertise of these two related but distinct disciplines. Your responsibilities will include (but not be limited to): deriving data insights to drive decision making, applying ML and modeling techniques to solve business problems, and deploying and managing those models in production.

This role reports to the Director of Business Intelligence.

What You'll Do

  • Collect, clean, transform, and validate data for analysis and model development
  • Explore data to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights
  • Design, train, evaluate, and refine predictive or optimization models
  • Select appropriate features, algorithms, metrics, and validation strategies
  • Build reproducible data and machine-learning pipelines
  • Deploy models for batch or real-time inference

  • Professional development experience with the following tools and platforms: Airflow, Argo Workflows, cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake), major cloud providers (AWS, GCP), Git, Kubernetes, MLFlow, Pandas, Polars, PyTorch, TensorFlow, SHAP and leveraging AI / LLMs.

In addition, the successful candidate will be eligible to receive other compensation from time to time in the form of discretionary and/or nondiscretionary bonuses and long-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be influenced by a candidate’s qualifications, internal employee equity considerations, and location. title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering: Software Development Test (SDET)
description:
To be considered for this position, applications and resumes are accepted only through our careers site by directly applying to the posted job. We do not accept unsolicited resumes or sales solicitations from staffing agencies. Any OCC employee wishing to submit a referral must do so through their Workday account. Any resume submitted outside of an active job posting will not be considered for employment.

What You'll Do:

OCC's Enterprise Quality Engineering organization seeks a Senior Associate in Performance Testing to execute performance and failover testing for mission-critical clearing, risk, and settlement systems. This hands-on role focuses on designing test scenarios, executing performance tests, analyzing results, and validating system behavior during failover and disaster recovery scenarios. The ideal candidate combines strong performance testing execution skills with the ability to work across multi-region cloud and hybrid architectures, ensuring systems meet strict RTO/RPO regulatory requirements.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each primary duty satisfactorily.

  • Design and execute performance tests using LoadRunner, JMeter, and Gatling across AWS and on-premise environments per established test plans and load profiles

  • Create, maintain, and enhance LoadRunner scripts, test scenarios, and script repositories

  • Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, anomalies, and optimization opportunities; generate findings reports

  • Develop and maintain performance test automation scripts (Python, Java) and integrate regression testing into CI/CD pipelines

  • Create parameterized test data and document test procedures, expected results, and baselines

  • Work with DevOps to set up and validate multi-region test environments

  • Correlate performance results with APM/monitoring platforms (Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics) and generate dashboards and trend analysis

  • Collaborate with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams on performance requirements and testing plans

  • Execute failover and disaster recovery testing across primary, secondary, and tertiary regions, including applications, databases, Kafka, and middleware

  • Validate RTO/RPO metrics and post-failover performance against SLAs, including compliance with regulatory requirements

  • Test multi-region deployments for replication lag, data consistency, Kafka topic replication, and failover behavior during region switches

  • Document and present test results, trends, and findings to QE leadership

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Qualifications:

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the primary functions.

  • 3+ years hands-on experience in performance testing, including executing performance tests with LoadRunner, JMeter, or similar tools

  • 2+ years designing and executing failover/disaster recovery testing in cloud or hybrid environments

  • Proficiency in LoadRunner scripting and test scenario creation, OR strong hands-on experience with JMeter/Gatling

  • Scripting experience in Python or Java for test automation and data generation

  • Experience with AWS cloud environments and understanding of performance implications in cloud-native applications

  • Working knowledge of Kafka and event-driven systems, including producer/consumer testing

  • Hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, DB2) and ability to write queries for test data and validation

  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for performance regression testing

  • Familiarity with APM/observability platforms (Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar)

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab) and integration of performance tests

  • Proficiency with Linux command-line tools and basic understanding of Linux operating systems

  • Experience with test management and issue tracking tools (Jira, Zephyr, SpiraTest)

  • Experience testing multi-region architectures or distributed systems with performance validation

  • Experience or familiarity with financial systems, clearing, settlement, or highly regulated, low-latency environments

Technical Skills:

  • Performance testing certification (ISTQB Performance Tester, LoadRunner certification, or equivalent)

  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerized application performance testing

  • UC4 (Automic) job scheduling experience

  • API testing experience (Postman, RestAssured)

  • Experience with data pipeline testing (ETL tools, Tableau)

  • AWS certification or cloud architecture knowledge

  • Experience in Options/Futures industry

  • Hands-on experience with Kafka cluster setup, monitoring, and performance tuning

Education and/or Experience:

  • B.S. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail in test execution and result documentation

  • Experience in Agile methodology.

  • Experience in integration of Jira and Test management tool.

  • Strong communication skills, written and oral, analytical abilities, problem solving skills, sound judgment and time management skills.

  • Experience in creating automation scripts.

  • Experience in developing automation frameworks.

  • Experience in developing Jenkins pipelines.

  • Experience in the Options and Futures industry is preferred

Certificates or Licenses:

  • AWS certification or performance engineering certification preferred

About Us

The Options Clearing Corporation (OCC) is the world's largest equity derivatives clearing organization. Founded in 1973, OCC is dedicated to promoting stability and market integrity by delivering clearing and settlement services for options, futures and securities lending transactions. As a Systemically Important Financial Market Utility (SIFMU), OCC operates under the jurisdiction of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), and the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. OCC has more than 100 clearing members and provides central counterparty (CCP) clearing and settlement services to 19 exchanges and trading platforms. More information about OCC is available at www.theocc.com.

Benefits

A highly collaborative and supportive environment developed to encourage work-life balance and employee wellness. Some of these components include:

  • A hybrid work environment, up to 2 days per week of remote work
  • Tuition Reimbursement to support your continued education
  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance
  • Technology Stipend allowing you to use the device of your choice to connect to our network while working remotely
  • Generous PTO and Parental leave
  • 401k Employer Match
  • Competitive health benefits including medical, dental and vision

Visit careers/thriving-together for more information.

Compensation

  • The salary range listed for any given position is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at OCC, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors such as skills, experience and/or education.
  • In addition, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer.
  • We typically do not hire at the maximum of the range in order to allow for future and continued salary growth. We also offer a substantial benefits package as noted on www.theocc.com/careers
  • All employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Discretionary bonuses are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, company and individual performance and are not guaranteed.

Salary Range

$86,500.00 - $148,700.00

Incentive Range

6% to 10%

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
SENIOR ANALYTICS ENGINEER

Location: Mega Kuningan, South Jakarta

Work Arrangement: On-site

ABOUT THE ROLE

  • We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help turn data from multiple systems into trusted datasets, consistent business metrics, and scalable reporting models that support sales, product performance, and inventory decisions.
  • This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, and business, combining strong SQL and data modeling skills with hands‑on Power BI, Python, automation, and cloud data warehouse experience.
  • You’ll work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analysts to understand business needs, build reliable data solutions, and ensure that the numbers used for decision‑making are accurate, consistent, and easy to trust.
  • We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, works independently, challenges unclear requirements, and proactively ensures data reliability — not someone who waits to be chased when something breaks.
  • You’ll also have the opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve development, testing, documentation, and analysis, while applying sound judgment to validate AI‑generated outputs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain reusable data models and reporting datasets.
  • Integrate data from multiple systems and resolve differences in identifiers, classifications, formats, and business definitions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into clear metrics and data requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, measures, relationships, and reporting logic to ensure consistent calculations.
  • Build automated processes for data preparation and quality checks, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and freshness.
  • Manage late‑arriving data, corrections, and historical changes while maintaining data traceability.
  • Improve query performance, data reliability, and usability.
  • Implement approved data access controls and row‑level security where required.
  • Document data models, metric definitions, source relationships, and transformation logic.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to deliver maintainable solutions and troubleshoot production data issues.
  • Use AI‑assisted tools responsibly for development, testing, documentation, and analysis — while critically reviewing and validating the outputs.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience in Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related role.
  • Experience owning production data models and reporting datasets.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem‑solving skills, and a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical data solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts and data limitations to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working independently, managing priorities, and collaborating across teams.
  • Professional English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Comfortable learning and applying AI tools with good judgment when reviewing their outputs.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Required:

  • Advanced SQL, including complex joins, window functions, incremental processing, and query optimization.
  • Strong data modeling skills, including fact/dimension design, historical changes, and datasets at different levels of granularity.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with Power BI, including semantic modeling, DAX, relationships, filter context, and Row‑Level Security (RLS).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and validation.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT workflows and automated data quality checks.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses.
  • Working knowledge of Git, code review, testing, documentation, and controlled deployment.
  • Comfortable working with Excel and Google Sheets as data sources and transforming recurring spreadsheet processes into scalable solutions.

Preferred:

  • Experience with GCP / BigQuery.
  • Experience with dbt or an equivalent transformation framework.
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Experience with AI‑assisted development and workflow automation.

BUSINESS & ANALYTICS MINDSET

Beyond technical skills, you should be someone who:

  • Enjoys understanding why the business needs the data, not just how to retrieve it.
  • Can learn unfamiliar business processes and clarify terminology with stakeholders.
  • Understands how metric definitions, reporting periods, missing data, and source limitations can affect business decisions.
  • Can reconcile different stakeholder requirements and help establish shared definitions and trusted metrics.
  • Takes ownership of data quality and proactively identifies issues before they impact reporting.
  • Focuses on building solutions that are reliable,

• Provides critical input to market leaders for development of property and overall revenue sales strategy.

Building Successful Relationships

• Provides revenue strategy expertise and leadership to general managers, property leadership teams and market sales leaders.

• Identifies and communicates revenue and profit opportunities to property leadership teams and sales organization.

• Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.

• Provides targeted and timely communication of results, achievements and challenges to the stakeholders.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Develops, implements and maintains a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

• Utilizes all available on the job training tools for employees.

• Conducts employee performance appraisals according to Standard Operating Procedures.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

title: Senior Materials Engineer
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.

For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.

Context

SYSTRA is looking for an amazingly talented Senior Materials Engineer to join our team to conduct design reviews, material investigations, inspections, and testing activities to verify that contractor-selected materials and construction processes meet project specifications and standards.

Missions/Main Duties

  • Review and assess the suitability of concrete mix designs to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable standards.
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to identify, develop, and implement materials improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Conduct design reviews, material investigations, inspections, and testing activities to verify that contractor-selected materials and construction processes meet project specifications and standards.
  • Review and recommend appropriate materials for specific engineering and construction applications.
  • Assess material characteristics and performance properties, including durability, sustainability, conductivity, and resistance to environmental conditions.
  • Evaluate and compare material properties to determine the feasibility and acceptability of proposed material substitutions.
  • Review the impact of new standards, code revisions, and specification changes on project materials and construction practices.
  • Identify non-conforming materials and workmanship, maintain quality records, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and closed out effectively.
  • Provide technical support and guidance on material performance issues and construction-related material challenges.
  • Review and approve contractor quality plans, material procedures, and related documentation.
  • Assess the environmental implications of materials, products, and construction processes, including waste reduction and sustainability considerations.
  • Review and approve material testing results to verify compliance with performance requirements, including resistance to heat, corrosion, chemicals, and environmental exposure.
  • Prepare technical reports and evaluations related to material suppliers, products, and performance assessments.
  • Develop and manage supplier audit programs and conduct supplier quality audits as required.
  • Provide site support and technical advice regarding material failures, specification deviations, cracking, surface defects, settlement issues, earthworks performance, and other construction material concerns.

What Required Skills You’ll Bring:

Profile/Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in the design, selection, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of construction materials.
  • Experience working on major civil, infrastructure, or heavy construction projects.
  • Strong knowledge of construction materials, material testing methodologies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Good understanding of international standards and specifications related to material engineering.
  • Experience reviewing concrete mix designs, earthworks materials, construction products, and material compliance requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical evaluation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Workplace Type

On-site

title: Gaming Director
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Gaming Operations provides executive leadership and strategic direction for all gaming operations at Jackpot Junction Casino Hotel. The position is responsible for the overall performance, profitability, operational effectiveness, regulatory compliance, guest experience, and long-term development of the casino's gaming operations.

The Director establishes strategic and operational priorities; develops and manages revenue, expense, profit, and capital objectives; provides leadership and direction to gaming management; and works collaboratively with executive leadership and other departments to ensure an efficient, compliant, and exceptional guest experience.

The Director serves as a member of the Executive Committee and is expected to maintain a visible leadership presence throughout gaming operations, including during evenings, weekends, high-volume periods, and other times when business needs require.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Strategic & Executive Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction for all gaming operations, including slot, table games, bingo, sportsbook, slot technical services, and related gaming functions.
  • Develop and implement short-range and long-range gaming strategies consistent with the overall goals and objectives of Jackpot Junction Casino Hotel.
  • Establish departmental priorities, operating objectives, performance expectations, and accountability standards.
  • Evaluate gaming operations, market conditions, competitive activity, customer trends, and business opportunities to identify opportunities for growth and improved performance.
  • Participate as a member of the Executive Committee and contribute to property-wide strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Provide senior leadership with timely information, analysis, recommendations, and operational updates regarding gaming performance and emerging issues.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Develop and manage plans to achieve budgeted gaming revenue, profit, expense, labor, and capital objectives.
  • Monitor gaming financial performance and identify opportunities to increase revenue, profitability, productivity, and operational efficiency.
  • Review operating results, forecasts, budgets, and performance trends and take appropriate corrective action when objectives are not being met.
  • Develop and evaluate capital improvement and equipment requirements and provide recommendations regarding priorities and investments.
  • Ensure gaming resources are utilized effectively and in a manner that supports the financial objectives of the organization.
  • Work collaboratively with Finance and other appropriate departments on budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and business planning.

Gaming Operations

  • Direct and oversee the effective operation of all gaming areas and related gaming support functions.
  • Establish and maintain operating standards that promote efficiency, profitability, regulatory compliance, and a high-quality guest experience.
  • Analyze gaming operations to identify opportunities for improved productivity, revenue generation, cost control, and service delivery.
  • Ensure appropriate coordination among slot, table games, bingo, sportsbook, slot technical services, and other gaming functions.
  • Monitor operational performance and address issues affecting the safety, efficiency, integrity, or profitability of gaming operations.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing, scheduling, deployment, and utilization of gaming personnel consistent with operational requirements.
  • Maintain a regular and visible presence on the casino floor and throughout gaming operations.
  • Respond appropriately to significant operational issues, guest concerns, emergencies, and other situations requiring senior gaming leadership.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Integrity

  • Ensure gaming operations are conducted in accordance with applicable governmental requirements, regulatory requirements, company policies, internal controls, and established procedures.
  • Promote a culture of compliance, accountability, integrity, and operational control throughout the Gaming Department.
  • Work with appropriate regulatory, compliance, internal audit, security, surveillance, and other departments to address regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Ensure identified deficiencies, compliance concerns, and operational issues are appropriately addressed and corrected.
  • Maintain appropriate knowledge of requirements affecting bingo, slot, table games, sportsbook, and other applicable gaming operations.
  • Support and cooperate with internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and compliance initiatives.
  • Ensure gaming management and staff receive appropriate training regarding applicable policies, procedures, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.

Guest Experience & Public Relations

  • Promote a positive, professional, and welcoming gaming environment that supports guest satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Establish and maintain effective relationships with guests, employees, community representatives, business partners, and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Address significant guest concerns and escalated service issues in a timely, professional, and appropriate manner.
  • Maintain satisfactory public relations through direct or delegated contacts.
  • Work with the Marketing Director to ensure gaming operations effectively support casino promotions, marketing initiatives, player incentives, and reward programs.
  • Collaborate with other departments to provide a consistent and exceptional overall guest experience.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Provide effective leadership, direction, coaching, and support to Gaming Department managers and employees.
  • Maintain high employee morale through positive communication, effective management, recognition, accountability, and regular training.
  • Establish clear expectations for departmental managers and hold leaders accountable for operational, financial, service, compliance, and employee performance.
  • Develop the capabilities of gaming leadership through coaching, mentoring, training, and professional development.
  • Support succession planning and development of future gaming leaders.
  • Promote teamwork, professionalism, respect, accountability, and a positive workplace culture.
  • Address performance and personnel matters appropriately and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Coordinate gaming operations with Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Security, Surveillance, Information Technology, Food & Beverage, Hotel Operations, Facilities, and other departments as appropriate.
  • Promote effective communication and cooperation between Gaming Operations and other areas of the property.
  • Participate in property-wide initiatives and projects that affect gaming operations or the overall guest experience.
  • Represent Gaming Operations in appropriate organizational meetings, committees, projects, and initiatives.

Technology, Equipment & Capital Planning

  • Monitor gaming equipment, systems, technology, and infrastructure to support reliable, efficient, and compliant gaming operations.
  • Identify operational technology and equipment needs and make recommendations regarding replacement, upgrades, and capital investment.
  • Coordinate with appropriate departments and vendors regarding gaming-related technology, equipment, projects, and implementation.
  • Evaluate operational impacts and business opportunities associated with new gaming technologies, equipment, and systems.

Leadership Presence & Availability

  • Maintain a visible leadership presence on the casino floor and within gaming operations.
  • Regularly work evenings, weekends, holidays, high-volume periods, and other nontraditional hours as operational needs require.
  • Remain available to address significant gaming operational matters and emergencies as required.
  • Travel as needed in support of organizational and professional responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About CORTO

We are CORTO, a cutting-edge software company dedicated to revolutionising the legal industry. Our mission is to empower legal practitioners with AI-driven solutions that streamline their workflow, boost productivity, and provide more efficient client service.

Our team of AI experts and engineers collaborate to develop intelligent software tailored to the unique needs of lawyers, paralegals, and legal assistants. Our innovative AI solutions automate routine tasks, simplify document management, and enhance decision-making, allowing legal professionals to focus on what they do best—providing expert legal counsel.

We’re rapidly scaling from 80 to 250+ employees, with a highly technical workforce where around 75% of the team are developers and engineers. Working alongside our Sydney-based team of passionate high achievers, you’ll join a fast-growing technology business where things rarely stay the same for long - and if you’re smart, caring, and ambitious, you’ll be in great company.

﻿

What you’ll do

﻿We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our AI and Automation Team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the APIs that power document ingestion and integrations of our Core AI platform at CORTO.

To make this happen you will

This is an incredible opportunity to be part of an engineering team building the next generation of our products. The day to day will include:

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining multiple microservices central to document ingestion and integrations.
  • Maintaining and enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that connect enterprise knowledge sources with Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Prototyping and experimenting with new AI techniques, ensuring alignment with best practices and industry standards.
  • Building and managing scalable cloud infrastructure (utilizing serverless compute, event queues, managed containers, and NoSQL/relational storage).
  • Optimising code and system architecture for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Working closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver efficient solutions.

What you’ll bring

﻿You are a focused, motivated and hard-working developer who wants to join a fantastic growing team at a critical time and learn on the job to expand your skills. In addition to that you will bring:

  • Experience: Hands-on software engineering experience building RESTful APIs and production-grade software.
  • Tech Stack Agnostic Mindset: Strong foundation in at least one modern backend programming language (e.g., C#, Python, Java, Go, or Node.js) and a willingness to learn new technologies as required by the business.
  • Architecture & Distributed Systems: Solid understanding of software architecture, event-driven designs, and microservices.
  • Database Knowledge: Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MS SQL) and NoSQL or key-value stores (e.g., DynamoDB, Redis).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Exposure to major cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • AI-Assisted Workflows: Experience with or interest in using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development.

You are the type of person who

  • Able to work autonomously and take ownership of parts of the product
  • Has analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Proactive in chasing leads to resolve dependencies
  • Has a positive attitude – things might not always go as expected but we maintain optimism and win, nonetheless
  • Ability to think outside the box – not all our tasks are standard so neither are the solutions
  • Being a team player – we reach our goals together and help each other to succeed. We have a strict no-ego, no-blame culture with intense focus on getting things done
  • Relentless urge to get things done

CORTO is an inclusive, people-first company committed to breaking down institutional barriers that keep people from reaching their potential. If you meet some, but not all the requirements above, we encourage you to still submit your application.

﻿

Why join CORTO?

  • Your work matters. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
  • Make an impact. You won’t be another ‘cog in the wheel’ here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects – and to make a real difference.
  • Work with a group of authentic, passionate people who love what they do.
  • Well-funded and global. CORTO is part of ATI Global – one of the largest international LegalTech companies.
  • Flexible and hybrid working. We engage, share, and collaborate on ideas and workflows.
  • Career and learning opportunities - we move fast and need smart people to get us where we're going. We are a scaling business and looking for people who want to grow with us.
  • Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
  • We value your well-being with additional time off, gym membership and other perks.
  • Fast-paced tech environment, if we don't disrupt ourselves someone else will do it!
  • Access to LEAP Home - a program unique to the ATI Group to support you in buying your primary residence.

At eBay, we’re more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world and creates economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. As we continue our tech-led reimagination of the global marketplace, we’re looking for people who are passionate about solving complex problems, building at scale, and creating experiences that make commerce better for everyone.

About the team and the role:

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Data Engineering Manager to lead a team building scalable, reliable data solutions that power critical experiences across eBay. This team plays a central role in eBay’s data ecosystem, enabling trusted real‑time insights, analytics, experimentation, and personalized experiences for millions of customers across the marketplace. As part of this focused C2C strategy, eBay continues to invest in the future of circular commerce and the next generation of conscious consumers. With the recent acquisition of Depop, a leading consumer‑to‑consumer fashion marketplace with a highly engaged GenZ and Millennial customer base, eBay is expanding its portfolio of complementary C2C businesses while preserving the distinct brand, community, and product experience that make Depop unique. In this role, you will lead and grow a team of data engineers responsible for architecting, building, and operating high‑performance real‑time and batch data pipelines and platforms. You will set technical direction, drive execution across complex initiatives, and partner closely with Product, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering leaders to translate business priorities into durable, high‑quality data solutions. This is an opportunity to combine people leadership, technical depth, and organizational influence in a highly scaled environment. You will help shape modern data engineering practices across technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Databricks, Airflow, dbt, and AWS, while fostering an inclusive, high‑performing team culture focused on innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning.

What you will accomplish:

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers, creating an inclusive and high‑performing environment where team members grow their technical depth, expand ownership, and deliver meaningful business impact.

Drive the design and delivery of scalable real‑time and batch data pipelines and platforms that enable trusted, timely, and high‑volume data consumption across product, analytics, and machine learning use cases.

Define and execute the roadmap for modern data engineering capabilities, including streaming, orchestration, transformation, observability, and cloud‑native platform development using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Databricks, and AWS.

Partner cross‑functionally with Product, Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to prioritize investments, translate evolving requirements into robust technical solutions, and deliver data products that improve customer and business outcomes.

Raise the engineering bar by establishing strong practices for architecture, code quality, testing, documentation, operational readiness, and data reliability, while proactively improving scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Own execution across major initiatives from planning through production operations, balancing near‑term delivery with long‑term platform health and influencing technical decisions that improve reuse, maintainability, and speed across teams.

What you will bring:

Experience leading and developing engineering teams, with a track record of delivering complex data, platform, or backend initiatives in fast‑paced and highly collaborative environments.

Strong technical foundation in data engineering or software engineering, including experience with distributed systems, large‑scale batch and streaming pipelines, and cloud‑based data platforms.

Hands‑on knowledge of technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Databricks, Airflow, dbt, AWS, or comparable modern data engineering tools, with the ability to guide architecture and support strong technical execution.

Experience establishing engineering best practices across system design, data quality, observability, testing, production support, and operational excellence for large‑scale data platforms.

Strong cross‑functional collaboration, communication, and prioritization skills, with the ability to align engineering investments to product and business goals and influence stakeholders across multiple disciplines.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience in ecommerce, marketplace, fintech, payments, or other high‑scale environments is a plus.

Additional Details

title: Brigádník/brigádnice (DPP), Praha Galerie Nové Butovice
description:
Jako Brigádník/brigádnice v H&M budete součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

  • Pomáhat zákazníkům s výběrem a sdílet své znalosti o módě
  • Spolupracovat s kolegy a zajistit, aby byl obchod vždy přehledný a dobře zásobený
  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají 18 let a více.
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2
  • Mají možnost pracovat na odpoledních směnách (max do 21:30) a o víkendu.

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • Rozsáhlý školící program – vše tě naučíme.
  • Možnost kombinace práce a osobního života (flexibilita směn).
  • Občerstvení na pracovišti.
  • Šance být součástí unikátní H&M společnosti a její kultury.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na DPP (300 hodin ročně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 24.09.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Business Analyst (Oracle Fusion Finance, SAP S/4HANA Cloud)
description:
Salary: $5,000 – $6,500 per month

About the role

In this pivotal role, the personnel will configure, manage, and optimise the government's financial processes within an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, ensuring seamless integration for reporting, budgeting, accounts payable/receivable, and compliance. The personnel will bridge finance expertise with deep platform knowledge of modern ERPs like Oracle Fusion Finance, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, and equivalent platforms. The personnel will work closely with Finance users and stakeholders to understand business problems, analyse and optimise processes, and translate requirements into ERP solutions. The personnel's responsibilities include end-to-end ownership from business analysis and requirements definition through solution design, configuration, testing and validation. The personnel will also provide functional and technical oversight of System Integrators (SIs) and vendors, challenging proposed solutions to maximise the use of platform-native capabilities, minimise unnecessary customisation, and ensure solutions remain scalable, maintainable and aligned with government requirements.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive business process analysis of finance workflows including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Asset Accounting, whilst proposing ERP product-based solutions for enhanced efficiency

  • Analyse current-state and design future-state processes, identifying opportunities to simplify and standardise processes using ERP platform capabilities and clean-core principles

  • Facilitate requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions, resolving conflicting requirements and challenging legacy practices to distinguish genuine business and policy needs from existing system constraints

  • Configure and customise Finance ERP components, including organisational and financial structures, Chart of Accounts, Cost Centres, Profit Centres, Projects, accounting rules, workflows, approval structures, business rules and other core financial structures that support government operations

  • Develop prototypes or proof-of-concepts where appropriate to validate requirements and solution approaches before implementation

  • Develop sophisticated financial reports and leverage artificial intelligence for advanced analytics, whilst providing consultation and training to guide users on best practices and new functionalities

  • Make disciplined, scalable use of platform-native capabilities - data models, workflow engines, automation frameworks, permission models, integration connectors, and extension layers - including custom coding to support critical finance operations missions

  • Maintain accountability for platform delivery outcomes, including vendor-delivered work, conducting technical reviews similar to pull request reviews in software development

  • Analyse defects and production issues across business processes, configurations, integrations and data, and support resolution and continuous improvement

  • Act as an in-house Finance ERP functional specialist, independently reviewing and challenging SI- and vendor-proposed designs, configurations, customisations and technical solutions

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, independently drive moderately complex to advanced scopes, and help uphold strong engineering standards whilst uplifting team capabilities

  • Possess deep expertise in Agile practices and Oracle Fusion Finance, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, or equivalent major enterprise platforms, coupled with strong understanding of GAAP/IFRS, financial statements, and reporting requirements

  • Possess technical proficiency in SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion Finance, data migration, and troubleshooting

  • Excellent business process analysis, project management, problem-solving, and communication skills

  • Demonstrate the ability to lead and govern vendor delivery with technical authority, guiding vendors towards high-quality delivery whilst shaping how teams build and maintain platform components

  • Experience in maintaining oversight and system governance over enterprise platforms, providing senior technical leadership to vendor teams and system integrators, and ensuring seamless integration across complex government technology ecosystems

  • Certification in major finance ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle) will be an advantage

  • Experience in deep platform mastery and architectural thinking, with a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement will be an advantage

  • Experience working in financial industries setting (e.g., Banking, Insurance) will be an advantage

title: Finance Technical Assistant Sudan Nationals Only
description:
Roles and responsibilities:

The purpose of the Finance Technical Assistant position is to provide efficient and compliant financial support services, ensuring accurate processing of financial transactions, maintenance of cash and bank records, and adherence to NRC financial policies and procedures.

Generic Responsibilities:

  • Process cash and bank payments in compliance with NRC financial policies and procedures.

  • Handle and safeguard petty cash/safe box and ensure all transactions are adequately supported with relevant documentation.

  • Prepare and process bank transfers for suppliers, beneficiaries, staff claims, and other NRC operational expenses.

  • Accurately record payments, advances, staff clearances, and other financial transactions in NRC financial systems (Citrix/Unit4).

  • Maintain up-to-date cash and bank balance trackers and provide regular reports to management.

  • Conduct safe replenishments in accordance with NRC finance policies and approved procedures.

  • Assist in month-end financial closing activities and document filing.

  • Ensure proper archiving of finance documents and supporting records for audit purposes.

  • Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and information.

  • Compliance and adherence to NRC policies, guidance and procedures and a specific responsibility for finance policies and procedures.

Specific responsibilities:

  • Monitor daily safe box balances and ensure cash payments remain within NRC-approved cash ceiling limits.

  • Prepare weekly cash and bank balance reports and share them with the Finance Coordinator for review and action.

  • Any other tasks as delegated by the line manager.

Critical interfaces:

  • Finance Coordinator: Payment approvals, financial reporting, cash management oversight.

  • Area and Country Office Finance Teams: Coordination of financial transactions and reconciliations.

  • Procurement, Logistics : Supplier payment processing and supporting documentation verification.

  • Program Teams: Processing beneficiary payments and project-related financial transactions.

  • Human Resources Department: Processing staff claims, advances, and staff payroll-related transactions.

  • Banks and Financial Service Providers: Execution and follow-up of bank transfers.

Generic professional competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Minimum 2 years' experience working in finance, accounting, cash management, or a related function.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word and ability to accurately work with computerized accounting systems.

Context related skills, knowledge and experience:

  • Previous experience working with humanitarian or non-governmental organizations is an advantage.

  • Strong foundation in accounting principles, bookkeeping, and accounts payable and receivable processes.

  • Experience using ERP/accounting systems, preferably Unit4 or similar finance software.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry and reporting.
  • Knowledge of NRC financial policies and donor compliance requirements is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of Arabic is desirable.

title: Lead Engineer Reconstructies Netwerken

Jij bent een ervaren engineer die kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel heeft. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners, motiveert anderen en denkt continu mee over haalbaarheid en verbeteringen. Je wilt impact maken en groeien in een coördinerende rol. Daarnaast heb jij:

title: Concept Creative
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Concept Creative, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future retail experience at H&M. Working with customer insights, brand direction and business needs, you’ll transform ideas into inspiring, functional and scalable store concepts that bring our physical environments to life. You’ll create and develop concepts for stores around the world, balancing creativity, customer experience and commercial impact.

From early ideation and visual storytelling to presentations, renderings and design proposals, you’ll bring concepts to life and help define how customers experience our brand in physical spaces. You’ll collaborate across multiple functions, navigating complex challenges and turning creative opportunities into actionable concepts that can be developed and realized at scale.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, design, strategy and collaboration. Someone who can move comfortably between the big picture and the details, while keeping the customer experience at the center of every decision.


WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join the Retail Creative Development team and report to the Concept Development Manager. Together with Concept Creatives, Project Managers, Retail Architects, Engineers and other key stakeholders across H&M, you’ll help shape the future of our physical customer experience.

You’ll be part of a highly collaborative and creative environment where curiosity, innovation and new ideas are encouraged. This role requires close partnership with teams across the organization, making stakeholder management and relationship-building key to your success.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative and self-driven architect/ interior designer with a passion for shaping experiences through physical environments. You combine strong conceptual thinking with excellent visual communication skills and know how to translate ideas into compelling concepts that inspire others.

You enjoy working in dynamic environments where priorities can shift and projects can vary in pace and complexity. You're comfortable creating clarity from ambiguity, managing multiple stakeholders and driving your work forward independently.

You have a strong sense of design, materiality and customer experience, and you're excited by the opportunity to influence how millions of customers experience H&M stores around the world. Most importantly, you're curious, open-minded and energized by solving creative challenges together with others.

We are looking for people with:

  • Experience within retail design, interior architecture, spatial design, concept development or a related creative field, ideally within retail or customer‑focused environments.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience creating presentations, visual concepts, layouts, sketches and renderings that communicate design intent effectively.
  • Strong ability to produce high‑quality renderings, 3D models, and visual communication assets.
  • Experience in tools such as Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Enscape or similar.
  • The ability to translate business needs, customer insights and briefs into engaging customer experiences.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple stakeholders and navigating a complex organizational environment.
  • Strong self-leadership, prioritization and stakeholder management skills.
  • A passion for creativity, innovation and continuous learning.
  • Curiosity and openness towards AI-powered tools and new ways of working within the creative process.

Portfolio submission

As part of your application, please submit a portfolio showcasing your creative work. We would especially love to see examples of concept development, retail environments, visual storytelling, renderings and projects that demonstrate your ability to turn ideas into inspiring customer experiences.


WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a temporary 13-month position based in Stockholm, Sweden. Apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV and portfolio in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application

title: Data Center Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Xanadu

Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere.

Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere. At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

Your Role And Responsibilities

As part of the Hardware Team in Toronto, you will take your experience in delivering complex mechanical, vibration-control, and thermal-cooling solutions and apply it to Xanadu’s rack-scale quantum computer development. In this role, you will bridge facility-level infrastructure design with chassis-level mechanical packaging. You will model and size key rack infrastructure (CDUs, PDUs, liquid manifolds, fiber managers) while owning the mechanical design of the sub-system modules that integrate directly into our racks. With your strong background in mechanical design, thermal/liquid management, and complex assemblies, you will take mechanical ownership of the world’s first photonic quantum computers deployed at scale.

Basic Qualifications And Experience

  • BSc or higher in mechanical engineering or a relevant, related discipline.
  • 5+ years of industry experience in data center thermal/mechanical systems engineering.
  • Proficiency in system-level thermal and hydraulic sizing, including selecting and integrating Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs), Power Distribution Units (PDUs), manifolds, and liquid cooling loops.
  • Hands‑on experience with thermal simulations (CFD/FEA) to achieve precise temperature stability, uniform heat distribution, and low vibration across both sub‑system enclosures and rack‑level environments.
  • Proficiency in GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and tolerance stack‑up analysis for complex assemblies, particularly for blind‑mate power and fluid connections.
  • Deep familiarity with mechanical packaging (sheet metal design, machined components, structural frames, and quick‑disconnect fluid fittings).
  • Self‑motivated and adaptable, comfortable working both independently and collaboratively with cross‑functional teams (photonic, electrical, optical, and software engineers) in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills, with a track record of taking end‑to‑end mechanical ownership of complex hardware deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications And Experience

  • MSc in mechanical engineering or a relevant, related discipline.
  • 8+ years of combined academic and industry experience, including 3+ years leading mechanical packaging or data center infrastructure projects in a commercial industry environment.
  • End‑to‑end experience specifying, sizing, or designing rack‑scale infrastructure, including liquid‑to‑liquid / liquid‑to‑air Cooling Distribution Units (CDUs), secondary fluid loops, manifolds, and high‑density Intelligent PDUs.
  • Proven track record in sub‑system module packaging, designing complex mechanical assemblies (50+ unique parts) integrating sensitive electronics, high‑power compute/optical ICs, or photonic components.
  • Hands‑on experience with customized rack frameworks compliant with EIA‑310, OCP (Open Compute Project), or custom high‑density cabinet standards, including structural load analysis and blind‑mate mechanical guide systems.
  • Advanced thermal and hydraulic modeling expertise, using CAD mesh definitions and CFD tools (e.g., Ansys Icepak, SimScale, FloTHERM) to simulate both chip‑level cold plate temperatures and macro‑level fluid pressure drops across full rack manifolds.
  • Expertise in passive and active vibration mitigation, including structural and acoustic vibration isolation within chassis and interconnect assemblies to protect phase‑sensitive optical/photonic paths from pump, fan, or fluid dynamics.
  • Expert‑level experience with major CAD and CAM software.
  • Hands‑on experience with industry manufacturing techniques for metallic and plastic parts.
  • Hands‑on experience with CNC machining and 3D printing to quickly prototype concepts and ideas.
  • Experience liaising with machining centers for parts production.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams to extract requirements.
  • Experience with high‑volume sheet metal stamping and forming processes, with a strong understanding of DFM principles.
  • An exceptional candidate will have experience specifying or designing production rack‑scale electrical power distribution.

This is for a new position. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and internal benchmarks. The base salary range is 140,000 - 180,000+ CAD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Master thesis: Agentic Telemetry for 5G-6G RAN
description:
Join our Team

About the Opportunity

Would you like to contribute to the evolution of Ericsson’s 5G, 6G, and Cloud RAN solutions while exploring Generative AI and Agentic Software Development? This thesis focuses on telemetry and analytics for AI-assisted software porting.

Ericsson is a global leader in mobile communication technology and is shaping the future of intelligent RAN software development. As software systems become increasingly complex, AI-powered workflows are essential for improving engineering productivity and accelerating technology evolution.

The thesis will investigate how engineering teams can capture, measure, and analyze data from Agentic AI workflows used to migrate software functionality from 5G RAN to 6G RAN solutions. The aim is to understand productivity gains, iteration efficiency, and the overall effectiveness of these workflows.

What You Will Do

The objective is to design and develop a telemetry and analytics framework for Agentic AI-driven software porting workflows. Your work may include:

  • Defining the telemetry required to measure AI-assisted software porting activities.

  • Designing mechanisms to capture agent iterations, task progress, engineering effort, and delivery milestones.

  • Developing analytics and visualization capabilities to measure workflow performance.

  • Defining and evaluating productivity metrics, including estimated versus actual engineering effort, workflow efficiency, and productivity gains.

  • Investigating methods to correlate telemetry with Epics, User Stories, and software delivery outcomes.

  • Analyzing and validating the effectiveness of Agentic AI workflows for 5G-to-6G RAN software porting.

You will also learn industry best practices, agile ways of working, and state-of-the-art software development environments while contributing to next-generation RAN product development.

The Skills You Bring

  • A master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with Jira.

  • Experience with Amazon Q/Kiro CLI, Claude Code, or other AI coding assistants is beneficial.

  • A collaborative, creative, and people-oriented mindset.

  • Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and assume ownership.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English.

title: Software Development Engineer - CV Test Infrastructure, Annapurna ML, CV Test Infrastructure
description:
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join the CV Test Infrastructure team within Amazon's Annapurna ML organization. You will build and maintain the automated validation infrastructure (Origami platform) that supports chip verification and validation across multiple engineering teams and hardware platforms - including emulators (ZeBu), virtual platforms (QEMU), and silicon prototypes. In addition, you will design and implement diagnostic tools that enable engineers to quickly identify, analyze, and resolve validation failures across complex hardware/software environments.

Key job responsibilities
Design and develop diagnostic tools for analyzing test failures, hardware issues, and regression results across emulation, virtual platform, and silicon environments
Build and maintain automation frameworks for test execution across multiple platforms
Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines for nightly regression and on-demand test execution
Develop and improve the Origami platform - a web-based system for test management, resource monitoring, and validation reporting
Automate emulator model build and release processes
Build dashboards and tooling for real-time visibility into regression results, resource utilization, and failure analysis
Manage and improve SLURM-based job scheduling infrastructure for shared compute resources
Collaborate with multiple verification and design teams to understand their diagnostic and automation needs
Maintain and extend AWS-based infrastructure (EC2, DynamoDB, S3) supporting the validation platform
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- 3+ years of programming experience (Python, Bash, or similar)
- Experience designing and building developer tools or diagnostic utilities
- Strong experience with Linux environments and debugging complex systems
- Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools (Jenkins, Git)
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience building test automation frameworks and tools
- Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS
- Experience building diagnostic/analysis tools for hardware or embedded systems
- Familiarity with SLURM or similar job scheduling systems
- Experience with web development (React, Node.js) for dashboard/tooling
- Familiarity with hardware verification/emulation environments
- Experience with log parsing, failure classification, and root cause analysis tooling

title: Kierownik / Kierowniczka Działu
description:
JAKIE BĘDĄ TWOJE OBOWIĄZKI​

Jako Kierownik/Kierowniczka Działu będziesz zarządzać, wspierać i motywować swój zespół. Tworząc inkluzywną kulturę opartą na współpracy i przedsiębiorczym podejściu, zapewnisz środowisko, w którym każdy może się rozwijać. Działając zgodnie z naszymi wartościami, przyczynisz się zarówno do własnego sukcesu, jak i sukcesu całej firmy.

Twoje zadania będą obejmować:

  • Kierowanie zespołem i dbanie o to, by każdy klient czuł się wyjątkowo – poprzez utrzymywanie wysokiego poziomu obsługi i atrakcyjnego wyglądu sklepu.
  • Odpowiedzialność za wyniki sklepu i Twojego działu – poprzez analizę wyników sprzedaży, szukanie nowych możliwości i wyznaczanie celów, które pomogą osiągnąć jeszcze lepsze rezultaty.
  • Planowanie pracy zespołu – układanie grafików, organizacja dnia i dbanie o płynne funkcjonowanie sklepu.
  • Rekrutację, szkolenia oraz rozwój pracowników – z troską o inkluzywne środowisko pracy, w którym każdy głos ma znaczenie.
  • Budowanie pozytywnego wizerunku marki – w każdej interakcji z klientem.
  • Aktywne promowanie programu lojalnościowego – tak, by zakupy były dla klientów nie tylko przyjemnością, ale też korzyścią.

Z KIM BĘDZIESZ WSPÓŁPRACOWAĆ​

​Nasze sklepy stanowią fundament firmy — to właśnie w nich klienci bezpośrednio doświadczają naszej marki. Jako część dynamicznego zespołu sklepowego, każde stanowisko — od doradców/doradczyń sprzedaży, przez kierowników/kierowniczki działów i sklepów, po dekoratorów/dekoratorki i kontrolerów/-ki administracyjno-kasowych/-e — przyczynia się do tworzenia inspirującej i przyjaznej atmosfery. Współpracując z innymi sklepami oraz zespołem regionalnym, będziesz dzielić się spostrzeżeniami i osiągać wspólne sukcesy. Wraz z członkami swojego zespołu będziesz pełnić kluczową rolę, pomagając klientom czuć się pewnie i wyrażać swoją indywidualność dzięki najnowszym trendom i ponadczasowym fasonom. Budując relacje z klientami, sprawiamy, że moda staje się dostępna i zrównoważona dla każdego.

KIM JEST KIEROWNIK/KIEROWNICZKA DZIAŁU​

Szukamy osób z…​

  • Doświadczeniem w zarządzaniu sprzedażą detaliczną.
  • Wiedzą w zakresie planowania, analizy i monitorowania wyników sprzedaży, przy użyciu odpowiednich narzędzi raportowania.

Oraz osób, które…​

  • Czują się pewnie w roli liderów. Potrafią inspirować, szkolić i rozwijać swoje zespoły w zgodzie z wartościami i kulturą firmy.
  • Chcą rozwijać się w dynamicznych i zróżnicowanych zespołach, gdzie podstawę stanowi współpraca.
  • Są zmotywowane, aby zapewnić klientom wspaniałe doświadczenia zakupowe poprzez promocję i sprzedaż naszych produktów.
  • Są zainteresowane modą, sprzedażą oraz monitorowaniem działań konkurencji w celu zwiększania sprzedaży.
  • Potrafią jasno się komunikować, myślą nieszablonowo i z entuzjazmem podchodzą do nowych wyzwań.
  • Są elastyczne, analityczne i ambitne. Potrafią pracować ze statystykami oraz danymi.
  • Posługują się językiem polskim na poziomie zaawansowanym, zarówno w mowie, jak i w piśmie.

KIM JESTEŚMY

Grupa H&M to globalna firma, która łączy silne marki modowe. Naszym celem jest pokazanie, że wyjątkowy design, przystępne ceny i zrównoważone rozwiązania mogą iść w parze. Chcemy, by moda była dostępna dla jak najszerszej grupy osób, dlatego nasi klienci stoją w centrum każdej decyzji, którą podejmujemy.

Wspieramy rozwój tysięcy współpracowników pełnych pasji i talentów, których łączy wspólna kultura i wartości. Razem chcemy wykorzystać naszą siłę, zasoby i wiedzę, aby kształtować bardziej inkluzywną i zrównoważoną przyszłość branży modowej.

DLACZEGO POKOCHASZ PRACĘ Z NAMI

W Grupie H&M jesteśmy dumni z tego, że tworzymy otwarte i pełne energii miejsce pracy. Oferujemy naszym pracownikom atrakcyjne świadczenia oraz szerokie możliwości rozwoju na całym świecie.

Zapewniamy:

  • Umowę o pracę.
  • Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości 200 PLN.
  • Możliwość otrzymania premii za wyniki sprzedażowe.
  • 25% zniżki dla Ciebie i jednej bliskiej osoby na zakupy we wszystkich markach Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Program motywacyjny H&M HIP. Dowiedz się więcej o programie tutaj.
  • Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz).
  • Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku.
  • Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej.
  • Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej.
  • Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie.
  • Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit.
  • Dodatkowy dzień wolny (jubileuszowy).
  • Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych.

DOŁĄCZ DO NAS

Nasza wyjątkowość wynika z połączenia wielu czynników — inkluzywnej kultury opartej na współpracy, silnych wartościach i możliwościach rozwoju. Jednak to przede wszystkim nasi pracownicy tworzą tożsamość Grupy H&M.

Jest to stanowisko w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy, z miejscem pracy w Zawierciu. Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV tak szybko, jak to możliwe.

Zrób z nami kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Twoja podróż zaczyna się tutaj.
