title: Spécialiste principal(e) DevOps | Senior DevOps Specialist
description:
Raison d'être du poste

À titre de spécialiste principal(e) DevOps, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, le maintien et l'évolution des infrastructures, des systèmes d'automatisation et des mécanismes de déploiement qui soutiennent notre vision de Créer des moments qui touchent les gens.

Vous concevrez et mettrez en œuvre de façon autonome des solutions d'infrastructure, améliorerez les capacités d'automatisation soutenant l'ensemble du cycle de livraison logicielle et contribuerez à maintenir des plateformes fiables, évolutives et sécuritaires.

Grâce à votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et à votre collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie, vous contribuerez au renforcement des pratiques DevOps, au mentorat de collègues moins expérimentés et à l'orientation des décisions relatives à l'infrastructure.

Responsabilités principales

Le ou la spécialiste principal(e) DevOps est responsable de la livraison de solutions d'infrastructure et d'automatisation fiables, sécuritaires et évolutives soutenant nos produits, projets et plateformes logicielles.

La personne titulaire du poste devra :

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les architectes DevOps et logiciels afin de concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir l'infrastructure conformément à la stratégie produit et technique.
  • Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir l'infrastructure en tant que code (Infrastructure as Code), les pipelines d'intégration et de livraison continues (CI/CD) ainsi que les mécanismes d'automatisation des déploiements dans des environnements infonuagiques et locaux.
  • Configurer, maintenir et dépanner les environnements de développement, de test et de production, y compris les configurations systèmes et la gestion des dépendances.
  • Prendre en charge les initiatives d'infrastructure et d'automatisation de la conception jusqu'à la validation finale.
  • Surveiller la santé et la performance des systèmes et intervenir lors d'incidents afin d'assurer leur disponibilité et leur fiabilité.
  • Identifier et résoudre des enjeux complexes d'infrastructure dans des environnements de développement, de préproduction et de production, tant dans le nuage que sur du matériel local.
  • Gérer les dépendances logicielles, les versions et la cohérence des environnements de développement et de déploiement, tout en assurant la conformité des licences et l'identification des vulnérabilités.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie logicielle afin d'intégrer les pratiques d'infrastructure et de déploiement à leurs processus de développement.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils, méthodes de travail et standards DevOps.
  • Encadrer et soutenir les spécialistes DevOps moins expérimentés dans leur développement professionnel.
  • Maintenir une documentation claire de la configuration des infrastructures et des processus opérationnels.
  • Participer à l'évaluation et à l'intégration de nouvelles technologies favorisant l'automatisation et la fiabilité.
  • Explorer et adopter de façon proactive des outils et flux de travail fondés sur l'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer votre efficacité personnelle ainsi que les activités d'automatisation, de dépannage et de gestion des infrastructures.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche requise afin de répondre aux besoins de l'entreprise.

Qualifications et expérience

Formation

  • Baccalauréat, DEC ou DEP en informatique, en technologies de l'information ou expérience pertinente équivalente.

Expérience, connaissances et compétences

  • Minimum de 6 années d'expérience professionnelle en génie logiciel, infrastructure, ingénierie de plateforme ou environnements DevOps, dont au moins 4 années consacrées aux pratiques DevOps, à l'automatisation de l'infrastructure, aux pipelines CI/CD, aux déploiements infonuagiques ou locaux, ou à des responsabilités connexes.
  • Expérience pratique de la gestion de configuration des environnements (approvisionnement et préparation des environnements), tant dans le nuage que sur du matériel local.
  • Solide expertise en gestion des dépendances et des paquets logiciels dans plusieurs langages et technologies ainsi qu'en maintien de la cohérence des environnements.
  • Capacité démontrée à concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des infrastructures avec un minimum de supervision.
  • Une expérience en conteneurisation et en orchestration constitue un atout.
  • Connaissance des meilleures pratiques en matière de surveillance, de journalisation et de gestion des incidents.
  • Excellentes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, y compris dans des contextes techniques peu familiers.
  • Bonnes compétences en communication et capacité à documenter et présenter clairement des solutions techniques.
  • Aisance dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.
  • Désir d'identifier de façon proactive les possibilités d'amélioration des systèmes, outils et processus.

Une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, est requise pour ce poste. Cette exigence est nécessaire puisque la personne titulaire du poste devra :

  • collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, équipes et partenaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec dont la langue de travail est l’anglais;
  • participer à des réunions techniques, des revues de code et des discussions de conception tenues en anglais;
  • consulter, analyser et utiliser de la documentation technique, des outils de développement, des cadres logiciels (frameworks) et des ressources spécialisées principalement disponibles en anglais;
  • rédiger ou réviser de la documentation technique, des commentaires de code et des communications destinées à des équipes anglophones;
  • contribuer à des projets logiciels mondiaux nécessitant des échanges fréquents en anglais.

ENGLISH

Position Purpose

As a Senior DevOps Specialist, you will play a key role in building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment systems that power our vision to Create Moments that Move People. You will independently design and implement infrastructure solutions, improve automation to support all aspects of software delivery, and help ensure our platforms remain reliable, scalable, and secure.

Through proactive problem-solving and close collaboration with engineering teams, you will strengthen our DevOps practices, mentor less experienced engineers and influence infrastructure decisions.

Responsibilities

The Senior DevOps Specialist is responsible for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure and automation solutions that support our software products, projects and platform.

The Senior DevOps Specialist will:

  • Work closely alongside DevOps and software architects to design, implement, and maintain infrastructure in alignment with product and technical strategy.
  • Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot build, test, and production infrastructure, including OS-level configuration and dependency management.
  • Take ownership of infrastructure and automation tasks from design through implementation and validation.
  • Monitor system health and performance, and respond to incidents to maintain reliability and uptime.
  • Identify and resolve complex infrastructure issues across development, staging and production environments spanning cloud and local hardware.
  • Manage software dependencies, versioning, and environment consistency across development and deployment targets, ensuring license compliance and identification of vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate infrastructure and deployment practices into their development process.
  • Contribute to improving DevOps tooling, workflows, and standards across development teams.
  • Mentor and support more junior DevOps engineers in developing their skills.
  • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure configurations and operational processes.
  • Assist with evaluating and integrating new tools and technologies to improve automation and reliability.
  • Proactively explore and adopt AI tools and workflows to drive your personal efficiency, and that of our automation, troubleshooting and management of infrastructure.
  • Perform other duties as required to meet business needs.

Position Requirements

Qualifications – Academic / Vocational

  • Bachelor’s degree, DEC or DEP in Computer Science or Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.

Experience – Knowledge and Skills

  • 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps environments, including at least 4 years focused on DevOps, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, cloud/on-prem deployment, or related platform responsibilities.
  • Hands-on experience with machine configuration management (provisioning and environment setup) for both cloud and local hardware.
  • Strong skills in dependency and package management across a variety of languages and technologies, including techniques for maintaining environment consistency.
  • A demonstrated ability to design, implement and maintain infrastructure with limited supervision.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration is desirable.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging and incident management best practices.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to apply these quickly in unfamiliar environments.
  • Good communication skills, with an ability to clearly document and discuss technical solutions.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.
  • A desire to take initiative in identifying areas for improvement across systems, tools and processes.

title: Department Supervisor - Perimeter Mall
description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

title: Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist - Banking and Finance
description:
• Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist — Banking & Finance

    AFCA's Senior Dispute Resolution Specialists play a central role in how we consider and resolve complex and difficult complaints, often with multiple issues. In this role, you will utilise experience in negotiation, conciliation and case investigation to resolve financial complaints fairly and efficiently, applying relevant codes, industry guidelines, legislation, common law and AFCA's Fairness Jurisdiction.

    Working as part of a team, Senior Dispute Resolution Specialists review complex complaints from consumers and small businesses that have not been resolved directly with the financial firm, and impartially negotiate fair outcomes where possible.

    Where a complaint cannot be resolved by agreement, a Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist investigate complaints to prepare and provide a verbal or written assessment of the issues and recommended outcome.

    The Senior Dispute Resolution role also has a strong focus on mentoring and quality. Beyond managing a caseload of active complaints, Senior Dispute Resolution Specialists are a trusted reviewer and coach for colleagues, helping to sharpen their investigation approach, increase capability and technical knowledge and lifting the standard of written and verbal communication.

    As a Senior Dispute Resolution Specialist, you will play a central role in how we consider and resolve complaints. You will:

  • Review complex complaints from consumers and small businesses that have not been resolved directly with the financial firm
  • Work with customers to understand the issues in the complaint and gather relevant information
  • Apply a sound understanding of the AFCA complaint resolution criteria including: relevant legal principles, applicable industry codes or guidance, good industry practice and previous AFCA decision to resolve financial complaints fairly and efficiently
  • Use alternative dispute resolution methods, including conciliation, to help parties resolve complaints by negotiation
  • Conduct a thorough investigation of complaints that cannot be resolved by negotiation, using your strong analytical and critical thinking skills to produce well-reasoned and fair preliminary assessments in Plain English
  • Complete quality assurance activities, reviewing written communication, assessments and correspondence to providing constructive feedback that lifts clarity, structure, reasoning and Plain English standards across the team
  • Support the overall capability and confidence of the team by mentoring and coaching team members on case management activities, resolution techniques, and investigation and analytical tasks.

  • Our Banking and Finance teams deal directly with consumers and financial firms to help resolve and investigate complaints across all banking and finance products. Some of the issues commonly investigated include:

  • Disputed transactions and scams
  • Responsible and Appropriate lending
  • Misleading and unconscionable conduct
  • Financial difficulty
  • Charges including interest and fees
  • Privacy and confidentiality, including Credit Reporting

To be successful in this role, you will have:

title: Technical Specialist Dimensional Engineering
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

This position requires an experienced professional with extensive expertise in end-to-end Dimensional Engineering across the complete vehicle development lifecycle. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical and leadership capabilities, a proactive mindset, and a demonstrated ability to drive results in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of leading dimensional engineering activities through vehicle launch, while effectively collaborating across Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Development, and Supplier organizations. They must be able to translate vehicle-level dimensional requirements into robust product and process solutions that ensure world-class fit, finish, and craftsmanship.

This individual is expected to demonstrate technical excellence, sound engineering judgment, and a relentless commitment to continuous improvement. They will be recognized subject matter expert who consistently raises the level of technical rigor within the organization, mentors and develop engineering talent, and drives the adoption of best practices and standards.

The ideal candidate embraces challenges with energy, determination, and a strong sense of ownership, striving for excellence in all aspects of their work while maintaining the highest standards of quality, innovation, and execution. They must possess the ability to influence cross-functional teams, resolve complex technical issues, and deliver dimensional performance targets that support successful vehicle launches and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the collection, and deployment of dimensional targets, ensuring they are effectively incorporated into product, process, and tooling designs.
  • Validate in launch component and assembly locating strategies to achieve vehicle-level dimensional objectives.
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to develop robust tooling concepts that support dimensional quality targets throughout product development and production.
  • Provide technical leadership for the validation of dimensional simulation models using 3DCS.
  • Collaborate closely with Design, Manufacturing, and Quality Engineering teams to develop, validate, and implement Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) requirements.
  • Lead the optimization, and validation of GD&T schemes for components and assemblies to ensure dimensional performance meets or exceeds program targets.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of comprehensive gaging and measurement strategies for prototype and production phases for in plant assemblies.
  • Drive cross-functional reviews to identify dimensional risks and recommend design, process, tooling, and manufacturing improvements.
  • Lead root cause investigations and resolution activities for dimensional issues identified during prototype builds, launch, and production.
  • Develop dimensional engineering standards, best practices, methodologies, and procedures to improve organizational capability and consistency.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to dimensional engineers, designers, and manufacturing teams.
  • Lead the development, deployment, and delivery of dimensional engineering training programs as required across engineering and manufacturing organizations.
  • Support vehicle architecture development by establishing and managing system and subsystem dimensional requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Present dimensional performance, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies to engineering leadership and program management teams.
  • Ensure successful execution of dimensional engineering activities from concept development through vehicle launch and production ramp-up.

Skills

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in Dimensional Engineering or a related field.
  • Proven experience leading vehicle-level dimensional engineering activities for new product development programs.
  • Comprehensive understanding of automotive system and subsystem dimensional requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive dimensional architecture and influence the development of new vehicle concepts.
  • Expert-level knowledge and application of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Proven track record of excellence in dimensional analysis, tolerance stack-up studies, and variation simulations using 3DCS.
  • Deep understanding of automotive design, product development, manufacturing processes, and assembly operations.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in Dimensional Engineering within the automotive industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of inspection methods, metrology principles, and measurement systems.
  • Expert proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Process Capability Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • End-to-end dimensional engineering experience from concept development through production launch on a minimum of five vehicle programs.
  • Expert-level understanding of dimensional engineering standards, best practices, and industry requirements.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to align Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Supplier Quality, and Program Management teams to achieve dimensional objectives.
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop dimensional engineers while establishing and improving engineering standards and processes

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in Dimensional Engineering or a related field.
  • End-to-end dimensional engineering experience from concept development through production launch on a minimum of five vehicle programs.
  • Comprehensive understanding of automotive system and subsystem dimensional requirements.
  • Expert-level knowledge and application of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Expert proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Process Capability Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Proven track record of excellence in dimensional analysis, tolerance stack-up studies, and variation simulations using 3DCS.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in Dimensional Engineering within the automotive industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of inspection methods, metrology principles, and measurement systems.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to align Design, Manufacturing, Quality, Supplier Quality, and Program Management teams to achieve dimensional objectives.

title: Staff DevOps
description:
Who We Are

KEV builds mission-critical financial software for K12 schools across North America. Our platform provides real-time visibility and control over how funds are collected and managed, replacing fragmented workflows with secure, modern systems that schools rely on every day.

Trusted by more than 27,000 K12 schools managing over $8B annually, KEV delivers mission-critical software for payments, accounting, and reporting, where reliability and security matter. Headquartered in Toronto with teams across North America, we are scaling quickly and investing deeply in cloud-native, data-driven technology.

KEV is a place for people who care about building durable software at scale and doing work that has real impact in public education. We focus on solving hard problems, raising the bar on engineering craft, and building products that earn long-term trust from the communities we serve.

This role is for an active vacancy.

About the Role

We are hiring a Staff DevOps Engineer to lead the modernization of KEV's infrastructure and delivery practices, taking us from where we are today to a platform built on infrastructure as code, templated CI/CD, and self-service golden paths for engineering teams. This role requires deep hands‑on experience and the judgment to assess our current state honestly, shape a pragmatic modernization strategy, and break that strategy into work a team can actually execute.

You will operate as both a senior technical practitioner and a force multiplier: writing and reviewing the automation yourself while also coaching and upskilling existing team members. This is a role for someone who partners easily across the organization — with engineering leads and managers day to day, and with finance, revenue, product, and the Vice President of Architecture and CTO when infrastructure decisions have cost, risk, or roadmap implications — rather than treating platform modernization as an engineering-only initiative.

How You Will Contribute

Infrastructure Modernization Strategy & Execution Assess the current state of KEV's infrastructure and delivery practices, identify where legacy operations are creating risk or slowing teams down, and build a clear, sequenced strategy for modernizing them. Break that strategy into concrete workstreams, and lead a team through execution — balancing speed against risk and communicating trade-offs to stakeholders as priorities compete.

Infrastructure as Code & Platform Engineering Design and build the infrastructure-as-code foundations and templated, reusable CI/CD pipelines that let application teams ship reliably without re-solving the same infrastructure problems. Establish golden paths and platform engineering practices that make the right way to build and deploy the easy way, removing any manual, one-off work.

Azure & .NET Delivery Automation Own and improve how KEV's .NET services are built, deployed, and operated within Microsoft Azure, automating deployment pipelines and Azure-native infrastructure so releases are fast, predictable, and low-risk. Bring deep Azure expertise to decisions about how workloads should be architected and delivered going forward.

Site Reliability & AI-Enabled Operations Apply SRE practices — service-level objectives, reliability engineering, incident response — to raise the bar on how KEV's platforms are operated in production. Evaluate and apply AI tooling where it can meaningfully improve engineering and operational workflows, bringing the same trade-off thinking to new tooling that you'd apply to any other infrastructure decision.

Developer Experience Improve the day-to-day experience of engineers working on KEV's platforms, including local development environments and the tooling that supports them. Treat DevEx as a lever for velocity and quality, not a nice-to-have, and use feedback from engineering teams to prioritize what to fix next.

Coaching & Technical Mentorship Coach and mentor existing team members, helping them build fluency in infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and platform engineering practices. Raise the technical bar of the team through hands‑on pairing, review, and knowledge‑sharing, not just through documentation.

Cross‑Functional Partnership & Communication Partner effectively with engineering leads, managers, and the Vice President of Architecture and CTO, as well as functions like finance, revenue, and product, translating technical modernization work into terms each audience cares about — cost, risk, timeline, or impact on delivery. Communicate clearly and proactively so that stakeholders across the business understand what's changing, why, and what trade‑offs were made.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of hands‑on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or a similar infrastructure/engineering role, with a track record of leading the modernization of infrastructure operations into a DevOps model.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and rolling out infrastructure as code, templated/reusable CI/CD pipelines, and platform engineering practices such as golden paths, at an organizational scale.
  • Experience assessing the current state of an organization's infrastructure and delivery practices, building a modernization strategy from that assessment, breaking it into executable work, and leading a team through delivery.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including contributing to and automating the deployment of modern and legacy .NET services.
  • Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering practices to production systems and experience evaluating and adopting AI tooling to improve engineering or operational workflows.
  • Experience improving developer experience, including local development environments and developer‑facing tooling.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment - PCI, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST
  • Solid understanding of security principles in complex ecosystems and proficiency with debugging and diagnostic tools to resolve application issues effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor engineers, raising the technical capability of a team over time.
  • Strong ability to think in trade‑offs — technical, cost, timeline, and risk — and to make and explain those trade‑offs to both engineering and non‑engineering audiences.
  • Excellent communication skills, with proven ability to partner across organizational boundaries

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation – We believe in rewarding great work with fair, competitive pay.
  • Meaningful benefits – Because your well‑being matters; both at work and at home.
  • Retirement Savings Support – We help you plan for your future with company‑matched programs, including RRSP matching in Canada and 401(k) contributions in the U.S.
  • Professional development – We invest in your growth with ongoing learning, stretch opportunities, and continuing education, including KEV Academy for onboarding and skill‑building, plus KEV University, our online platform offering a wide range of courses.
  • Hybrid model – 3 days in the office to collaborate and connect, with flexibility the rest of the week.
  • Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge with close to 4 weeks of vacation and a company‑wide holiday closure
  • Office perks – Enjoy a fully stocked snack bar and occasional catered lunches—because we know that great conversations (and ideas) often start around good food.

Salary Range - $150,000-180,000

Note: We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Why You’ll Love Working at KEV

  • Make a real difference every day – At KEV, your work supports children, parents, and schools across North America. We don’t just build software, we create solutions that simplify lives and strengthen communities. Our mission is rooted in impact, and every team member plays a vital role in shaping the future of K-12 education.
  • The KEV Way – At KEV, you’ll never feel stuck in the status quo. You’ll be part of a team that’s constantly questioning, improving, and innovating—always with one guiding focus: How does this help our schools and the students they serve? It’s a culture that challenges you to do your best work while reminding you why it matters.
  • Grow with us – We’re scaling fast, and so are our people. At KEV, you’ll have real opportunities to learn, develop, and shape your career. Whether advancing in your role or exploring a new path, you’ll be supported every step of the way.
  • Work alongside excellence – You’ll be part of a team with integrity who treat their colleagues with respect. who are accomplished but humble, collaborative but accountable. It’s a place where you can do your best work while feeling supported and inspired by the people around you.
  • Celebrate Community and Culture – At KEV, we connect, recognize, and celebrate our people. Join Club KEV for team‑building fun, hear directly from customers in our Voice of Customer Series, stay aligned with Monthly Townhalls, and be inspired by the KEVite Awards, where top contributors are recognized by their peers.

This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required by an individual joining the KEV team in this or any other capacity.

title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
company: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets. The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues. Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

  • Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
  • Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
  • Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
  • Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
  • Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. Compile, optimize and update data center standard operating procedures including SOP, MOP and EOP, and improve the standardized operation system of the data center.

Follow up and complete other special operation and maintenance tasks of the data center cluster assigned by the company.

About you

Major in Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, HVAC or related fields.

At least 1 year of formal working experience in data center facility operation and maintenance industry.

Familiar with data center industry standards, management rules and overall operational workflows of various business modules.

Possess solid on-site management and coordination capabilities, with good professional quality, strong sense of responsibility and execution.

Able to consider the interests of the company, data center and customers comprehensively, strictly implement operation management specifications, and fully guarantee the long-term stable and safe operation of the data center.

Candidates with practical data center electromechanical and HVAC operation experience are preferred.

title: DevOps, Kubernetes, and Site Reliability Engineer
description:
At Brokerage, we advise, originate, trade, manage, and distribute capital for governments, institutions, and individuals, always operating with a standard of excellence. We are a leading global financial services firm conducting business through three principal business segments: Institutional Securities, Wealth Management, and Investment Management. The Firm’s employees serve clients worldwide from more than 1,200 offices across 43 countries.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people are critical to our success. We share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and a strong team ethic. Brokerage provides a strong foundation for building a professional career, offering people opportunities to learn, achieve, and grow. A philosophy that respects different lifestyles, perspectives, and individual needs is an important part of our culture.

Department Profile

Operations Technology, or OpsTech, is an innovation-driven organization comprising functionally aligned engineering teams that support critical Firm operations. We develop strategic technology solutions for key business processes, including settlements, confirmations, regulatory reporting, position keeping, and client reference data management.

If you are interested in solving complex technical problems, improving developer productivity, and building reliable engineering solutions in a dynamic global environment, OpsTech is the place for you.

Position Description

We are looking for an experienced DevOps, Kubernetes, and Site Reliability Engineer with a minimum of five years of relevant industry experience. Experience within financial services or another highly regulated technology environment is preferred.

The successful candidate will join the Operations Technology team and help design, automate, deploy, and support reliable application platforms and CI/CD capabilities. The role will work closely with application development, infrastructure, network, security, and production support teams to improve software delivery, platform stability, operational resilience, and engineering efficiency.

The position requires strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker/Podman, Linux, networking, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, Python, and shell scripting. The candidate should understand modern DevOps and SRE practices and be comfortable supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex application and infrastructure issues, and automating repetitive operational tasks.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about automation, production reliability, and continuous improvement. The candidate should be organized, disciplined, detail-oriented, self-motivated, collaborative, and focused on delivering measurable engineering outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD pipelines and supporting build, test, release, and deployment infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain automated deployment solutions for applications running in Kubernetes and containerized environments.
  • Partner with application development teams to improve build, test, deployment, and release processes.
  • Support the deployment of applications, configuration changes, patches, and platform upgrades across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes deployment artifacts, including YAML configuration, Helm charts, or equivalent packaging and configuration mechanisms.
  • Develop automation using Python, Linux shell scripting, and related tools.
  • Manage and improve GitHub repositories, branching strategies, pull-request workflows, access controls, and automated repository processes.
  • Integrate automated testing, code-quality validation, security scanning, dependency checks, and linting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot application, infrastructure, container, Kubernetes, network, and deployment issues in complex environments.
  • Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive or corrective engineering solutions.
  • Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability, availability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Define and improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, operational metrics, and production support procedures.
  • Automate routine operational activities to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, network, database, cybersecurity, release management, and application teams.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Participate in design reviews, production-readiness reviews, incident reviews, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in an after-hours production support and on-call rotation when required.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, SRE, production engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including application deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, scaling, services, ingress, secrets, and operational support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Docker/Podman and containerized application environments.
  • Strong Linux and UNIX system administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong experience with Linux shell scripting, such as Bash or KornShell.
  • Hands-on programming and automation experience using Python or a comparable language.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts, software delivery lifecycles, release automation, and deployment strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and artifact-management tools such as Jenkins and Artifactory, or equivalent platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub, including repository management, pull requests, branching strategies, release workflows, and automated checks.
  • Experience developing automation using YAML, Ansible, or an equivalent automation framework.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, routing, load balancing, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting applications and resolving production issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of SRE practices, including monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, service reliability, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience integrating code-quality tools, security scanning, automated testing, and policy controls into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across application, operating system, container, network, infrastructure, and database layers.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and using tools such as Jira.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering and support teams.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and deliver results with limited supervision.
  • Ability to participate in an after-hours on-call support rotation.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as OpenShift or another managed Kubernetes environment.
  • Experience provisioning on-demand environments using virtual machines and containers.
  • Experience working with Azure, AWS, GCP, or another cloud platform.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management technologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes package-management and deployment tools such as Helm.
  • Experience with GitOps deployment models and tools.
  • Knowledge of service mesh technologies, container networking, ingress controllers, and API gateways.
  • Experience with observability and telemetry platforms, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Experience developing or maintaining Grafana dashboards.
  • Familiarity with production incident management, problem management, change management, service operations, and release management.
  • Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and production resiliency.
  • Experience with relational database technologies such as DB2, Sybase, or Oracle.
  • Experience working in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with secure software supply-chain practices, secrets management, certificate management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be:

  • Passionate about automation, reliability, and engineering excellence.
  • Comfortable owning technical problems from initial investigation through resolution.
  • Able to balance delivery speed with production stability, security, and operational risk.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities to simplify processes and remove manual work.
  • Capable of communicating complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative team member who shares knowledge and contributes to the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

title: Electrical (ELE) Engineer (Data Center)
description:
This role requires the candidate to work in South Jakarta, Indonesia.

Client Overview

Our client is a global technology company operating in the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) industry, specializing in digital infrastructure, enterprise technology solutions, and mission‑critical facilities.

The organization delivers end‑to‑end infrastructure solutions across telecommunications, cloud computing, data centers, enterprise networks, and intelligent digital platforms. With operations spanning multiple countries and large‑scale infrastructure projects, the company partners with enterprise customers, system integrators, and engineering organizations to support digital transformation initiatives.

As demand for high‑availability data center infrastructure continues to grow, the company is expanding its engineering capabilities and seeking experienced technical professionals to lead complex electrical system design and project delivery for mission‑critical facilities.

Job Role

The Electrical (ELE) Engineer (Data Center) is responsible for designing, validating, and delivering reliable electrical infrastructure solutions for large‑scale data center projects. This role oversees the end‑to‑end engineering lifecycle, including electrical system design, technical evaluation, equipment selection, stakeholder coordination, and on‑site engineering support to ensure successful project execution.

Working closely with project leadership, consultants, contractors, vendors, and clients, the successful candidate will ensure that all electrical systems are designed and implemented in accordance with project specifications, local regulations, and international data center standards. The role also supports technical clarification, engineering optimization, commissioning activities, and field issue resolution to ensure system reliability, operational efficiency, and timely project delivery.

This position is ideal for experienced electrical engineers with strong expertise in mission‑critical facilities, power distribution systems, and data center infrastructure who are passionate about delivering high‑quality engineering solutions in a fast‑paced project environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver comprehensive electrical system designs for large‑scale data center projects, including Single‑Line Diagrams (SLD), load calculations, power distribution layouts, cable routing, and Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
  • Design and validate High Voltage (HV), Medium Voltage (MV), Low Voltage (LV), UPS systems, generators, transformers, power distribution units (PDU), battery backup systems, and supporting electrical infrastructure.
  • Ensure electrical solutions comply with project specifications, local regulations, and international data center standards and best practices.
  • Define end‑to‑end electrical system architectures and evaluate equipment specifications to ensure technical compatibility, system reliability, redundancy, and energy efficiency.
  • Review and recommend appropriate electrical equipment, materials, and infrastructure components based on project requirements and engineering standards.
  • Lead technical discussions, solution reviews, and design clarification sessions with clients, consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with equipment suppliers, manufacturers, and subcontractors to resolve technical issues, optimize engineering solutions, and ensure alignment with project requirements.
  • Support construction, installation, and site execution activities by providing technical guidance and ensuring work is delivered according to approved engineering designs.
  • Conduct site inspections, review design modifications, evaluate technical change requests, and resolve engineering issues throughout project execution.
  • Collaborate with commissioning teams during system testing, verification, troubleshooting, and project handover to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Prepare engineering documentation, technical reports, design calculations, and project deliverables while maintaining compliance with quality, safety, and project standards.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional engineering and project management teams to support timely project delivery, mitigate technical risks, and maintain overall project performance.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical engineering design, MEP engineering, or technical project delivery.
  • Proven experience leading engineering activities within data center or other mission‑critical infrastructure projects.
  • Hands‑on experience delivering large‑scale data center facilities with complex electrical systems is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of High Voltage (HV), Medium Voltage (MV), Low Voltage (LV), UPS systems, generators, grounding, surge protection, power monitoring, and electrical distribution systems.
  • Working knowledge of HVAC, fire protection, and integrated MEP coordination.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, ETAP, or other electrical engineering software, as well as Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Able to work under pressure and adapt to dynamic project environments with frequent site deployments.
  • Willing to work flexible hours during critical project phases when required.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Trustworthy GenAI-assisted Software Engineering
description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Trustworthy GenAI-assisted Software Engineering

This is Western Norway University of Applied Sciences

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.
The Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences offers a wide range of courses both at undergraduate and graduate levels in:
Engineering and Natural sciences Economic and Administrative sciences Maritime sciences Social sciences and Humanities. The Faculty is
also responsible for PhD programmes in computer technology, innovation and regional development and in nautical operations.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners

The Department of Computer science, Electrical engineering and Mathematical sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) has an open position as a post-doctoral researcher within trustworthy GenAI-assisted software engineering.

The position is for a period of up to 3 years and associated with the strategically funded TERSE project.

Workplace is campus Bergen.

Project and duties of the position
The TERSE project aims to develop actionable methods, guidelines and software tools for enhancing
software engineering with the application of GenAI; and to explore how profession-oriented education and
curricula in software engineering should be transformed in light the emerging GenAI era. A central element
of the project is collaboration with industry, public sector institutions and international partners aimed to
investigate the real-world effects of GenAI in software engineering.


Software technology and engineering are key enablers in the ongoing digital transformation of society.
GenAI has emerged as a disruptive technology not only within a multitude of sectors profoundly impacting
the way we will work in the future, but also within the profession of software engineering itself where code
is increasingly being automatically produced by GenAI-based coding co-pilots and agents. Considering the
pivotal and increasingly critical role of software in society, the prospect of such a disruptive change raises
fundamental questions on the feasibility and risks associated with the application of GenAI, and on how the
future profession of software engineers will change.


The postdoctoral researcher will work closely with the four work package leaders of the TERSE project on
coordinated industry collaboration enabling longitudinal and empirical studies of GenAI, and on developing
and evaluating methods and software technology to detect, prevent, and mitigate faults in GenAI-generated
software. Key research questions to be addressed include: what measurable productivity and software
quality effects occur when applying GenAI in software engineering processes; how to develop and apply
software engineering tools which make AI-assisted development dependable; what are best practices and
methodology for trustworthy application of GenAI-based software tools and technology; and how to
integrate GenAI in software engineering education.

Research environment

The postdoctoral researcher will be a key researcher in the TERSE project and part of the software engineering research group at HVL https://www.hvl.no/en/research/group/software-engineering/ . The research group currently include 10 professors and associate professors, 12 postdoctoral researchers and PhD candidates, and a large number of master students in software engineering and
in applied computer science. The software engineering research group is conducting high-quality research presented at international venues, and has broad scientific expertise including empirical software engineering, model- based software engineering, and formal methods for software engineering. The research group has a strong track record of externally funded projects with national and international industry and with academic partners. This includes projects within cloud computing and services, internet-of-things, business process modelling, AI, machine learning, collaborative systems, and security spanning domains such as healthcare services, marine environments, robotics, industrial automation and emergency work. The postdoctoral research fellow will be provided with work expense funding that can be used forconference participation, travel and research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is
Campus Bergen.

Qualifications

The successful applicant must have earned a PhD degree in informatics/computer science/software engineering or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded before the candidate can be offered the position. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within software engineering, and preferably include the application of generative AI and machine learning in software engineering or software engineering for AI. In addition to the required educational background and scientific profile, the following criteria will be assessed in the ranking of qualified candidates:

  • Quality and relevance of the PhD thesis
  • Publication and project acquisition track record, quality and relevance of publications
  • Practical software engineering skills, including experience with generative AI in software development or the engineering of software for AI solutions
  • Research network, industrial work experience and/or experience from industrial collaboration
  • Ability to work in the intersection of theoretical, applied, and empirical research
  • Teaching experience and interest in curriculum development in software engineering education
  • Ability to collaborate, engage in writing funding applications, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research work, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Dissemination capacity, oral and written communication skills in English (or in Norwegian)

The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter, including a statement of motivation, description of relevance of research profile in relation to the position and summary of scientific work and industry experience
  • Up to five selected publications
  • Copies of educational certificates, transcript of academic records
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Applicants will in addition be assessed in relation to their prospective starting date.

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. If the documents submitted are not in English or in a Scandinavian language, the applicants must submit the corresponding certified translations.

HVL/Ingvild F. Melien

title: Senior Flight Software Engineer

Job Description

ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations. Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium‑lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.

Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

ABOUT SPACE SYSTEMS AT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems team is responsible for every satellite and satellite component made by Rocket Lab: from complete satellites destined for missions to the Moon and Mars, to the individual components and subsystems that make up a satellite like solar panels, flight software, reaction wheels and star trackers, separation systems, radios, and more. Our Space Systems team is made up of engineers, technicians, and designers who design, create, and put together our own satellites for missions across the commercial, government, and defense sectors, or who build and assemble satellite hardware and software that supports other satellite missions.

SENIOR FLIGHT SOFTWARE ENGINEERWHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO
  • Architect flight software solutions across three domains: sustaining engineering for current missions on orbit, next‑generation FSW for autonomous satellite constellations (including C&DH, GNC/ACS, FDIR, mode management, and autonomy), and embedded software for hardware products like thrusters, reaction wheels, radios, star trackers, and IMUs.
  • Lead system trade studies and design solutions in collaboration with Avionics Hardware, GNC, and Operations teams, balancing technical excellence with schedule and budget constraints across a diverse portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain robust regression testing frameworks that span flight software and embedded software product lines, enabling rapid, reliable verification across missions and component releases.
  • Guide multi‑disciplinary engineering teams through anomaly resolution, technical risk identification and mitigation, and delivery of complex aerospace systems from concept through on‑orbit operation.
  • Define technical standards and best practices for the team, facilitate architecture meetings, approve designs, and communicate FSW architecture clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, training delivery, and on‑the‑job coaching while role‑modeling professional behavior and technical excellence.
YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar, with minimum 5 years of professional experience in a relevant discipline.
  • Deep technical expertise in C/C++, avionics software, embedded systems development on resource‑constrained hardware, and ideally direct experience with aerospace system development, integration, and on‑orbit operations.
  • Strong software development skills including REST APIs, Linux development environments, TypeScript/JavaScript, NodeJS, Angular or similar frontend frameworks (React, Vue), Git, and Python.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and communication abilities, with proven capacity to manage complex projects, adjust to evolving requirements, clearly articulate technical concepts, and inspire teams to deliver.
  • Cross‑functional collaboration mindset with awareness of spacecraft disciplines such as propulsion, thermal, power, structures, GNC, and mechanisms, and ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Ownership mentality and positive attitude, willing to tackle any problem, see challenges as motivation, maintain professionalism under pressure, and consistently demonstrate a "how can I help?" approach.

  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Network programming expertise (Sockets/WebSockets).
  • Familiarity with NodeJS/NPM build systems and tooling.
  • Elasticsearch experience.

Deze werkgever is een netwerk- en telecominfrabedrijf in Harderwijk. De organisatie ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt vaste en draadloze netwerken voor telecomaanbieders in heel Nederland. Je werkt in een team van vakmensen met korte lijnen en een nuchtere aanpak.

Jij bent nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en praktisch ingesteld. Je hebt oog voor detail, legt je bevindingen helder vast en schakelt makkelijk met collega's, opdrachtgevers en andere partijen. Je vindt het prettig om veel buiten te zijn. Daarnaast heb jij:

  • mbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • kennis van glasvezel- of coaxinfrastructuur;

  • inzicht in civiele werkzaamheden en tracebepaling;

  • ervaring met het opstellen van technische rapportages;

  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega's. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

Kun jij je (deels) herkennen in deze vacature? Reageer dan vooral! We gaan graag met jou in gesprek om jou beter te leren kennen. Neem contact met ons op!

title: Senior Platform Engineer

title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
description:
The Department of Computer Science has a vacancy for a

PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering

NTNU is a broad-based university with atechnical-scientific profile and a focusin professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

...

About the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.

About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited.

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.

Duties of the position

  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale . If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act , and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates. NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation . You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene.
