title: Project Coordinator (Open to Tier 1 & Tier 2 applicants)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Office/Unit/Project Description

Morocco has been actively promoting green growth and green jobs through various initiatives and partnerships, with a specific emphasis on engaging youth and Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). The government has set ambitious targets for renewable energy and implemented policies to support sustainable development, such as the National Energy Transition Strategy which aims to increase the share of renewable energy, improve energy efficiency, and promote sustainable transportation.

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in Morocco is playing a crucial role in supporting the country's green transition. The UNDP is working closely with SMEs and youth-led solutions to provide them with the necessary financial and technical support to participate in the green economy. These efforts are aimed at accelerating Morocco's progress in promoting sustainable development, creating green jobs, and supporting the growth of SMEs, while also addressing the challenges of climate change and empowering young people to take an active role in the green growth process.

The Green Growth and Jobs Accelerator (GGJA) is one out of three projects under the Danish-Arab Partnership Programme’s (DAPP) which is funded and managed by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The GGJA is part of DAPP’s programme for Youth Employment and Entrepreneurship. UNDP has been implementing the GGJA which sits regionally as part of the UNDP Regional Bureau for Arab States’ Regional Youth Project Portfolio.

GGJA is implemented in Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, and Tunisia building on UNDP’s work and experience with implementing the SDG Accelerator for SMEs methodology which directly supports sustainable business development and commercial green growth in SMEs. The SDG Accelerator is a part of UNDP’s service offer UNDP Impact Venture Accelerators (IVA). The IVA is a practical approach to help businesses focus on delivering products/services, business models and business plans which contribute to the SDGs.

The objective of the Green Growth and Jobs Accelerator is to support established entrepreneurs and SMEs, of which a proportion will be youth-led, to accelerate green growth in their businesses and through this, support the local transition to a green and sustainable economy, and enable green jobs for youth.

Each year, in each of the four countries in mention, two 5-months Accelerators are implemented, and each Accelerator includes a cohort of up to 25 carefully recruited SMEs. Each company in the Accelerator develops one or more business plans for green growth also integrating relevant ways for the company to create jobs for youth, either as a result of the implementation of the business plan, as means to realize the business plan, or preferably both.

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) has launched the Green Growth and Jobs Accelerator in Morocco as part of its efforts to promote sustainable and inclusive development. The Accelerator offers the opportunity to small and medium-sized enterprises to integrate sustainability into their business models, thereby advancing green growth, job creation, and innovation in line with national priorities and the Sustainable Development Goals.

By the end of 2027, the programme is expected to engage up to two hundred Moroccan enterprises, providing targeted support through coaching, digital training, and facilitated access to investment opportunities. The initiative aims to generate one thousand direct jobs and an additional two thousand five hundred indirect jobs, with a particular emphasis on supporting youth-led businesses and enhancing the participation of women in green economic growth.

By focusing on strategic sectors such as sustainable agriculture, renewable energy, circular economy, and digital innovation, the Green Growth and Jobs Accelerator seek to contribute to the Morocco’s transition toward a low-carbon, climate-resilient economy. The initiative aims to strengthening the resilience and competitiveness of enterprises, expanding opportunities for decent work, and positioning Morocco as a regional leader in green and inclusive development.

Under the overall management and guidance of the UNDP Morocco Country Office, and in coordination with the UNDP Arab States Bureau’s Regional Youth Project Portfolio, the Accelerators will be implemented at the country level. The Morocco Country Office will provide strategic oversight, ensuring coherence with national priorities and alignment with UNDP’s global and regional frameworks.

Implementation will draw on the longstanding networks of the participating Country Offices, engaging relevant stakeholders across sectors, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises. Activities will be carried out in close collaboration with a regional management consulting firm, which supports the implementation process and provides strategic business development consulting on green growth and sustainable business instruments. This consultation includes, for example, advisory services on the development of business plans for new environmentally friendly products and services, the introduction of greener production or operational processes, and the integration of selected standards that can enable enterprises to access new markets.

Under the direct supervision of Democratic Governance Team Leader in the Moroccan Country office, the GGJA Project Coordinator is expected to perform the following responsibilities and duties:

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for the overall management of the Green Growth and Jobs Accelerator at the country level, ensuring effective delivery, strong private sector engagement, and alignment with national and regional priorities.

Scope of Work

1.Coordinate effective project planning and implementation.

  • Follow up the implementation of activities and financial management of the project, including the monitoring of SME cohorts and, where relevant, visits to enterprise premises to assess progress and results.
  • Coordinate the work of the implementing partner, ensuring that contractual outputs are delivered on time, at high quality, and with a tangible contribution to SME growth and green innovation.
  • Support engagement with the private sector stakeholders involved in project implementation.
  • Maintain operational dialogue with business associations, accelerators, innovation hubs, and financial actors relevant to SME support activities.
  • Maintain regular dialogue with public institutions at both local and national levels, as well as with academia and research networks, to ensure that enterprise support is connected to relevant policy frameworks and institutional ecosystems.
  • Ensure day to day coordination among partners and stakeholders, harmonizing approaches and securing synergies with other DAPP initiatives in the country and region, under the guidance of UNDP Morocco Country Office and the Regional Bureau for Arab States’ Regional Youth Portfolio.
  • Ensure structured technical reporting and documentation of activities, including collecting data, monitoring results, and capturing innovations emerging from SME engagement.
  • Contribute to the preparation of cases and success stories for communication purposes, highlighting the impact of the project for both local and regional audiences.

2.Ensure effective implementation of SMEs Accelerators

  • Ensure implementation of two five -month Accelerators per year in in close collaboration with the implementing partners.
  • Support recruitment of SMEs to accelerators through own channels and partners networks, with guidance from UNDP.
  • Take part in in all meetings related to the project and coordination meetings with Regional Bureau for Arab States and the implementing partners.
  • Participate in fortnightly learning sessions focusing on SME progress, methodology/tools application and other items relevant to the project.
  • Support delivery of joint sessions for SMEs including Joint Kick-off workshop, Impact Measurement and Management (IMM) workshop and Showcase.
  • Ensure systematic capture of SME results in line with results framework.
  • Support coordination with youth that are part of Youth4Sustainability and their engagement in the accelerators and support to SMEs, with the support of the Youth Development Delegate .

3.Ensure effective implementation of SME Finance outcome

  • Conduct mapping of sustainable finance and risk finance providers relevant to participating SMEs.
  • Support matchmaking SMEs with potential investors or finance providers.
  • Document progress of dialogues between SMEs and finance actors, in collaboration with the implementing partner.

4.Ensure effective implementation of Learning Modality

  • Support integration of learning materials into relevant stakeholder channels and platforms. Participate in technical design sessions and provide input relevant to the local context.
  • Facilitate coordination with business schools, universities, innovation hubs, accelerators, and incubators for outreach and dissemination of learning materials. Support onboarding of SME alumni to the Green Growth Community. Support use of the Regional Youth Project Platform (NextGen Youth Platform) for knowledge sharing, asset upload, and SME–youth connections.

5.Facilitate knowledge and capacity building, knowledge sharing

  • Organize training, workshops, and capacity building activities in a consultative manner, involving technical experts and stakeholders that may include the government, private sector, NGOs, donors, and/or academia.
  • Identify, synthesize and document best practices and lessons learned that are generated from the project and implementing partners.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

In this context, the Project Manager (PM) will work under the guidance and supervision of the Democratic Governance Programme Analyst and in close collaboration with team members.

Who You Are

  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community

description:
Are you someone who enjoys solving complex data problems and building reliable, scalable data systems?

PT Asuransi Raksa Pratikara is looking for a Data Engineer to help strengthen our growing digital and data ecosystem. You’ll work hands-on with databases, data pipelines, APIs, system integrations, and analytical data models to ensure business-critical data is accurate, secure, accessible, and ready to use.

You’ll collaborate with Software Developers, System Administrators, Data Analysts, and business teams to improve data quality, automate data processing, optimize database performance, and build scalable data solutions.

If you enjoy turning complex data environments into reliable and automated solutions, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines and data integrations across applications, databases, and data sources.

Develop and maintain APIs and integrations for secure and efficient data exchange between systems.

Design and maintain database schemas, data models, tables, relationships, and analytical data structures.

Write and optimize complex SQL queries, indexes, execution plans, and database structures.

Ensure data quality, integrity, consistency, and availability across systems.

Automate data validation, transformation, synchronization, and repetitive data-processing tasks.

Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, scheduled jobs, integrations, database performance, and data discrepancies.

Support data migration, replication, synchronization, and transformation across database platforms.

Review database designs, queries, and data-related changes before production deployment.

Collaborate with business users and analysts to build analytical data models, reporting tables, and dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, or Apache Superset.

Maintain documentation for data models, pipelines, APIs, integrations, and data architecture.

Continuously evaluate technologies and engineering practices to improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance.

What We’re Looking For

1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field.

2. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Data Engineering, Database Engineering, Backend Engineering, or a similar role.

3. Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle Database, and/or MySQL.

4. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.

5. Good understanding of data modeling, database design, normalization, and relational database architecture.

6. Experience or understanding of ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data transformation, APIs, and system integration.

description:

Sales and profit

  • Ensure you meet customer expectations on direct service according to H&M standards.
  • Support the store to achieve an excellent customer experience.

  • Follow up on the H&M Visual Identity through the implementation of the Commercial Handbook and secure well-styled mannequins in windows and in-store.
  • Create a clear red thread from windows to A-area with wearable buying suggestions.
  • Ensure high-quality garment presentation every day together with the store team
  • Maintain clear customer flow through fixture placement and navigation in line with H&M standards
  • Launch and maintain all sales campaigns and activities on time and according to H&M standards.

  • Together with the Department Manager, follow up on store KPIs and initiate actions to reach store goals and budgets

  • Complete the sample picking as well as execute the floor moves in a way that creates clear stories and wearable buying suggestions
  • Complete all sales floor and window morning routines daily before the store is open

  • Keep visual room organized and safe.

title: Consultant vanzari 20 ore City Park
description:
CE VEI FACE​

În calitate de Consultant Vânzări, vei juca un rol cheie în crearea unei experiențe remarcabile pentru clienți. Vei întâmpina clienții, îi vei ghida prin magazin și îi vei sprijini să găsească ceea ce au nevoie în timp ce prezinți produsele noastre. Acționând în conformitate cu valorile noastre, vei contribui atât la succesul tău, cât și al companiei.

Va trebui să:

  • Împărtășești cunoștințele despre modă și produse pentru a ajuta clienții să ia decizii.
  • Colaborezi cu echipa ta pentru a oferi servicii excepționale la fiecare pas al călătoriei clientului, inclusiv în promovarea activă a programului de loialitate (Hello Member).
  • Te asiguri că suprafața de vânzări și zonele din spatele casei de marcat sunt bine aprovizionate, organizate și plăcute.
  • Oferi suport la deschiderea și închiderea magazinului.
  • Te reprezinți pe tine și brandul nostru în mod pozitiv în toate interacțiunile cu clienții.

​CU CINE VEI LUCRA​

Magazinele sunt inima companiei noastre, locul unde clienții experimentează direct brandul nostru. Ca parte a echipei dinamice a magazinului, fiecare rol - de la consilieri de vânzări, manageri de departament, de magazin și visual merchandiseri și până la cash office responsible - contribuie la crearea unui mediu inspirațional și primitor. De asemenea, vei păstra legătura și cu echipa mai mare a Ariei, colaborând între magazine pentru a împărtăși informații și a contribui la succes împreună. Alături de echipa ta, vei juca un rol vital în a-i ajuta pe clienți să se simtă încrezători și să-și exprime individualitatea cu cele mai recente tendințe și stiluri atemporale. Prin construirea de conexiuni semnificative cu clienții din magazinele noastre, facem moda accesibilă și durabilă pentru toți.

​CINE EȘTI​

Suntem în căutare de persoane cu…​

  • Experiență în servicii pentru clienți în modă, retail sau domenii similare care va fi considerată un avantaj.
  • Pasiune pentru a ajuta clienții și interes pentru modă sau retail – restul te învățăm noi!

Și persoane care …​

  • Prosperă în medii colaborative și dinamice.
  • Sunt comunicative, creative, curioase să lucreze cu tehnologia magazinului, cu o dorință puternică de a învăța și de a se dezvolta.
  • Sunt flexibile și orientate spre acțiune.

CINE SUNTEM NOI​

H&M Group este o companie globală de branduri și întreprinderi puternice de modă. Scopul nostru este să demonstrăm că nu există compromisuri între designul excepțional, prețurile accesibile și soluțiile sustenabile. Vrem să facem moda accesibilă pentru mulți, iar clienții noștri sunt în centrul fiecărei decizii pe care o luăm.​

​Suntem un grup alcătuit din mii de colegi pasionați și talentați, uniți de cultura și valorile noastre comune. Împreună, vrem să ne folosim puterea, amploarea și cunoștințele pentru a împinge industria modei către un viitor mai incluziv și mai sustenabil. ​

​DE CE-ȚI VA PLĂCEA SĂ LUCREZI AICI ​

La H&M Group, suntem mândri să fim o companie vibrantă și primitoare. Oferim angajaților noștri beneficii atractive cu oportunități extinse de dezvoltare în întreaga lume. ​

  • 25% discount pentru angajați pentru brandurile H&M Group, atât în magazine, cât și online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories și ARKET).​
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Află mai multe despre program aici.​
  • Oportunități de învățare pentru a construi o carieră pe termen lung într-o companie de modă importantă și dinamică
  • Asigurare de sănătate
  • Împărțirea costului activităților sportive
  • Bonus pentru recomandarea noilor colegi
  • Voucher de Crăciun
  • Tichete de masă

ALĂTURĂ-TE

Caracterul nostru unic provine dintr-o combinație de multe lucruri – cultura noastră incluzivă și colaborativă, valorile noastre puternice și oportunitățile de creștere. Dar, mai presus de toate, oamenii noștri sunt cei care ne fac ceea ce suntem.​

​Fă următorul pas în cariera ta împreună cu noi. Călătoria începe aici.​

​* Evaluarea rolurilor în magazin:

Pentru a gestiona volumul mare de aplicații pentru rolul de Consilier Vânzări, folosim o metodă de evaluare online pentru recrutarea bazată pe abilități în unele dintre magazinele noastre. Va trebui să-l completezi ca parte a procesului de aplicare și selecție. Răspunsurile tale vor fi notate de un instrument de evaluare care aplică criterii predefinite stabilite de H&M Group.

După finalizarea evaluării, vei avea ocazia să oferi feedback și să pui întrebări. Dacă întâmpini dificultăți sau preferi o metodă alternativă de evaluare, te rugăm să contactezi recruitment_support@hm.com . Alegerea unei alternative nu va avea impact asupra aplicației tale.

Pentru mai multe informații despre modul în care prelucrăm datele cu caracter personal, te rugăm să consulți Notificarea noastră de confidențialitate.

**Ne-am angajat într-un proces de recrutare corect, echitabil și bazat pe competență. Prin urmare, te rugăm să nu atașezi o scrisoare de intenție în cererea ta.**

title: Trade & Customs Associate - Tilburg (38 uur)
description:
To meet our current and future capacity needs, our Trade & Customs team in Tilburg is looking for a new colleague. Tilburg is a key location within H&M Group's logistics network, supporting both retail and online business operations across Europe.

We put the customer at the centre of everything we do. Our mission is to ensure products move efficiently through the supply chain and are available when and where our customers need them. To support this mission, we are looking for an ambitious, collaborative, and solution-oriented Trade & Customs Associate to join our team.

As a Trade & Customs Associate, you will play an important role in ensuring the smooth import and export operations of goods moving through our distribution centers. You will work closely with transport providers, customs teams, brokers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient goods flow, regulatory compliance, and high service performance.

What will be expected of you?

As a Trade & Customs Associate, you will be responsible for coordinating international shipments, supporting customs activities, and ensuring the timely movement of goods across our supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Planning and coordinating import flows and cross-docking activities for shipments arriving by sea, air, road, and rail.
  • Monitoring inbound shipments and ensuring timely delivery to the distribution centers in the Netherlands (Tilburg) and other countries.
  • Coordinating customs clearance activities in close cooperation with internal customs teams and external customs brokers.
  • Supporting export processes and cross-border shipments to non-EU destinations in cooperation with internal stakeholders, customs teams, and customs brokers.
  • Preparing, reviewing, and validating commercial invoices, proforma invoices, packing lists, and other customs and financial documentation required for export declarations and international shipment movements.
  • Reviewing and approving transport, freight, and service provider invoices, ensuring accuracy and budget compliance.
  • Communicating daily with transport providers, customs brokers, warehouses, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
  • Tracking shipments and proactively managing transport disruptions, missing cargo, and delivery exceptions.
  • Supporting transport insurance claims and follow-up activities when required.
  • Maintaining operational reports, statistics, and KPIs to support performance monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Working closely with warehouse operations teams and 3PL partners to ensure smooth execution of supply chain activities.
  • Contributing to process improvements and helping maintain efficient and compliant logistics operations.

Who will you work with?

You will collaborate closely with various teams and stakeholders across the H&M Group supply chain, including:

  • Internal Trade & Customs Teams
  • Transport Providers and Freight Forwarders
  • Customs Brokers
  • Warehouse Operations Teams
  • Distribution Centers in Tilburg and other locations
  • Finance Teams
  • Planning and Logistics Teams
  • External Service Providers and 3PL Partners


Who are you?

We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a international environment and can manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

You bring:

  • MBO degree and equivalent work experience in logistics, transport operations or international trade.
  • Knowledge of customs procedures, supply chain processes and international trade regulations.
  • Strong communication skills and excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills.
  • High attention to detail and an ability to work accurately under pressure.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with SAP or transport management systems is considered an advantage.



And as a person, we believe you are:

  • Flexible and willing to support operations in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proactive and solution-focused, with the ability to identify issues and resolve them efficiently.
  • Curious and eager to learn and develop within logistics and international trade.
  • Collaborative and capable of building strong relationships across teams and functions.
  • Structured and organized, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Who are we?

H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands. Our purpose is to prove that great design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions can go hand in hand. We want to make fashion accessible to everyone, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues connected through our shared company culture and values. Together, we use our strengths, skills, and knowledge to make the fashion industry more inclusive and sustainable.

What’s in it for you?

At H&M Group, we are proud of our energetic and welcoming company culture. We offer attractive benefits and extensive global development opportunities.

  • Competitive salary
  • Staff discount valid across all H&M Group brands, both in-store and online
  • Participation in the H&M Incentive Program (HIP)

JOIN US

Our unique strength comes from many things: our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and our development opportunities. Above all, it is our people who make us who we are.

Does this sound like the next step in your career? Submit your CV in English as soon as possible, and no later than the 3rd of October. Take the next step in your career. Your journey starts here!

Due to our data privacy policy, we only accept applications submitted through our career site.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competencies. Therefore, we kindly ask you not to include a cover letter with your application.

title: Satış Danışmanı - Zorlu Center - 29h
description:
Satış Danışmanı olarak mağazaya gelen müşterileri karşılar, ihtiyaçlarını anlamaya çalışır ve alışverişleri boyunca onlara destek olursunuz.

Mağaza içinde satış alanı, deneme kabinleri ve kasa dâhil olmak üzere her noktada müşterilere yardımcı olursunuz. Günlük işleriniz arasında ürünlerin yerleştirilmesi, stokların kontrolü, teslimatların düzenlenmesi ve mağazanın düzenli görünmesinin sağlanması yer alır. Müşterilerin kendilerini rahat hissettiği, keyifli bir alışveriş deneyimi geçirmelerine katkı sağlarsınız.

Bu rolde, markamızı en iyi şekilde temsil ederek mağazaya gelen müşteriler için sıcak ve davetkâr bir deneyim oluşturursunuz. Müşterilere samimi ve ilgili bir şekilde yaklaşır, ihtiyaçlarını anlayarak alışveriş sürecinde onlara yol gösterirsiniz. Yardımsever ve proaktif tutumunuzla müşterilerin kendilerini rahat hissetmelerini sağlar, alışverişlerini keyifle tamamlamalarına destek olursunuz.

Ekip arkadaşlarınızla uyum içinde çalışarak, müşteriler için iyi ve tutarlı bir mağaza deneyimi sunulmasına katkı sağlarsınız.

Müşteri hizmetleri deneyimi ve kumaş bilgisi avantajdır; ancak zorunlu değildir.

• Müşteri odaklı: İnsanlarla iletişim kurmaktan keyif alır, iyi bir hizmet sunmaya önem verirsiniz.
• Uyumlu ve esnek: Değişen önceliklere ve müşteri ihtiyaçlarına kolayca uyum sağlayabilirsiniz.
• Eylem odaklı: İnisiyatif alır, proaktif davranır ve sorumluluklarınızı özenle yerine getirirsiniz.
• Güçlü iletişim becerileri: İnsanlara karşı içten ve ilgili bir yaklaşım sergiler, açık iletişim kurar ve ihtiyaçlarını anlamak için onları dikkatle dinlersiniz.
• Öğrenmeye açık: Geri bildirime açıksınızdır ve kendinizi geliştirmeye isteklisinizdir.
• Markaya ilgi duyan: Markamıza ve koleksiyonlarımıza ilgi duyar, bu ilgiyi müşterilere yansıtırsınız.
• Çalışma saatleri: Akşam, hafta sonu ve tatil günleri dâhil olmak üzere esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilirsiniz.
• Dil bilgisi: Türkçe dilinde iletişim kurabilecek seviyede bilgi sahibi olmak.

Tercih sebebidir (zorunlu değildir):
• Daha önce perakende alanında çalışmış olmak ve mağaza operasyonları ile müşteri hizmetleri konusunda temel bilgiye sahip olmak.

• Müşterilere moda trendleri, kumaşlar ve bedenler konusunda güvenle önerilerde bulunabilmek.

  • Bu pozisyon yarı zamanlı sözleşmelidir ve haftada 29 saat çalışmayı kapsar.
  • Son başvuru tarihi: 05/10/2026

Yan Haklar

Çalışanlarımızı, cazip yan haklar ve gelişim fırsatlarıyla desteklemeye önem veriyoruz. Ekibimizin bir parçası olarak, mağaza içi ve çevrimiçi alışverişlerde geçerli olmak üzere tüm H&M Group markalarında %25 personel indirimi hakkına sahip olursunuz. Ayrıca tüm çalışanlarımız, katkılarını takdir etmek ve gelişimlerini desteklemek amacıyla tasarlanmış olan H&M Teşvik Programı’na (HIP) dâhildir. H&M Teşvik Programı hakkında daha fazla bilgiye buradan ulaşabilirsiniz.

Buna ek olarak, Türkiye’de görev yapan ekip üyelerimiz aşağıdaki yan haklardan faydalanır:

• Yönetim ekibi ve tam zamanlı tüm çalışanlar için özel sağlık sigortası,
• Günlük 383 TRY yemek yardımı,
• Günlük 140 TRY ulaşım yardımı.

Kapsayıcılık & Çeşitlilik

H&M Group olarak, herkesin kendini ait hissettiği kapsayıcı, çeşitli ve eşitlikçi bir çalışma ortamı yaratmayı önemsiyoruz. Farklı geçmişlere, bakış açılarına ve deneyimlere sahip ekiplerin birlikte daha güçlü sonuçlar ortaya koyduğuna inanıyoruz. Bu çeşitlilik; yaratıcı düşünmeyi destekler, bakış açımızı genişletir ve hem dünya genelindeki ekip arkadaşlarımızla hem de müşterilerimizle daha güçlü bağlar kurmamıza katkı sağlar.

Bu nedenle işe alım sürecimizin her aşamasında çeşitliliğin tüm boyutlarını gözetiyor, hizmet verdiğimiz toplulukları yansıtan bir ekip yapısı oluşturmayı hedefliyoruz.

title: Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży 20h
description:
Jako Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży jesteś przyjazną twarzą naszej marki i uosabiasz jej serce.

Będziesz miał/-a okazję zapewnić klientom obsługę na wysokim poziomie na każdym kroku. Od inicjowania rozmów, po pomoc przy kasie, w przymierzalniach i w całym sklepie. Będziesz odgrywać istotną rolę w zwiększaniu komfortu zakupów. Twoje obowiązki będą również obejmować pracę z dostawami, uzupełnianie brakujących produktów i visual merchandising najnowszej kolekcji na sali sprzedaży.

Twoja rola jest niezbędna w tworzeniu przyjaznych doświadczeń, które prezentują to, co najlepsze w naszej marce. Z ciepłem i entuzjazmem poprowadzisz naszych klientów przez ich podróż, oferując prawdziwą pomoc i proaktywną obsługę, aby podnosić na duchu i inspirować. Razem, we współpracy ze swoim zespołem, będziesz tworzyć chwile, które mają znaczenie.

  • Zorientowanie na klienta: lubisz kontakt z ludźmi i jesteś zaangażowany /-a w zapewnianie doskonałej obsługi
  • Elastyczność i zdolność adaptacji: potrafisz reagować na zmieniające się priorytety i potrzeby
  • Zorientowanie na działanie: jesteś proaktywny/-a i zmotywowany/-a do podejmowania inicjatywy i realizowania zadań z najlepszym efektem
  • Doskonała komunikacja: jesteś ciekawy/-a ludzi, komunikujesz się jasno i aktywnie słuchasz, aby zrozumieć ich potrzeby
  • Chęć nauki: otwartość na feedback i ciągłe poszukiwanie możliwości rozwoju
  • Zaangażowanie w markę: pasjonujesz się naszą marką i kolekcjami, z chęcią będziesz dzielić się tym entuzjazmem z klientami
  • Elastyczność: gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach, w tym: wieczorami, w weekendy i w święta
  • Komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem polskim i angielskim

Preferowane, ale nieobowiązkowe:

  • Masz doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i wiesz, jak działa sklep dzięki wcześniejszej pracy w handlu detalicznym
  • Czujesz się pewnie, doradzając klientom w kwestiach trendów, materiałów i dopasowania rozmiarów

  • Część etatu z umową na 20 godzin tygodniowo

  • Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV jak najszybciej, ale nie później niż do 10.10.2026r.

Benefity:

Oferujemy atrakcyjne benefity i możliwości rozwoju. Jako członek/-kini zespołu otrzymasz 25% rabatu pracowniczego na wszystkie marki Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online. Ponadto każdy/-a pracownik/-czka jest objęty/-a Programem Motywacyjnym H&M (HIP), który nagradza Twój wkład i wspiera rozwój w firmie. Więcej informacji o programie znajdziesz tutaj.

Dodatkowo, pracownicy w Polsce otrzymują:

  • Umowę o pracę

  • Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości od 50 PLN do 200 PLN (proporcjonalnie do etatu)

  • Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz)

  • Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku

  • Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej – 30 PLN

  • Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej – 49 PLN

  • Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie

  • Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit

  • Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych

INKLUZYWNOŚĆ I RÓŻNORODNOŚĆ

W Grupie H&M dążymy do tworzenia inkluzywnych, różnorodnych i sprawiedliwych miejsc pracy w całej organizacji. Wierzymy, że zespoły rozwijają się, gdy łączą różnorodne doświadczenia i perspektywy. Ta różnorodność zwiększa naszą zdolność do kreatywnego rozwiązywania problemów, poszerza horyzonty i buduje wartościowe relacje z kolegami, koleżankami i klientami na całym świecie. Dlatego uwzględniamy wszystkie wymiary różnorodności w procesie rekrutacji – aby nasze zespoły odzwierciedlały bogactwo społeczności, którym służymy.

title: Senior Deployment Technician
description:
About the role:

As a Senior Deployment Technician, you will be primarily responsible for technical and administrative activities associated with workstation replacement (WSR) program in line with guidelines related to technical investigations, lifecycle schedule and stock management.

This role support's the Deployment Coordinator in delivering on replacement activities to meet Queensland Health's approved asset lifecycle processes within a geographical area.

You will be required to engage with customers and handle escalation of technical issues related to the run up and delivery of devices.
The workstation replacement (WSR) program performs the replacement of computing devices to improve performance and reduce interruption to clinical and non-clinical staff working within Queensland Health.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Provide excellent customer service by applying communication skills with an ability to negotiate, advise and work collaboratively with others to reach decisions.
  • Provide timely support to clients by conducting investigation and diagnosis of incidents and providing eHealth incident management processes to ensure agreed Service Levels are maintained.
  • Supporting the local Deployment Coordinator to manage team members and activities to deliver the WSR program for supported sites.
  • Engagement as a member of the team to ensure WSR activities (including WSR stock management of new and replaced devices, run up, deployment and installation of devices) are completed as per documented work processes.
  • Ensure asset management integrity is maintained by ensuring work processes are implemented correctly and involvement with regular asset activities as identified.
  • Provide financial administrative support, within the domain of WSR, by undertaking activities associated with quoting & ICT asset and equipment management.
  • Provide ad-hoc support (on-site and remote) to Queensland Health sites as required.

Role fit:

We are seeking a technically capable ICT professional with demonstrated experience managing, configuring, monitoring and implementing ICT environments across relevant technical domains. You will have a strong focus on delivering high-quality client support, effectively prioritising workloads, resolving issues within agreed Service Level Agreements, and working independently. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential, including the ability to build effective working relationships, mentor junior staff, and produce clear technical documentation, work instructions and reports. You will also have the ability to quickly learn and apply ServiceNow and ITIL Service Management processes, particularly in request, CMDB and asset management, along with experience delivering small to medium-scale projects, coordinating multiple priorities, engaging with customers, and working within agreed timeframes and accountabilities. Knowledge of asset management, procurement and records management policies and practices will also be highly regarded.

Why work for us:

  • Career training and development
  • Competitive salaries
  • Generous leave entitlements, including leave loading
  • Employee wellbeing programs

Our commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion

At Queensland Health, our work environment is inclusive and supportive, and we value our employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all cultures, abilities and backgrounds.

Our commitment to cultural safety, equity, diversity and inclusion means we understand some people may need changes to the recruitment process. If you need support during the recruitment process, such as meeting with the panel virtually instead of in person, please reach out to the hiring manager. We value diverse candidates and your need for adjustments will not affect our hiring decisions.

Ready to apply?

For further information on how to apply please review the attached Role Description.

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values - Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

Within GTO, Group Architecture and Digital Technologies (GADT) is responsible for end-to-end enterprise architecture as well as the design, delivery and maintenance of our digital banking platforms across Retail banking (TMRW) and Wholesale banking (Infinity).

Who we're looking for
UOB is embarking on the next phase of its digital banking transformation, with a strong focus on modernisation, scale, resilience, security and customer experience across the Group. We are seeking an experienced and visionary technology leader to join us as Executive Director, Head Digital Delivery, a senior leadership role with end-to-end accountability for digital banking platforms across Retail and Wholesale Banking.

Reporting to the Head of Group Architecture & Digital Technology (GADT), you will lead the end-to-end technology strategy, delivery and operations across our Digital Banking platforms spanning both Retail and Wholesale banking - while scaling and optimizing a global delivery organization (≥500 engineers) across on-shore and off-shore locations. You'll be responsible for owning delivery outcomes, production reliability, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement to accelerate business growth and customer experience across ASEAN markets and China.

What you'll do
Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the technology strategy for digital banking across Retail and Wholesale as part of a broad modernisation program. Shape multi-year roadmaps balancing innovation, stability, security, scalability and cost efficiency. Drive platform convergence and reuse while enabling domain-specific capabilities that enhance customer experiences.

Budget, Vendor & Portfolio Management

Oversee program/portfolio planning, dependency management, and release governance across channels. Own prioritization, estimation frameworks, capacity planning, and delivery outcomes across the digital banking portfolio. Ensure transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and benefits realization. Manage strategic vendor relationships, contingent workforce, and offshore delivery centers.

Delivery and Engineering Oversight

Optimize delivery processes across the SDLC by adopting AI-driven tooling, best practices, estimation models, and harmonizing Scaled Agile (SAFe) and Waterfall approaches. Own delivery of digital banking platforms across mobile, web, engagement systems, workflow platforms, APIs, and integration layers. Enforce modern engineering practices (Agile, Microservices, Containerization, DevSecOps, CI/CD, SRE) to ensure high availability, resilience, and performance.

Digital Architecture, Platforms, and Modernisation

Set architectural direction in partnership with Enterprise Architecture. Lead modernization initiatives including cloud-native adoption, real-time event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, microservices, containers, and API integration. Champion shared platforms and common services to accelerate delivery and reduce complexity.

Stakeholder Management

Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior leaders across Technology & Operations, Retail, Wholesale, and Group functions. Provide input on product launches, technical feasibility, delivery roadmaps, partnerships, and market expansion. Influence at executive level with a focus on business outcomes and customer impact.

Team Leadership

Recruit, develop, and retain top talent. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement across Retail and Wholesale digital teams, engineering chapters, tribe leads. Drive capability development, role clarity, and career pathways.

Risk, Security & Regulatory Excellence

Ensure compliance with MAS and global regulatory standards for resilience, data protection, and auditability. Embed security-by-design and privacy-by-design principles. Collaborate with Technology Risk, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, and Compliance teams to proactively manage risks.

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you'll need to succeed

  • Proven track record (15+ years) in digital delivery leadership within large financial institutions or technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated success building and running delivery at scale (circa 500 engineers) across on-shore/off-shore and multiple geographies, preferably across ASEAN and China
  • Strong understanding of Retail and Wholesale Banking processes, digital platforms, and emerging technologies to meet customer/user expectations and the customer journey.
  • Strong practical command of delivery methodologies - program management, estimation, Disciplined Agile, SAFe, and Waterfall; ability to tailor models to business/regulatory needs.
  • Track record uplifting modern engineering standards (architecture, DevOps, test automation, performance, security) and maturing SRE/observability. This may include API platforms, event streaming, microservices, container orchestration, automated QA, performance engineering.
  • Hands-on production support leadership with measurable outcomes (stability, MTTR, release reliability) and a bias for continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the executive presence to negotiate and influence stakeholders in complex matrix organisations, driving consensus amongst differing viewpoints and objectives.
  • Talent magnet and coach of leaders; proven ability to scale leaders of leaders.
Additional Requirements

title: Video Producer
description:
About Basis

Basis builds real agents that do real work in the real economy. Our agents operate for hours at a time, performing end-to-end work for some of the largest accounting firms in the world.

We recently raised $100M at >$1B valuation and are racing to deploy the most advanced applied ML at production scale.

Our investors include: Khosla Ventures (Keith Rabois & Vinod Khosla), Accel (Miles Clements), Google Ventures, Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross, Adam D'Angelo, Jeff Dean, Jack Altman, Noam Brown, Kyle Vogt, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue and many other operators/technical leaders.

"Basis is on the frontier of building production-grade, long-horizon agents. They've pushed the limits of what we thought our models could do on real-world, economically valuable, complex accounting tasks. They've been a great collaborator in helping us shape what the future of agents looks like." — Prashant Mital, Applied AI Lead, OpenAI

What you'll be doing

Accounting is a relationship-driven industry, and the most convincing thing we can put in front of a CFO or a firm partner is another one telling their own story. Video is how we do that at scale. It's also how we show what our agents actually do, in a category where most people have to see it to believe it. Basis is early in video, which means the person in this seat defines what we make and how we make it.

You'll own video end to end. That includes our in-office studio and the podcast we produce there, customer testimonials shot on location, conference and event content, recruiting and brand films, and the product and launch video that supports every campaign. It also includes the platform-native cuts that come out of all of it.

This role is built for someone who wants the whole range. You'll be as comfortable scoping a shoot, building the shot list, and running the camera as you are in the timeline afterward. Pre-production is yours, and it's the part that most determines whether a shoot is good or just expensive. You'll own our agency and freelance relationships outright, from scoping and budgets through on-set direction and final quality control. You'll be our lead editor, cutting some projects entirely yourself and directing external editors on others.

As we scale, you'll build the playbook that makes all of it repeatable: the formats worth investing in, the studio workflow, the partners we call for which kind of work, and the pipeline that turns one production day into a month of content.

What you'll bring

End-to-end range. Real depth across pre-production, production, and post, with a portfolio that shows both footage you shot and cuts you made.

On-set craft. Command of camera, lighting, and audio, including the ability to light and run a multi-camera interview on your own and get clean sound every time.

Directing instinct. A knack for making people who aren't professional talent sound like themselves on camera.

Pre-production discipline. The habit of solving problems on paper before the crew shows up.

Editorial judgment. The taste to set the bar on a cut and the clarity to give notes that raise someone else's work to it.

Partner management. A track record scoping, briefing, budgeting, and directing agencies and freelancers.

AI in the workflow. Eagerness to use AI across scripting, transcript-driven assembly, and generative assets to make the function faster.

0-1 mindset. Comfort building the video function and its processes from scratch.

Other non-negotiables:

  • 4-7 years producing and editing video, ideally on an in-house brand or creative team or at a production company serving brand clients

  • Command of Premiere or Resolve, plus enough After Effects or equivalent to handle light motion work

  • A reel that demonstrates both shooting and editing

  • In person 5 days a week in our Flatiron office (when not traveling)

What we'd love to see

Studio and podcast production: A room, a rig, or a show you stood up and ran on a reliable schedule.

Customer storytelling: Testimonial or case study video, especially shot on location at a customer's office.

Event capture: Conference or live event production, including turning a few days of footage into a full content slate.

Motion design: Design and animation chops that let you raise the quality bar without outsourcing it.

B2B range: Work for a business audience that people actually chose to watch.

Accounting industry fluency: Familiarity with the accounting profession and genuine curiosity about the people we're putting on camera.

What Success Looks Like

Customer proof on demand: Testimonial video is ready when a conference, launch, or campaign needs it.

A studio that runs: The podcast ships on schedule, and production quality is a reason people watch rather than something they overlook.

Partner leverage: Our agencies produce stronger work for us than for anyone else because the pre-production and direction are that tight.

Compounding output: Every production day yields a hero piece plus the platform-native cuts, planned in advance.

Operational scale: A documented video playbook is in place that lets the team 10x output without 10x effort.

Brand authority: Basis becomes synonymous with the future of AI in accounting through consistently high-quality video that people share on their own.

Benefits at Basis

We offer a competitive and thoughtful benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being:

  • Health & Wellness: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; Life Insurance; and 6 coaching & 6 therapy sessions through Spring Health.

    • Basis will cover 100% of your Wellhub Gold membership.

    • Wellhub gives you access to gyms like Lifetime, SoulCycle, NYSC and so many more - as well as access to wellness apps like Strava & Headspace!

  • Time off: Unlimited PTO + 12 paid company holidays.

  • In-Office Perks: Daily meal stipends, a fully stocked kitchen, and $300 toward your custom desk setup.

  • Financial Benefits: Pre-tax commuter benefits and 401(k) retirement plan

  • Team Culture: Monthly office activities and frequent optional team happy hours.

  • Parental Leave

title: Manufacturing Technician
description:
The Manufacturing Technician is responsible for operating and monitoring plastic machining equipment to produce high-quality components in accordance with engineering drawings, work instructions, and production schedules. The role ensures product quality, machine efficiency, safety compliance, and accurate production reporting while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Set up, start, operate, stop, and adjust plastic machining equipment according to approved work instructions, engineering drawings, and production requirements.
  • Monitor machine performance and make routine adjustments to maintain product quality and production efficiency.
  • Load raw materials and unload finished parts while ensuring proper handling and traceability.
  • Perform tooling or fixture changes as required and verify machine readiness before production.
  • Inspect machined plastic components using measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other inspection equipment.
  • Verify product dimensions and visual appearance against engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Identify non-conforming products and report quality issues promptly to the supervisor or Quality team.
  • Support first-piece, in-process, and final inspections to ensure compliance with customer and company requirements.
  • Perform routine cleaning and basic preventive maintenance on machines and workstations.
  • Report equipment malfunctions, abnormal machine conditions, or tooling issues to the supervisor or maintenance team.
  • Maintain good housekeeping practices in accordance with 5S standards.
  • Comply with all company safety, health, environmental, and PPE requirements.
  • Follow standard operating procedures and work instructions at all times.
  • Record production output, downtime, material consumption, scrap, and rework accurately in production logs or manufacturing systems.
  • Report machine breakdowns, quality concerns, and production variances to the Production Supervisor.
  • Ensure production documentation is completed accurately and on time.

Requirements:

  • Minimum SPM, SKM, Certificate, or equivalent technical qualification.
  • Technical certification in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Machining, or a related discipline is an advantage.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience operating plastic machining or CNC machining equipment in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in plastic fabrication, machining, or precision manufacturing is preferred.
  • Fresh graduates with relevant technical training may be considered.
  • Basic knowledge of plastic machining processes and manufacturing operations.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and work instructions.
  • Familiarity with measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Basic understanding of machine operation, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.
  • Good attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Basic computer literacy for production reporting.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Jr. Data Engineer
description:
Company Description

PT. Indonesia Indicator is a strategic intelligence company that focus on Big Data and AI. We provide intelligence insight and forecasting using Osint (Open Source Intelligence) Dataint (Data Intelligence) and Humint (Human Intelligence) to make a better decisions.

We are looking for Jr. Data Engineer position for working onsite at Bintaro, South Tangerang.

Role Description

As a Jr. Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining reliable data pipelines that support analytics and AI-driven applications. You will prepare and deliver high-quality structured and unstructured data for model training, inference, forecasting, and strategic intelligence. You will work closely with product, analyst, and AI/ML teams to ensure data accessibility, scalability, governance, and quality across systems.

  • Familiarity with message queue systems and asynchronous processing.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux commands and Docker containerization.
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and basic unit testing in data pipelines.
  • Comfortable with HTTP protocols and using CLI tools for debugging.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with preparing or integrating data for AI applications; knowledge of LLMs or AI APIs is a plus.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.

  • Mají 18 let a více.
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2
  • Mají možnost pracovat na odpoledních směnách (max do 21:30) a o víkendu.

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • Možnost kombinace práce a osobního života (flexibilita směn).
  • Občerstvení na pracovišti.
  • Šance být součástí unikátní H&M společnosti a její kultury.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na DPP (300 hodin ročně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 02.10.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: H&M - Junior Fashion Designer - Regional Assortment
description:
Are you a creatively driven Junior Designer with a strong fashion instinct, a sharp commercial eye, and a passion for creating collections that truly connect with the customer?

We’re looking for an emerging design talent to join our Regional Assortment team at our Stockholm Head Office. In this role, you’ll help shape globally relevant collections through a distinctly local lens, with a particular focus on the US market. You’ll translate the global brand vision into fashion-forward, culturally relevant design—bringing fresh ideas to life with both creativity and commercial impact.

As a Junior Designer within Regional Relevance, you’ll work closely with Senior Designers to create curated, market-specific collections that feel authentic to the customer while staying true to the overarching brand direction. You’ll play an active role in shaping a modern, relevant assortment that strikes the balance between fashion, individuality, and wearability across diverse markets.

You’ll be part of a highly collaborative, cross-functional team, working closely with Product Managers, Pattern Makers, Print Designers, Planners, Buyers, Product Developers, and Business Controllers. Together, you’ll bring ideas from concept to collection, gaining hands-on experience across the full design journey.

From sketching and developing collection overviews to supporting technical packs and contributing to concept development, you’ll have the opportunity to make your mark at every stage of the process.

If you’re curious, commercially minded, and excited by the challenge of translating global fashion into something that feels fresh, relevant, and unmistakably right for the market, we’d love to hear from you.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

  • A BA degree in Textile/Fashion Design
  • At least 1 year’s work experience as a Junior Designer
  • Passion and understanding of our H&M customer
  • Strong skills in Adobe Suite programs
  • Experience in 3D CLO is a plus
  • Attention to detail and fabric knowledge
  • A creative and visionary mindset for fashion
  • Strong communication skills and flexibility
  • Ability to prioritize with an organized approach
  • Enjoy working in diverse teams and contributing your perspective
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Strong self-drive and initiative
  • English fluency (Swedish is not necessary)

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

If you would like to be considered for our Open Application, please apply by sending in your CV and portfolio pdf (max 10mb/upload). All documents should be in English.

​Please note: For any internal applications you must speak to your current Manager first before applying.

The journey starts here

title: HV Battery Integration Engineer II
description:

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

We are currently seeking a Vehicle Integration Engineer II, HV System, as part of product engineering organization in the plant. The candidate will work with multi-disciplinary teams to drive product/specification related investigations to resolution for the products in production. Our ideal candidate exhibits a can-do attitude and approaches their work with vigor and determination. Candidate will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, to possess the ability to learn quickly and to strive for impactful results in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for vehicle/system level troubleshooting using standard communication/diagnostic tools (Canalyzer/Canape, etc.)
  • Solve complex component/system level problems using standard problem-solving techniques
  • Data driven proactive problem solving & issue avoidance due to process deviations or critical part quality issues
  • Provide design for manufacturability & serviceability feedback in future product development processes
  • Responsible for design intent assembly requirements of HV System, on the assembly line
  • Advice on build process development and possible improvements to ensure design intent is not compromised

Skills

  • Product problem-solving skills using industry-standard techniques.
  • Data analysis skills using statistical tools such as Minitab or JMP, and programming/tools such as Python or MATLAB.
  • Prototype build or launch event participation preferred.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes related to HV system marriage to the vehicle and associated variables of interest.
  • Knowledge of instrumentation, including data collection, hardware selection, electrical/electronic signal processing, and communication hardware is a plus.
  • Experience with automotive-grade adhesives, plastics, cooling systems, and metal components.
  • Experience using DFMEA, PFMEA, DVP&R, DFM, and RCA with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills using Atlassian products.
  • Proficiency in CATIA or 3DX, stack-up analysis (2D and 3D), and GD&T.
  • Collegiate FSAE, BAJA, or similar experience preferred.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: BS in Electrical, Mechanical, or Automotive Engineering; or MS in Electrical, Mechanical, or Automotive Engineering.
  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in electric vehicles or other high-voltage systems with a BS degree; or 2+ years of automotive experience in design and release of vehicle attributes with an MS degree.
  • Experience using vehicle and system-level communication or diagnostic tools for troubleshooting complex multi-variable issues.
  • Experience working with HV systems within BEVs.
  • Knowledge of HV Battery Packs, HV Harnesses, onboard charging units, and associated troubleshooting at the system and product level.
  • Experience with various types of end-of-line tests and setting robust pass/fail criteria.

title: Analytics Engineer, Risk
description:
About Us:

Propel (TSX: PRL) is the fintech company building a new world of financial opportunity by facilitating access to credit for consumers underserved by traditional financial institutions. Through its AI-driven platform, Propel evaluates customers in a more comprehensive way than traditional credit scores can. Our revolutionary fintech platform has already helped consumers access over one million loans and lines of credit and over one billion dollars in credit.

To build a new world of opportunity we bring together the brightest talent to help us build opportunities. We are entrepreneurs and believe in measuring success through results and growing within; talent and hard work never goes unnoticed. At Propel, we are here to change the way employees, customers and shareholders succeed together.

We are a team of passionate entrepreneurs, who foster curiosity and growth in our employees. Our culture is why we have been so successful and why our employees choose Propel to build their careers. It is also why we are one of North America’s fastest growing companies and a Best Place to Work.

Join us as we change the way employees, customers and shareholders succeed together.

About You:

You thrive in a vibrant, entrepreneurial organization where your ideas are valued. You are motivated by goals, a self-starter, and enjoy wearing multiple hats in a fast-growing fintech environment.

You are a builder at heart—someone who prefers creating reliable data pipelines over another dashboard. You thrive on owning the “plumbing” that delivers clean, timely data to machine learning models and enjoy turning manual, messy processes into repeatable automation. As the Analytics Engineer, Risk, you’ll join the Model Development team within Risk, working closely with the Manager, Model Development, Data Scientists, and Model Developers. This highly technical, hands‑on role focuses on the data infrastructure supporting credit risk models, including ETL pipelines for model training and scoring, standardized ingestion of new data sources—including UK data—and day‑to‑day delivery of stable production data. You’ll work primarily in Python and SQL with tabular, time‑series, and, as we grow, graph-structured data such as Neo4j.

Responsibilities

  • Own the integration of new data sources, into Propel’s model-ready data standards, ensuring consistent schemas, definitions, and quality across regions (CA/US/UK)
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL pipelines that prepare and deliver data for model training, retraining, and scoring across multiple model types, including survival, classification, and regression models
  • Build and maintain pipelines within the shared ETL/orchestration framework for model development, following the templates and patterns established by the Model Development team so new models can be onboarded quickly
  • Build feature engineering and data transformation logic for tabular and time-series data, using tools such as tsfresh or similar
  • Monitor the health and stability of data pipelines feeding models in production; proactively identify and resolve data drift, quality issues, and pipeline failures
  • Write clean, well-tested, production-grade Python code, including scripts and reusable packages or modules, that other team members can build on
  • Work with containerized model deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, as well as cloud infrastructure such as AWS and S3 for data storage and workflow orchestration, with support from our Infrastructure team
  • Query and transform data from relational databases and data warehouses using SQL.
  • Document data sources, pipeline logic, and transformations clearly so pipelines are auditable, maintainable, and easy to hand off
  • Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Model Developers to translate model requirements into scalable, production-ready data pipelines, and with the Business Analytics Engineering and Infrastructure teams where pipelines intersect with broader data platform work

Requirements

Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands‑on Python skills and comfortable writing production-quality, testable, reusable code
  • Familiarity with common data and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit‑learn
  • Experience building or maintaining ETL or data pipelines
  • Experience with pipeline or workflow orchestration tools such as Metaflow, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar is a plus
  • Comfortable working with different data shapes: tabular and time‑series data
  • Solid SQL skills for querying and transforming data into relational databases such as MySQL and/or data warehouses
  • Understanding of the ML data lifecycle, including feature engineering, training and scoring data preparation, and model monitoring and drift concepts
  • Experience with version control using Git and basic CI/CD practices
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with Data Scientists, Model Developers, and Infrastructure/Engineering stakeholders
  • Experience in fintech, credit risk, or another regulated or data‑intensive industry is a plus
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to accelerate day‑to‑day engineering work is an asset

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to graph data or graph databases such as Neo4j (nice‑to‑have)
  • Snowflake experience (nice‑to‑have)
  • Exposure to Docker, containerization, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS, S3, EKS, or similar services (nice‑to‑have)

Benefits to Joining Propel

  • Growth and opportunity – we pride ourselves on promoting from within
  • Incredible company culture
  • Competitive salary and health benefits
  • Comprehensive vacation package
  • Group health and dental benefits
  • Group RRSP program
  • Support for new parents
  • Diverse and inclusive workplace

Salary Range

$80,000 - $110,000

Final compensation is determined by market conditions, location, and the candidate’s experience, skills, and education. This role may also be eligible for performance‑based incentive programs and total compensation may include variable incentives, such as bonuses and commissions.

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Our Culture

Propel brings together the brightest talent to build opportunities. We are entrepreneurs who measure success through results and growth from within; talent and hard work never go unnoticed. Our team fosters curiosity and growth, making Propel one of North America’s fastest‑growing companies and a Best Place to Work.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Propel welcomes and encourages applications from all groups, including Indigenous peoples, women, visible minorities, persons with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and those with intersectional identities. Should you require accommodation throughout any stage of the recruitment and selection process, please specify your requirements when submitting your application and we will work with your needs.

AI Disclosure

We use AI to assist in reviewing applications and assessing candidates. These tools support our recruitment team, however, all hiring decisions are made by ourtrained hiring managers and recruitment professionals, not AI.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Build the infrastructure powering the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, the infrastructure behind our technology needs to scale with us.

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take ownership of the cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices powering our BIM Platform, working across Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, security and developer tooling.

The Role

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad ownership across our cloud and platform infrastructure.

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Data and Security teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure while improving how our developers deploy, monitor and troubleshoot their services.

We want DevOps to be an enabler rather than a gatekeeper. That means building the tooling, automation and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to move quickly and safely without creating unnecessary dependencies on DevOps.

You’ll have the autonomy to identify where our infrastructure and engineering practices can improve and take ownership of making those improvements happen.

The role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis, with 3 days per week in the office.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, maintain and evolve our Microsoft Azure infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, ARM templates and Helm

  • Design and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling fast, safe and repeatable deployments

  • Build observability across our infrastructure and services through monitoring, logging, alerting and distributed tracing

  • Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through capacity planning, autoscaling and resource optimisation

  • Build and maintain disaster recovery, backup and failover strategies

  • Strengthen infrastructure security across areas including network policies, secrets management and platform hardening

  • Establish and improve incident response processes, on-call practices, runbooks and blameless post-mortems

  • Work with our Data team to support reliable and scalable PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments

  • Build self-service tooling, templates and documentation that reduce unnecessary reliance on DevOps

  • Support infrastructure for data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment as our technology continues to evolve

  • Partner directly with developers on deployment, troubleshooting and infrastructure best practices.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a strong, hands-on DevOps Engineer who is comfortable owning complex infrastructure and operating across a broad technical environment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Demonstrable in-depth experience in DevOps, Infrastructure or Cloud Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes, including cluster design, networking, storage, upgrades and troubleshooting

  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent

  • Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions

  • Strong experience with containers and Docker

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability within production environments

  • Good knowledge of infrastructure security, including network segmentation, encryption, secrets management and audit logging

  • Experience building automation and tooling using Python, Go, Bash or TypeScript

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience taking ownership of production infrastructure and incidents

  • The ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly explain infrastructure trade-offs.

Strong AWS or GCP experience could also be relevant where you can demonstrate the ability to transfer that knowledge into an Azure environment.

Experience with high-availability infrastructure, PostgreSQL or MongoDB, AI/ML infrastructure, ETL/data pipelines, FinOps or SOC 2/ISO 27001 environments would be a bonus.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys automating away problems rather than repeatedly solving them manually. You’ll be comfortable taking ownership, challenging processes that don’t scale and building the tools and practices that make the wider engineering team more effective.

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office

  • 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

  • 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

  • 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

  • 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

  • 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events

  • 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings

  • 💰 Employee referral scheme

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 🌍 Make a real-world impact revolutionising the construction industry

If you’re a Senior DevOps Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and building environments that enable engineering teams to move faster, we’d love to hear from you.

If you'd like to see the products and technology we have created so far on our journey you can view it in action through our YouTube and Website

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
