title: YCBA Museum Photographer
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Imaging and Intellectual Property, the Museum Photographer creates high-quality images of museum, library, and archive collections at the Yale Center for British Art (YCBA). The photographer also undertakes photo and video documentation of YCBA facilities, exhibitions, programs, and events for archival and promotional use.

The photographer works both independently and as a member of a team of department photographers and technicians to meet imaging objectives. The photographer fulfills routine work orders according to established procedures. The photographer also evaluates and carries out projects, consulting with staff to develop an understanding of aesthetic, technical, logistical, and scheduling requirements.

The photographer transports objects to and from studios independently or with the assistance of collections staff when appropriate. They verify object identification, handle objects on set, and practice safe lighting and support methods according to museum conservation protocols. They ensure security of objects from pickup or arrival in the studio until release.

The photographer captures, evaluates, and adjusts digital image files for quality and accuracy, including exposure, gray and color balance, sharpness, contrast, and density. They maintain color management standards and workflows, creating custom ICC color profiles for a variety of capture settings and regularly monitoring settings for software and hardware used to capture, edit, and view images. They undertake post-processing of digital image files, including verification of objects or subjects photographed; file naming; applying technical or administrative metadata; editing or versioning digital files manually or using actions/scripts, including rotation, straightening, cropping, and appending digital color bars; checking files against work orders; and verifying transfer of image files from capture workstation to servers. The photographer also assists staff and supervises students working on ancillary digitization projects.

This position works at multiple sites, including both the museum (located at 1080 Chapel Street) and West Campus. Standard work hours are M–F 8:30 am–5 pm; occasional evening and weekend hours may be substituted to meet operational needs.

To be considered, please submit an electronic portfolio at the time of application. This can be a web link listed on your resume or a separate PDF attachment. Cover letters are strongly encouraged.


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Excellent written/verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a team, meet deadlines, and adapt to change. Track record of diligent performance, reliability, accuracy, and attention to detail, supported by references.

2. Ability to document 2D and 3D collection objects using a variety of still and analytical photography techniques, including but not limited to visible light photography, reflected and transmitted infrared photography, and ultraviolet photography.

3. Demonstrated ability to meet established cultural heritage digitization guidelines in production. Ability to discern subtle variation in tone and color and to adjust digital images and print output to match target values and originals. Comprehensive understanding of digital image file parameters.

4. Demonstrated command of photographic equipment and systems, including medium-format digital, DSLR, and modified cameras; strobe and continuous lighting; filters; and diffusers. Ability to troubleshoot equipment, hardware, and software, and to solve routine as well as novel technical issues.

5. Excellent computer skills. Expert skill with industry-standard tools and systems to capture, edit and print digital images. Proficiency with MacOS; familiarity with Windows OS and Microsoft 365. Keeps current with technological developments and innovations in cultural heritage digitization.


Preferred Education and Experience

1. Experience using Hasselblad H series or PhaseOne camera systems, Flexcolor or Phocus capture software, and strobe lighting systems.

2. Experience with X-rite, Basiccolor or GoldenThread color management systems.

3. Coursework or experience in scientific, conservation, or computational photography.

4. Experience imaging museum, library, or archive collections.

5. Video experience.

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift 50 lb., push object carts, carry heavy items, reach high shelves, climb ladders, stand or sit for long periods of time, and tolerate frequent exposure to high-intensity flash and strobe lighting equipment.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Views subjects and settings and plans compositions, camera positions, and camera angles to produce desired effects. 2. Evaluates the technical requirements of complex projects. Determines the most appropriate techniques and methods as well as time needed to complete assignments or projects. (Assignments may require innovation to resolve problems that are not necessarily governed by established procedures.) 3. Selects and assembles equipment according to subject material, anticipated conditions, and knowledge of function of various types of cameras, lenses, films, and accessories. 4. Provides color management support; matches hues and tones of digital files to original objects. 5. Maintains and monitors condition of equipment and software used to capture, edit and view images. 6. May perform other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in a related field and two years of related work experience in the same job family; or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.

description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values - Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior GenAI Application Engineer who operates effectively at the intersection of software engineering, GenAI application development, enterprise integration and production delivery.

This is not a pure research role. It is not a prompt-engineering-only role. The successful candidate will help design, build and improve production-grade GenAI applications that are reliable, observable, maintainable and useful to real enterprise users.

The successful candidate will:

  • Build and improve GenAI applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar orchestration tools.
  • Work with open-weight models, hosted LLMs and model-serving patterns.
  • Develop agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and prompt orchestration.
  • Integrate GenAI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, data sources and operational platforms.
  • Engineer solutions for production quality, including logging, tracing, evaluation, fallback behaviour and troubleshooting.
  • Bring a strong can-do attitude, enthusiasm, curiosity and practical delivery mindset.
  • Finance or banking experience is not required. What matters more is hands-on experience building real GenAI applications, strong engineering judgement and the ability to deliver in a complex enterprise environment.
WHAT MATTERS MOST
  • Strong hands-on experience building production-grade GenAI applications.
  • Practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, agentic workflows, RAG and tool calling.
  • Understanding of open-weight models and how to integrate them into real applications.
  • Ability to challenge weak designs and propose better ones.
  • Strong engineering discipline around reliability, testing, observability and maintainability.
  • Ability to work across application, data, platform, security and infrastructure teams.
  • Enthusiastic, energetic and willing to get into the details.
  • Pragmatic approach to delivery, not over-engineering and not hype-driven.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Six or more years of software engineering experience, preferably with recent hands-on experience in GenAI application development.
  • Proven experience building production-grade GenAI applications, not only prototypes, experiments or demos.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Practical understanding of RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, prompt orchestration and context management.
  • Experience integrating LLMs into real applications using APIs, backend services and enterprise data sources.
  • Experience with open-weight models or strong interest backed by hands-on experimentation.
  • Strong backend engineering skills using Python, Java or similar languages.
  • Good understanding of API design, distributed systems and production resilience patterns.
  • Experience with observability, logging, tracing and troubleshooting for GenAI or backend applications.
  • Familiarity with containerised deployment environments such as Kubernetes or OpenShift.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable and testable code.
  • Strong analytical, debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • High ownership, high curiosity and genuine interest in building useful AI products.
  • Ability to work in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information and evolving requirements.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge weak designs and coordinate across business, application, data, infrastructure and security teams.
NICE TO HAVE
  • Experience with DeepAgent or similar agent frameworks.
  • Experience with Langfuse, Elastic or similar observability and search tools.
  • Experience with Redis for caching, conversation state, rate limiting, queue-backed workflows or low-latency GenAI application patterns.
  • Experience with vLLM or similar inference-serving frameworks for running open-weight models.
  • Experience deploying GenAI workloads on cloud or container platforms.
KEY DOMAIN/TECHNICAL SKILLS
  • Production GenAI Application Engineering
  • LangGraph, LangChain, RAG and Agentic Workflows
  • Python, Java, APIs and Enterprise Integration

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Back to jobs New Senior Frontend Developer Toronto, ON, Canada

Kensington delivers the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that’s tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure that they enjoy the authentic best of their destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime!

We achieve this because of our extraordinary people, passionate experts with deep knowledge of their destinations. They are what enables us to deliver remarkable experiences in over 120 countries worldwide, and across each of our businesses – Private Touring, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Expeditions, Ultraluxe Land, Private Jets, and Air.

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com .

We are hiring at two levels. We welcome applications from both Frontend Developers and Senior Frontend Developers. The level offered will be based on the depth of the candidate’s experience, technical expertise , scope of ownership, and ability to lead work independently.

This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON.

OUR ORGANIZATION

Kensington and TripArc, as part of the Range Group, deliver the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that is tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure they experience the authentic best of each destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime.

We achieve this through extraordinary people with deep destination expertise across more than 120 countries and across our Tours, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Jets, and Air brands.

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com.

To learn more about TripArc, visit triparc.com.

THE ROLE

Kensington and TripArc are expanding their development team to support projects and initiatives across kensingtontours.com, campaign landing pages, microsites, booking and enquiry flows, and related digital properties. You will work in a modern frontend stack that includes Next.js, React, Contentful, and Amplitude while helping complete a migration from a legacy Angular application and supporting a full brand redesign.

At either level, you will create performant, accessible, responsive experiences for high-traffic, revenue-generating pages and use measurement to understand whether what you ship is working. The scope of ownership will be aligned to your experience:

  • Frontend Developer: You will build and maintain features within established patterns, implement experiments and analytics tracking, contribute to Contentful integrations and the design system, and grow your capability in conversion, performance, and technical discoverability through coaching and code review.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: You will own frontend conversion, experimentation, performance, and technical discoverability as a practice. You will set standards, make architectural decisions, partner directly with senior marketing and digital stakeholders, mentor developers, and translate commercial goals into measurable, maintainable technical solutions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Build high-quality frontend experiences

  • Design, build, and maintain features in our modern frontend application using Next.js and React, including Contentful integrations.
  • Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into performant, accessible, responsive, mobile-first experiences and raise questions where requirements are unclear.
  • Build reusable components against our design system and contribute to the component library as we move into a full rebrand.
  • Configure or architect content models and CMS structures so marketing partners can build and update pages without developer support.
  • Maintain our legacy Angular application during migration and help retire it cleanly.
  • Write maintainable code, participate in code review, estimate work honestly, identify risks early, and document solutions for technical and non-technical partners.

Improve conversion and measurement

  • Implement and instrument experiment variants on high-value pages, including event tracking, funnel visibility, and analytics needed to assess results.
  • Partner with marketing and digital stakeholders to translate commercial hypotheses into testable changes with clear success criteria.
  • Use experiment results and analytics to report whether changes worked and identify where users drop out of key journeys.
  • For Senior candidates: own the experimentation practice, design tests, establish staged rollout and rollback guardrails, and ensure results are measured honestly.

Protect performance and discoverability

  • Build experiences that meet expectations for Core Web Vitals, accessibility, application security, crawlability, and search discoverability.
  • Use appropriate rendering strategies and frontend patterns based on content volatility, speed, performance, and crawlability.
  • Support technical SEO through semantic structure, structured data, internal linking, redirects, URL changes, and migration safety.
  • For Senior candidates: set and defend performance budgets, own production performance improvements, and build the technical foundations for SEO, AEO, and GEO.

Collaborate and lead at the appropriate level

  • Communicate clearly with engineering, design, content, SEO, marketing, and digital partners.
  • Bring forward options, trade-offs, risks, and evidence rather than presenting only one answer.
  • For Intermediate candidates: learn actively from code review and technical direction, ask questions early, and take increasing ownership of defined areas.
  • For Senior candidates: define frontend standards and architectural patterns, review code, mentor developers, and act as a senior technical voice with business stakeholders.

MUST-HAVE

For both levels

  • Professional experience building and supporting web applications in production environments with real user traffic.
  • Strong component-based development experience with React and hands-on experience with Next.js.
  • Solid frontend fundamentals, including component architecture, state management, routing, rendering lifecycle, and frontend performance.
  • Strong modern CSS skills and experience building responsive, mobile-first user interfaces.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub and working within a modern CI/CD pipeline.
  • Ability to translate designs into accessible, responsive, production-ready experiences and familiarity with Figma-based design handoffs.
  • Working knowledge of the web-platform fundamentals that affect commercial outcomes, including accessibility, SEO, Core Web Vitals, analytics, and application security.

For Frontend Developer

  • 3-5 years of professional web development experience building and supporting production web applications.
  • Solid React development experience with hands-on experience using Next.js.

For Senior Frontend Developer

  • 6+ years of professional frontend development experience, including significant work on high-traffic, revenue-generating websites or applications.
  • Deep expertise in React and Next.js, including component architecture, state management, routing, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Production experience with rendering strategies such as SSR, SSG, and ISR, and the ability to select the appropriate approach based on business and technical requirements.
  • Experience integrating headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful, including designing scalable content models and schemas.

NICE TO HAVE

  • A/B or multivariate testing tools such as Amplitude, Optimizely, VWO, or LaunchDarkly.
  • Analytics and tag implementation using Amplitude, GA4, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent tools.
  • Performance tooling such as Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, WebPageTest, and Chrome DevTools.
  • Technical SEO tooling such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or Botify.
  • Image and media optimization at scale, including modern formats, responsive delivery, CDN behaviour, and Cloudinary.
  • Personalization or content-variant delivery and an understanding of caching and indexing considerations.
  • Internationalization and H reflang for multi-region sites.
  • Angular 9+, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury, or high-content-volume e-commerce.

OUR TECH STACK

  • React, GraphQL, and Next.js for the modern application.
  • Angular, .NET Core, and C# for the legacy application.
  • Contentful and Cloudinary.
  • Amplitude for analytics and experimentation.
  • Azure DevOps.

COMPENSATION

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay-for-performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The expected compensation range for this position is:

  • Frontend Developer: $90,000 to $110,000 CAD.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: $110,000 to $125,000 CAD.

The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography, and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. #LI-Hybrid

We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.

The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by the hiring team. We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Shelter and WASH Team Leader Yemen Hodeidah (National)
description:
The WASH/Shelter Team Leader is responsible for leading the qualitative implementation of NRC’s Shelter and WASH programme in targeted displacement sites. The role provides advanced technical guidance on WASH/Shelter programming and ensures effective planning, management, and supervision of the team, in line with NRC’s operational and technical priorities. At the field level, the Team Leader oversees and monitors Shelter and WASH activities, ensuring that services are delivered efficiently, humanitarian standards are upheld, and NRC’s accountability and protection principles are consistently applied. As technical lead, the Team Leader plays a pivotal role in shaping programme direction, bridging community needs with organizational and donor requirements, and reinforcing NRC’s responsiveness, programme quality, and coordination across displacement sites in northern Yemen.

Generic Responsibilities:

  • Supervise and implement WASH/Shelter projects according to strategy, proposals and plans
  • Ensure adherence to NRC policies and donor requirements
  • Develop annual activity and work plans
  • Supervision, training and development of project staff
  • Promote and share ideas for improvement and necessary changes in the activities
  • Cooperate with relevant partners and local authorities
  • Organize trainings for the team, relevant partners and beneficiaries
  • Monthly activity/project reports and other reporting as required
  • Ensure proper filing of all project documents

Specific responsibilities:

  • Lead, plan, organize and carry out daily WASH/Shelter activities within NRC area of interventions in line with agreed work plans, strategies and methodologies.
  • Implement effectively and within time and budget WASH/Shelter program as per the project proposals and project requirements.
  • Develop and review project designs to ensure compliance with relevant standards, procedures, and codes.
  • Manage the daily field operation of WASH/Shelter projects including CCCM
  • Assist the WASH/Shelter coordinator in tracking indicators in order to take remedial measures early.
  • Maintain regular budget control, ensuring spending within available unit cost and budget lines.
  • Represent NRC in the WASH/Shelter sub-Clusters and in other coordination forums
  • Monitor and document the implementation of project activities done by implementing partners and/or contractors (plan of action activities, contracts, financial expenditures and project documentation).
  • Leading WASH/Shelter activities in data collections, and data quality on bassline/PDMs and end line of WASH projects and draft the initial report.

  • Supervise all construction work related to WASH/Shelter and take lead on technical verification of work provided by contractors.

  • University degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related engineering field

  • Documented results related to programme responsibilities

  • Proven leadership skills and clear knowledge of own leadership profile

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal

title: Site Surveyor Glasvezel
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

Als Site Surveyor Glasvezel lever je een essentiële bijdrage aan projecten voor de aanleg van glasvezel op de zakelijke markt. Je weet hoe en waar telecomkabels het beste in de grond gelegd kunnen worden. Op basis daarvan stel je een schouwrapport op dat de basis vormt voor de uitrol van een project. Je werkt samen met een team van specialisten, overlegt met overheidsinstanties en komt tot een plan dat technisch en financieel uitvoerbaar is.

Deze werkgever is een netwerk- en telecominfrabedrijf in Harderwijk. De organisatie ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt vaste en draadloze netwerken voor telecomaanbieders in heel Nederland. Je werkt in een team van vakmensen met korte lijnen en een nuchtere aanpak.

Jij werkt nauwkeurig, hebt een goed oplossend vermogen en brengt informatie helder over. Je maakt je nieuwe technologieën snel eigen, zoals het digitaal inmeten van een tracé, en denkt graag mee over hoe het werk beter en efficiënter kan. Daarnaast heb jij:

  • ervaring in de telecom, bij voorkeur met de aanleg en mutatie van ondergrondse netwerken;

  • ervaring met het lezen van tekeningen en KLIC-informatie;

  • een VCA-certificaat en rijbewijs B;

  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega's. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

description:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Mimir Query, Databases | Canada | Remote Canada (Remote)
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the USA time zones.

What is Grafana Cloud?

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

Mimir Squad

The Mimir squad has 3 sub-squads, Ingest, Storage, and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project , and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across 3 major cloud providers. Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly.

A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They are likely engaged in a larger project with another engineer, and they are also incorporating some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on-call rotation for their systems.

What will you be doing:

  • Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives
  • Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.
  • Drive projects from initial idea all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers
  • Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope
  • Design, build, operate, and maintain critical systems, owning the reliability, performance, and availability
  • Be a part of your team’s follow-the-sun on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running
  • Support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team
  • Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action. You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs. You have good time management skills, which you leverage to work on the right things at the right time.

  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively
  • Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a squad. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication and time management skills are a must.
  • Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar then that translates well
  • Experience with leading and delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven and collaborative way
  • Experience with developing software that runs in the Cloud or experience with systems engineering
  • Experience with being on-call and following the DevOps model
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Familiarity with observability systems, know when to use metrics, logs, traces, to debug a problem.
  • Comfortable with microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience and comfort developing with LLMs like Claude and Codex on your day to day

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience working with queue systems, e.g. the Kafka protocol
  • Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)
  • Familiarity with the concept of infrastructure as code

Compensation & Rewards:

In Canada, the Base compensation range for this role is CAD 186,368 - CAD 223,642 . Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here . Compensation ranges are country-specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

title: VP (AI) - United Overseas Bank

Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. title: Mid-Weight Product Designer
description:
Title: Mid-Weight Product Designer

Location – Hybrid, or Remote in UK

About PetlabCo
PetLabCo.® is the world leader in DTC pet supplements, with nine-figure revenue and ambitious plans for continued global expansion. We make science-backed supplements, health care and treats that millions of dog owners love, powered by a performance marketing engine spending at serious scale across paid social and beyond. Behind that engine we're building a brand that dog owners recognise and trust, which is what turns a strong first purchase into a long relationship. Our team is vibrant, fast moving and customer obsessed. High performers are valued here and they're rewarded, which makes this the ideal place for an ambitious, hardworking animal lover who wants to move their career forward quickly.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Mid-Weight UX/UI Designer to join our growing Design team and help us create digital experiences that don’t just look great – they perform. You’ll work across multiple areas of the PetLab Co. customer journey, from our organic e-commerce site and customer account portal through to cold acquisition funnels and landing pages.

You’ll join a highly collaborative design environment, working closely with two Senior Product Designers, our Lead Digital Designer, two Mid-Weight Creative Designers and our Design & UX Director. Rather than being restricted to one product or area, you’ll support the team wherever the biggest design opportunities and commercial priorities are.

A key measure of success will be conversion. We’re looking for someone who understands that great DTC design needs to balance customer needs, brand, usability and commercial performance. You should have a keen eye for what converts, be curious about why customers behave the way they do, and be comfortable using data and experimentation to improve your work.

No two weeks will necessarily look the same. One week you might be improving the UX of our organic e-commerce experience, the next designing a cold acquisition funnel, and the next helping evolve our account portal or supporting a high-priority commercial initiative.

So, if you…

  • Love designing polished, intuitive digital experiences that drive measurable results
  • Understand the nuances of designing for DTC and e-commerce customers
  • Think about conversion and customer behaviour, not just aesthetics
  • Enjoy moving between different products, journeys and commercial challenges
  • Can take a problem from initial thinking and wireframes through to high-quality UI
  • Enjoy collaborating with other designers while being comfortable owning your own work
  • Have a positive, can-do attitude and aren’t afraid to roll your sleeves up when something needs to get done
  • Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities and challenges can change

…then please keep reading, as you may be the perfect fit.

Who Will You Report Into?
You’ll sit within our Design team and work closely with our Design & UX Director, alongside our Lead Digital Designer, Senior Product Designers and Creative Designers. We’re building a design function that can support PetLab Co. across the entire digital customer experience. As the business continues to grow, so does the number and variety of customer journeys we need to create, optimise and improve.

That’s where you come in.

We need another strong pair of hands who can move comfortably between different areas of the customer experience and help the wider team tackle the opportunities with the greatest potential impact.

You’ll have experienced designers around you to collaborate with, challenge ideas and learn from, but you’ll also be expected to take ownership. We want someone who can receive a brief or problem, understand the customer and commercial objective behind it, explore solutions and turn those into thoughtful, high-quality experiences.

We care deeply about craft, but we’re equally interested in what the work achieves. You’ll work with your manager and the wider team to understand performance, learn from experiments and continuously improve our digital experiences.
Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who wants to become a better designer while helping us build experiences that make PetLab Co. a better-performing business.

What’s the Ideal Candidate’s Background?

You’re a mid-weight UX/UI or Product Designer with solid experience within a direct-to-consumer brand or similarly fast-moving e-commerce business. You understand how customers shop online and how changes to hierarchy, messaging and interactions can reduce friction and improve conversion.

You have strong visual and UI fundamentals and can take an experience from journey mapping, wireframes and prototypes through to polished interfaces, considering different user states along the way. You’re commercially curious, too. You want to understand what happens after launch, using customer behaviour, conversion data and experiment results to inform your next iteration.

You’re comfortable with shifting priorities and a varied remit. As the business grows, you’ll be willing to apply your skills where they can make the greatest difference.

Requirements

  • DTC / E-commerce Experience – You have hands-on experience designing digital experiences for a direct-to-consumer brand, e-commerce business or similarly conversion-focused environment.
  • Mid-Weight UX/UI Experience – You’ve developed enough experience to independently take on design problems while still enjoying collaboration, feedback and learning from senior designers.
  • Conversion Mindset – You understand that conversion is a critical measure of digital design performance and have experience designing or optimising customer journeys with commercial outcomes in mind.
  • Strong UX Fundamentals – You can translate problems into journeys, flows, wireframes and prototypes before moving into execution.
  • Strong UI Craft – You have a keen eye for hierarchy, typography, spacing, layout and interaction and can create polished experiences across desktop and mobile.
  • Figma Proficiency – You’re highly comfortable designing and collaborating in Figma and understand components, libraries and scalable design systems.
  • Data Curious – You’re comfortable looking beyond the design file to understand how customers behave and whether your work is performing.
  • Commercially Minded – You understand that great customer experience and commercial performance aren’t opposing goals and actively look for solutions that deliver both.
  • Collaborative – You enjoy working with other designers and cross-functional partners and can clearly explain the thinking behind your decisions.
  • Think Fast, Move Fast – You’re energised by a high-velocity environment where priorities can change and there is always another interesting problem around the corner.
  • Can-Do Attitude – You’re positive, pragmatic and happy to roll your sleeves up. When something needs doing, you focus on how we can make it happen.
  • Driven to Excellence – You care deeply about the quality of your work while understanding when speed, iteration and learning are more valuable than chasing perfection.
  • Organised & Dependable – You can manage multiple workstreams and priorities without losing sight of the details.

Benefits

  • Private Health Care through Vitality
  • Generous Annual Leave - 28 days + public and bank holidays
  • Help@Hand – Employee Assistance Programme
  • Royal London Pension Scheme – We offer a workplace pension scheme with one of the UK’s leading providers of group pensions. With an employer contribution of 5%!
  • Enhanced Maternity / Paternity / Adoption Leave – because time with new family members is important!
  • Nursery Salary Sacrifice Scheme
  • Generous Learning and development budget – We always want you to keep learning.
  • Puppy Therapy – working in partnership with Paws in Work to provide a boost of oxytocin once a year.
  • Free breakfast, fruits and snacks – refuel and revitalise with free munchies in the office.
  • Working Environment – dogs are welcome!
  • Life Assurance – In the event of your death, while employed by us, your chosen beneficiaries will be provided with a tax-free lump sum equivalent of four times your basic salary.
  • Discount Vouchers & Gym Memberships – get discounts at a whole range of retailers and gym memberships through our provider, WellHub.
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme – Employees sacrifice salary in return for a new electric car, typically saving 30-40% of costs through income and tax and national insurance.
  • Give Back Day – An extra day off in the year to volunteer plus a £50 contribution to your chosen charity.

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

PetLabCo. is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage all applications irrespective of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, nationality, marital status, and disability. We believe that diversity is at the heart of innovation, and we welcome passionate candidates from all backgrounds. Come join the family and see for yourself!

Jako Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży będziesz osobą, która tworzy pierwsze wrażenie i buduje atmosferę w sklepie, witając naszych klientów i uosabiając filozofię naszej marki. Twoim zadaniem będzie zapewnienie wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty w sklepie: od rozpoczęcia rozmowy, przez pomoc w przymierzalni,odegrasz kluczową rolę w tworzeniu wyjątkowych doświadczeń zakupowych. Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również obsługę dostaw, uzupełnianie brakujących elementów kolekcji i ekspozycję najnowszych produktów na sali sprzedaży.

Będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za tworzenie atmosfery, w której klienci czują się swobodnie i zainspirowani. Dzięki Twojemu entuzjazmowi i autentycznemu podejściu pomożesz im znaleźć to, czego szukają – a czasem nawet coś, o czym jeszcze nie wiedzieli, że pokochają. Wspólnie z zespołem zadbasz o to, by każda wizyta była wyjątkowym doświadczeniem.

Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i znajomość materiałów są mile widziane, ale nie są wymagane.

  • Zorientowanie na klienta: lubisz kontakt z ludźmi i jesteś zaangażowany /-a w zapewnianie doskonałej obsługi
  • Elastyczność i zdolność adaptacji: potrafisz reagować na zmieniające się priorytety i potrzeby
  • Zorientowanie na działanie: jesteś proaktywny/-a i zmotywowany/-a do podejmowania inicjatywy i realizowania zadań z najlepszym efektem
  • Doskonała komunikacja: jesteś ciekawy/-a ludzi, komunikujesz się jasno i aktywnie słuchasz, aby zrozumieć ich potrzeby
  • Chęć nauki: otwartość na feedback i ciągłe poszukiwanie możliwości rozwoju
  • Zaangażowanie w markę: pasjonujesz się naszą marką i kolekcjami, z chęcią będziesz dzielić się tym entuzjazmem z klientami
  • Elastyczność: gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach, w tym: wieczorami, w weekendy i w święta
  • Komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem polskim i angielskim

Preferowane, ale nieobowiązkowe:

  • Masz doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i wiesz, jak działa sklep dzięki wcześniejszej pracy w handlu detalicznym
  • Czujesz się pewnie, doradzając klientom w kwestiach trendów, materiałów i dopasowania rozmiarów

  • Zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę zlecenie

  • Wymagana dyspozycyjność w weekendy

  • Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV jak najszybciej, ale nie później niż do 30.09.2026r.

INKLUZYWNOŚĆ I RÓŻNORODNOŚĆ

W Grupie H&M dążymy do tworzenia inkluzywnych, różnorodnych i sprawiedliwych miejsc pracy w całej organizacji. Wierzymy, że zespoły rozwijają się, gdy łączą różnorodne doświadczenia i perspektywy. Ta różnorodność zwiększa naszą zdolność do kreatywnego rozwiązywania problemów, poszerza horyzonty i buduje wartościowe relacje z kolegami, koleżankami i klientami na całym świecie. Dlatego uwzględniamy wszystkie wymiary różnorodności w procesie rekrutacji – aby nasze zespoły odzwierciedlały bogactwo społeczności, którym służymy.

title: Senior Engineer Glasvezel
description:

Als Senior Engineer Glasvezel ontwerp en verbeter je glasvezelnetwerken binnen telecomprojecten. Je vertaalt initiële ontwerpen en surveygegevens naar technische ontwerpen die aansluiten op de situatie in het veld, rekening houdend met bestaande infrastructuur en technische eisen. Blijkt de praktijk anders dan het oorspronkelijke ontwerp, dan analyseer je het verschil en werk je een passende oplossing uit. Zo kunnen projecten doorgaan en blijft de kwaliteit van het netwerk gewaarborgd.

Deze werkgever is een netwerk- en telecominfrabedrijf in Harderwijk. De organisatie ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt vaste en draadloze netwerken voor telecomaanbieders in heel Nederland. Je werkt in een team van vakmensen met korte lijnen en een nuchtere aanpak.

Jij bent een engineer met ervaring in telecom of glasvezelnetwerken. Je analyseert technische vraagstukken zelfstandig en vertaalt ze naar praktische oplossingen. Je bent analytisch, oplossingsgericht en werkt prettig samen met projectteams en collega-engineers. Daarnaast heb jij:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • ervaring als telecom-, glasvezel- of netwerkengineer;

  • ervaring met het uitwerken van technische ontwerpen;

  • een analytische en oplossingsgerichte houding;

  • plezier in samenwerken met projectteams.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega's. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Visjonen vår er å være en fremragende arbeidsplass med verdiene faglig autoritet og varme. Ved hjelp av flat struktur, tillit og en bamseklem i ny og ne har vi skapt en unik formel som funker. Er du en nysgjerrig og kompetent Data Engineer som vil bygge fremtidens dataløsninger med faglig autoritet og varme?

Høydepunkter

Noen års erfaring med data engineering (gjerne 4 år eller mer)

Erfaring med datamodellering og dataarkitektur, for eksempel Data Warehouse eller Data Mesh

Mulighet til å kommunisere godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

Gode problemløsningsevner, både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre

Et ønske om å utvikle deg faglig og holde deg oppdatert på nye metoder og teknologi

Engasjement for faget og glede av å dele kunnskap med kolleger

Kjennskap til MLOps og maskinlæring er en fordel

Du kjenner deg igjen i verdiene våre: faglig autoritet og varme

Vi ser etter en erfaren Data Engineer til vårt kontor i Oslo. Som konsulent i Miles vil du jobbe med komplekse og meningsfulle oppdrag innen data engineering og dataplattform, samtidig som du blir en del av et unikt miljø preget av faglig autoritet og varme.

Design, utvikling og vedlikehold av skalerbare data pipelines og ETL/ELT-prosesser.

Bygge og optimalisere datavarehus, data lakes og dataplattformløsninger.

Implementere løsninger på skyplattformer som Azure, AWS eller GCP ved hjelp av IaC (f.eks. Terraform).

Samarbeide tett med kunder og team for å levere innsikt og verdi gjennom data.

Mer enn bare en jobb

Hos oss er trivsel ikke et prosjekt – det er selve fundamentet. Vi jobber aktivt for at du skal få oppdrag som gir mening (og som du faktisk har lyst på), tid og rom til egen utvikling, et miljø som både heier på deg og utfordrer deg, og kollegaer som deler, støtter, ler og lærer sammen. Vi har stadig spennende og komplekse oppdrag innen data engineering og data platform, og vi håper å få flere nysgjerrige og kompetente utviklere med på laget.

Design, bygging og vedlikehold av robuste datastrømmer.

Erfaring med å operere og vedlikeholde maskinlæringsmodeller i produksjon.

Kjennskap til og interesse for maskinlæring er et pluss.

Vår visjon

Siden 2005 har Miles vært et ledende IT-konsulentselskap med en klar visjon: å være en fremragende arbeidsplass. Vår suksess hviler på to kjerneverdier – faglig autoritet og varme – som preger alt vi gjør. Disse verdiene styrer våre valg og beslutninger, og de er grunnsteinen i selskapets DNA. Hos oss i Miles handler det om så mye mer enn vekst – det handler om menneskene som skaper den og miljøet vi skaper sammen. Med stolthet ser vi at laget vårt vokser med flere dyktige kolleger, og vi skaper stadig nye muligheter sammen. Vi kan bruke mange floskler og fine ord for å beskrive Miles. Men med våre verdier i bunn så stemmer de fleste av dem.

I Miles Oslo jobber vi med noen av landets største kunder. Vi har mange spennende oppdrag innen bank og finans, telekom, fornybar energi, mobilitet og offentlig sektor.

Verdiene faglig autoritet og varme gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør og vi har full tro på at et smidig tankesett er veien å gå. Vi som jobber i Miles brenner for det vi jobber med, vi elsker å snakke fag og deler mer enn gjerne den kompetansen vi har med både kolleger og kunder.

Noen ganger møtes hele hurven på oslokontoret for å finne på noe sammen, og andre ganger deler vi oss opp i mindre grupper som gjør forskjellige aktiviteter.

For oss er det også viktig at familien til de ansatte inkluderes i det sosiale miljøet, og derfor har vi egne arrangementer der barn og bedre halvdeler kan bli med på moroa.

Vi er stolte over å tilby en arbeidsplass som virkelig setter konsulenten i sentrum.

På tvers av kontorene våre samles vi jevnlig for å dele kunnskap, erfaringer og faglig engasjement.

Men like viktig er de sosiale sammenkomstene med latteren, praten og de små øyeblikkene som gjør at vi trives i lag. Vi gjør mye gøy sammen!

Det er viktig for oss at du trives i oppdraget ditt, får jobbe med spennende oppgaver og har det bra på jobb. Vi holder alltid en tett dialog med konsulentene våre ute hos kunde. Og om noe skurrer, strekker vi oss langt for å finne løsninger, slik at både du og kunden er fornøyde.

Forsikring og pensjon

  • I Miles tar vi godt vare på folkene våre, også når uhellet er ute. Derfor har vi gode avtaler på plass for pensjon, gruppelivsforsikring, helseforsikring, reiseforsikring, behandlingsforsikring og ulykkesforsikring. Trygghet skal være en selvfølge, både på og utenfor jobb.

Vi har aldri helt skjønt poenget med å tvinge alle til å bruke det samme utstyret.Og stramme budsjetter? Ikke helt vår greie.I Miles får du velge det du trenger for at arbeidsdagen skal flyte best mulig, fordi vi tror at tillit og fleksibilitet gir de beste løsningene.

Vår kultur

Vi praktiserer en lederfilosofi der tillit, støtte og medarbeidernes trivsel og utvikling er i fokus, da vi vet at fornøyde ansatte skaper fornøyde kunder.

Vi kombinerer høy faglig kompetanse med et varmt, inkluderende og hyggelig miljø, hvor alle hjelper hverandre å lykkes. Våre verdier er derfor like enkle som de er ekte - faglig autoritet og varme.

Vi er et IT-konsulentselskap det ikke går tretten av på dusinet! Vi er ikke de eneste der ute som smykker oss med fancy ord som servant leadership og flat struktur, men vi kan med stolthet si at vi faktisk lever som vi lærer – vi jobber hver dag for at Miles skal være en fremragende arbeidsplass der du møter varme, tillit og ordentlig dyktige medarbeidere som bryr seg om og hjelper hverandre.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud‑based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics‑intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them.

Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will set the technical direction for a governed, scalable data platform that powers BI, product APIs, ML models, and customer‑facing AI assistants. You will lead our shift from ETL to ELT and advance our Data Mesh model, ensuring data products are well‑modeled, contract‑backed, reliable, and built to scale.

Outcomes - What Success Looks Like

  • Lead our ETL-to-ELT migration, moving transformation logic from PySpark pipelines into version‑controlled SQL and dbt without disrupting existing consumers.
  • Advance Data Mesh, establishing clear domain ownership, enforceable data contracts, safe schema evolution, and self‑service governance.
  • Own and mature dbt, including model architecture, contracts, testing, lineage, documentation, and CI/CD.
  • Strengthen our semantic layer, ensuring critical metrics are consistently defined and delivered at the correct grain across BI, APIs, ML, and AI.
  • Improve platform reliability and engineering standards through stronger data quality, observability, testing, security, and production readiness.
  • Raise team capability and delivery predictability through technical leadership, mentorship, planning, and AI‑assisted development practices.

Skills & Competencies - How the Work Gets Done

You are a hands‑on senior data engineer who can lead through technical expertise and influence. You bring:

  • Practical Data Mesh experience with domain‑owned data products, enforceable contracts, federated governance, and schema evolution.
  • Experience implementing ELT, ideally including migration from an existing ETL architecture.
  • Deep dbt, SQL, dimensional modeling, and data modeling expertise, including grain, contracts, testing, lineage, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with PySpark and cloud data warehouses such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
  • Experience building scalable data platforms using technologies such as AWS, S3, Glue, Athena, Airflow/Dagster, Kafka/SQS, Terraform, and CI/CD.
  • Strong data quality, testing, security, observability, and production engineering practices.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into robust data products and communicate technical trade‑offs across Product, Analytics, BI, and Engineering.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, setting technical standards, and using AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
  • Bonus: experience with semantic/metrics layers, ML or LLM data products, BI platforms, or FastAPI.

Culture Add: TEAM Values

We value team members who communicate with transparency, sharing information openly and building trust across functions. You bring excellence and expertise to your craft, holding a high bar for quality while continuously improving your skills. You demonstrate accountability by owning outcomes, following through on commitments, and taking responsibility for results. You are driven by metrics, using data and experimentation to inform decisions and deliver measurable impact.

Aptitudes

  • Smart: Able to quickly understand complex systems, connect ideas, and make sound judgments.
  • Curious: Actively seeks to understand customer problems, emerging technologies, and better ways of working.
  • Coachable: Open to feedback, willing to adapt, and continuously improving through learning.

What’s in It for You

You will join at an important stage in our data platform’s evolution, with meaningful influence over our move to ELT, Data Mesh, and governed data for AI. This is a hands‑on role with autonomy, visibility across technical and product leadership, and the opportunity to shape architecture and engineering standards while mentoring others and expanding your technical leadership over time.

Location: This is a remote opportunity, open to applicants authorized to work in Brazil. We are a global organization using English as our primary language, with localized communication where required. At Descartes, you will join a team committed to innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement as we build and support systems that power critical business operations worldwide. #LI‑Remote.

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators, and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky‑in‑a‑good way problem solvers. Guided by our values, we nurture a TEAM focused culture that invests in people and creates opportunities for advancement across a broad spectrum of career paths. We prioritize work‑life balance and foster an environment with the space to take ownership, to be heard, and to carve a path for your individual accomplishments to help drive our success. At Descartes, everyone has a voice and the best idea wins, regardless of who makes it. We offer competitive compensation, great benefits, remote and flexible work hours, and the opportunity to join a company on an awesome mission with a great existing team and trajectory.

Descartes also has a deep sense of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we helped our customers save over 552,000 metric tons of CO2 in 2020 by reducing fuel and paper consumption: https://www.descartes.com/who-we-are/social-responsibility-sustainability/environmental-impact.   • Enjoy working mostly remotely and, on occasion, in the NFB office space in downtown Montreal, located in the dynamic and arts‑centric Quartier des Spectacles, where we’re surrounded, inside and outside, by creators, producers and media professionals.
  • Immerse yourself in an exciting mandate: combine the art of design with the art of programming in the creation of NFB corporate digital products, including websites, apps and more (i.e., NFB Films app, NFB.ca).
  • Access to training budgets to keep up with the latest trends related to upcoming projects, in an environment that encourages and supports continuous learning.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the NFB’s digital products by embracing the following mandate:
  • Participates in the definition of front‑end architecture, including component structure, state management and development tooling, in collaboration with UX designers and other developers.
  • Assists in the design, programming, testing, implementation and maintenance of software solutions (interfaces, applications, web services, APIs), in collaboration with team members and internal and external partners.

  • Contributes to test scenario development (unit, integration, end‑to‑end) and promotes the application of test‑driven development (TDD) practices.

  • Stays up to date on new front‑end trends and tools, and actively participates in discussions about adopting them at the NFB.
  • Applies AGILE methodology: daily stand‑ups, planning, retrospectives, demos, etc.

ABOUT YOU:

You are an open‑minded, motivated individual with a passion for digital technologies. You are equally interested in innovation itself and in the tangible ways it enhances the user experience, whether on the web or mobile platforms.

Collaborating with colleagues from diverse professional backgrounds energizes you. You value a variety of perspectives, enjoy sharing your ideas, and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and respectful work environment. You know how to keep a sense of humor and approach challenges with a light touch, while remaining disciplined and committed when it is time to deliver results.

Self‑reliant and proactive, you are able to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and take sound decisions independently. You communicate with ease and thrive in an environment where discussions about architecture and user experience occasionally coexist with well‑timed GIFs, a few memes, and surprisingly passionate debates about raccoon trapping.

Also, you possess:

  • University degree in a relevant discipline (Web Design and Development, Software Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience;
  • Minimum three (3) years of relevant front‑end/full‑stack web‑development experience, or an equivalent combination of training and experience;
  • Solid experience in the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of dynamic, accessible, and high‑performance frontend interfaces, in accordance with UX principles and established technical standards.
  • Thorough knowledge of HTML5, CSS/SASS, JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript;
  • Thorough knowledge of Web Components; experience with the Lit library;
  • Experience with Redux (or another state management library) in front‑end applications;
  • Good knowledge of a modern front‑end framework such as Vue.js is an asset (used in select sub‑applications);
  • Good knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and cross‑browser/responsive design practices;
  • Good knowledge of front‑end build tooling (Webpack, Vite) and package management (Yarn/npm);
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs to separate front‑end and back‑end responsibilities;
  • Very good knowledge of Git and Git workflows (code reviews, branching strategies) and repository management (GitLab/GitHub);
  • Experience with front‑end testing tools (e.g., Jest, Cypress, Playwright) and an interest in TDD practices;
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker) for local development, packaging and troubleshooting containerized environments;
  • Knowledge of Python and a back‑end web framework (Django, Flask);
  • Familiarity with Elasticsearch and task queues such as Celery;
  • Understanding of software architecture principles for building stable, maintainable applications without over‑engineering;
  • Bilingualism in French and English, spoken and written.

The NFB is committed to building a skilled, diverse workforce that’s reflective of Canadian society. It promotes initiatives such as employment equity and encourages candidates to voluntarily indicate in their cover letter if they are a woman, a member of a First Nation, Inuk, Métis, a person with a disability or a member of a visible‑minority group.

The NFB is also committed to developing inclusive, barrier‑free selection processes and work environments. Feel free to advise us of any accommodation needs.

Avere un impatto significativo nel mondo ed essere parte attiva nel generare progetti che emozionino le persone, una riga di codice alla volta.

Crediamo che ognuno debba esprimere a pieno il proprio potenziale. title: Commissioning (CX) Engineer (Data Center)
description:
South Jakarta, Indonesia.

Client Overview

Our client is a global technology company operating in the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) industry, specializing in digital infrastructure, enterprise technology solutions, and mission-critical facilities. The organization delivers end-to-end infrastructure solutions across telecommunications, cloud computing, data centres, enterprise networks, and intelligent digital platforms. With operations spanning multiple countries and large-scale engineering projects, the company partners with enterprise clients, consultants, and contractors to develop highly reliable mission-critical infrastructure. As the organization continues to expand its data-center delivery capabilities, it is seeking experienced commissioning professionals to lead integrated systems testing, validate operational readiness, and ensure successful project hand-overs across large-scale data-centre developments.

Job Role

The Commissioning (CX) Engineer (Data Centre) is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading the end-to-end commissioning process for large-scale data centre infrastructure projects. This role oversees testing strategies, system validation, commissioning documentation, subcontractor coordination, and integrated systems testing to ensure all facility systems perform in accordance with design specifications, operational requirements, and industry standards. Working closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, equipment vendors, and clients, the successful candidate will lead commissioning activities from pre-functional testing through final integrated systems testing and client acceptance. The role plays a critical part in ensuring operational reliability, mitigating technical risks, and delivering mission-critical facilities that meet the highest standards of performance and quality. This position is ideal for experienced commissioning professionals with strong expertise in data centre infrastructure, MEP systems, integrated systems testing, and mission-critical project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute commissioning strategies, master test plans, commissioning procedures, and detailed test scripts for all phases of data centre commissioning.
  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), pre-commissioning, functional performance testing, integrated systems testing (IST), and final commissioning activities.
  • Prepare commissioning documentation, testing procedures, method statements, and project deliverables to ensure compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  • Define commissioning equipment requirements, testing tools, and Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for load banks, testing instruments, and specialised commissioning resources.
  • Coordinate with equipment suppliers, subcontractors, and testing vendors to support commissioning schedules, logistics, and technical execution.
  • Lead on-site commissioning activities involving electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire protection, Building Management Systems (BMS), and other mission-critical facility systems.
  • Supervise subcontractors, contractors, and commissioning teams during testing, troubleshooting, and system validation activities.
  • Conduct integrated systems testing, power failure simulations, redundancy validation, operational sequence verification, and performance testing to ensure facility readiness.
  • Identify commissioning issues, manage punch-list items, recommend corrective actions, and verify resolution prior to project handover.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders throughout commissioning, testing, and acceptance phases.
  • Prepare commissioning reports, testing documentation, and final acceptance records to support successful project completion and client hand-over.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and project management teams to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of mission-critical infrastructure projects.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data centre commissioning, MEP testing, quality assurance, or mission-critical facility commissioning.
  • Proven experience leading commissioning activities for large-scale data centre or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning methodologies, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), Functional Performance Testing (FPT), Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and commissioning documentation.
  • Solid knowledge of electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire protection, Building Management Systems (BMS), and integrated MEP systems.
  • Experience conducting load bank testing, generator synchronization, UPS testing, power system validation, blackout simulations, and operational readiness assessments.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Able to work under pressure and lead commissioning activities during critical testing windows, including evenings or weekends when required.
  • Willing to travel frequently and support on-site project execution.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

title: SAP Application Expert, in SAP Transportation Management System
description:

  • Support integration testing with SAP S/4HANA/ECC, EWM, SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), and SAP GTT where applicable.

  • Proven experience in writing functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and support documentation.

title: Assurance Senior
description:
Job Summary:

Job Duties:

Control Environment:

  • Applies knowledge and understanding of the collective effect of various factors on establishing or enhancing effectiveness, or mitigating the risks, of specific policies and procedures by:
    • Applying knowledge of transactional flow and key transactional cycles to complete audit work

    • Supervising and reviewing the work of audit staff

GAAP:

  • Applies knowledge and understanding of governing principles; applying these principles to client transactions; and documenting and communicating an understanding and application of these principles by:
    • Communicating financial statement disclosure requirements to clients
    • Drafting complex sets of financial statements with disclosures
    • Recognizing and applying new pronouncements to client situations
    • Identifying, analyzing and discussing alternative generally accepted accounting principles with the Manager, Senior Manager and engagement partner and the client, as needed
    • Identifying complex accounting issues and brings them to the attention of superiors for resolution
    • Coaching less experienced team members in new areas

SEC and PCAOB:

  • Applies knowledge and understanding of SEC regulations and PCAOB guidelines, and documents and communicates the application of these principles by:
    • Reading and reviewing clients’ SEC filings, ensuring accuracy and completeness, and also ensuring that all financial information is documented in the workpapers and through appropriate testing
    • Preparing required communications to the Client and the Audit Committee
    • Planning and executing Section 404 internal control audits including obtaining an understanding of the control environment, designing test plans, evaluating deficiencies and assessing the overall financial reporting control environment

GAAS:

  • Applies knowledge and understanding of professional standards; application of the principles contained in professional standards; and the ability to document and communicate an understanding and application of professional standards on an engagement by:

    • Identifying and proposing outcomes to critical issues

Research:

    • Utilizing of internal and external research tools and selecting methodology for routine research requests
    • Researching complex areas of accounting, forming an initial opinion on the correct treatment independently and considering and documenting the impact on the client and audit engagement
    • Documenting and organizing complicated findings in a usable format, based on information obtained from Accounting Research Manager, BDO Assurance Manual, Yahoo Finance, etc.
    • Assisting the engagement manager with gathering appropriate information about the business and information system, including the accounting system, to form an adequate basis for the preparation of the audit strategy
    • Developing the draft Audit Engagement Planning Memorandum, audit programs and budgets
    • Collaborating with the engagement manager to establish the responsibilities of individual audit staff for specific areas of audit work

  • Other duties as required

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Provides verbal and written performance feedback to Audit Associates
  • Supervises the work assignments of Audit Associates within assigned engagement team


Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Statistics, required OR Bachelor’s degree in other focus area and CPA certification, required
  • Master’s degree in Accountancy, preferred

Experience:

  • Two (2) or more years of prior relevant audit experience and/or public accounting, private industry accounting or consulting/professional services experience, required
  • Prior basic supervisory experience, preferred


License/Certifications:

  • Eligible to sit for the CPA exams upon starting employment, required and actively pursuing completion of the exams, required
  • CPA, preferred

Software:

  • Experience with assurance applications and research tools, preferred
