title: Salesforce AI & Data Cloud Solutions Engineer
description:
About AGF Management Limited:

Founded in 1957, AGF Management Limited (AGF) is an independent and globally diverse asset management firm. Our companies deliver excellence in investing in the public and private markets through three business lines: AGF Investments, AGF Capital Partners and AGF Private Wealth. AGF brings a disciplined approach, focused on incorporating sound, responsible and sustainable corporate practices. The firm’s collective investment expertise, driven by its fundamental, quantitative and alternative investing capabilities, extends globally to a wide range of clients, from financial advisors and their clients to high-net worth and institutional investors including pension plans, corporate plans, sovereign wealth funds, endowments and foundations. Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, AGF has investment operations and client servicing teams on the ground in North America and Europe. AGF serves more than 820,000 investors. AGF trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol AGF.B.

About the Role:

We're seeking a Salesforce AI & Data Cloud Solutions Engineer to modernize AGF’s CRM ecosystem through Data Cloud/Data360, Agentforce, automation, and advanced Salesforce capabilities. This role will operate as the primary technical owner for assigned solutions, including architecture, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-production support. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and taking accountability for end-to-end delivery. Working across Salesforce, Data360, and Agentforce, this individual will help evolve Salesforce into an intelligent platform that delivers AI-powered workflows, actionable insights, intelligent automation, and productivity gains supported by trusted, governed data across Sales and Analytics use cases. This role will enable relationship managers and sales teams to access proactive insights, reduce routine administration, trigger client and advisor workflows, support next-best-action recommendations, and embed AI into everyday sales processes. This new position is ideal for a hands‑on builder who combines Salesforce development expertise, strong data architecture skills, and curiosity for emerging AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Salesforce Data Cloud, AI & Agentforce Design and implement Salesforce Data360 solutions that unify CRM, transaction, portfolio, behavioural, and enterprise data into trusted customer profiles and Customer 360 views.
  • Configure Data360 architecture, including ingestion, identity resolution, data modelling, harmonization, grounding, segmentation, activation and governance to support Agentforce, Tableau, and AI-powered use cases.
  • Enable Agentforce, Tableau, and AI-powered use cases through scalable, governed, and reusable customer data foundations.
  • Design and implement scalable Salesforce solutions using Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, and automation tools.
  • Build and support Agentforce agents, custom actions, prompts, workflows, and AI-enabled business processes.
  • Identify and automate manual business processes across Sales Cloud.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define and deliver high-value AI and automation use cases.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and independently manage solution delivery from concept through production deployment.
  • Support Tableau Agent and emerging agentic analytics capabilities by enabling insight-to-action workflows in partnership with Tableau and analytics teams.
  • Collaborate with enterprise data teams to integrate Salesforce with internal and external systems using APIs, middleware, and modern integration patterns.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks and technical standards.
  • Optimize data models to support reporting, AI recommendations, analytics, and productivity tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving data, integrations, automation, performance, and security.
  • Establish governance, monitoring, and performance standards for AI-enabled solutions.
  • Document architecture decisions, data models, and agent configurations to support an auditable platform.

What you Bring:

  • 8+ years of hands‑on Salesforce development experience, with strong Sales Cloud knowledge.
  • Deep expertise with Flow Builder, including record-triggered, screen, auto-launched, and reusable flows, with strong debugging, error handling, and governance practices.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, including data modelling, schema design, ETL processes, large data volumes, data load and performance optimization.
  • Exposure to Data Cloud (Data360), Agentforce, Salesforce AI capabilities, or comparable customer data and AI platforms, with demonstrated ability to learn and apply emerging technologies.
  • Proven ability to independently design, develop, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions using Apex, Flow, Lightning Web Components, APIs, and platform configuration.
  • Hands‑on SQL and SOQL experience for data validation, analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, Python, Java or similar programming languages.
  • Salesforce Platform Administration foundation, including user management, object and field configuration and security model architecture.
  • Experience analyzing business processes and designing automation strategies that improve productivity, scalability, and user adoption.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail‑oriented approach with a focus on data accuracy, platform stability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Azure DevOps and release management tools.
  • Demonstrated ownership of end‑to‑end solution delivery from requirements through deployment and operational support.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and maintaining expertise in Salesforce and emerging platform technologies.

Strong Assets:

  • 1+ years’ experience with Data Cloud/Data360, Agentforce, or other Salesforce AI capabilities.
  • Salesforce certifications; Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I/II, Architect (path), Data Cloud Consultant, or Agentforce Specialist.
  • Exposure to Tableau or other analytics platforms.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with strong data governance, privacy, security, and audit requirements is an asset.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:

  • Strong builder mindset focused on delivering practical, scalable solutions.
  • Comfortable operating across configuration, automation, development, data, and AI.
  • Able to balance rapid delivery with sound architecture, governance, and maintainability.
  • Curious and committed to continuously expanding expertise in Salesforce and emerging AI technologies.
  • Driven by business outcomes, using data, automation, and intelligent workflows to improve productivity and user adoption.

Core Expertise:

  • Salesforce platform automation, flow architecture, data modelling and solution design, platform development.

Growth Expertise:

  • Data Cloud, Agentforce, AI-enabled automations, Customer data platforms, Integration architecture.

Compensation:

The anticipated compensation range for this role is $100,000 – $122,500 annually, which represents base salary and, where applicable, variable compensation components (e.g., annual bonus, commissions, etc.). Actual compensation will be determined based on many factors such as role location, candidate experience / qualifications, market conditions, and internal equity. AGF aims to offer a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package designed to support the success and well‑being of our employees, which may include a combination of base salary, variable compensation, benefits, and retirement savings plans.

AGF is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including women, Indigenous peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, national or ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable legislation.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact us at hr@agf.com so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

About us

Southern Cross Health Insurance is shaping a healthier Aotearoa New Zealand. Our purpose is simple: empowering our members to live well for longer. We're here to give peace of mind through timely access to quality care, inspire healthier living, and lead positive change across the health system. As a New Zealand-owned, member-based organisation, we're building a future where wellbeing is at the heart of everything we do – delivering exceptional value for our members and creating an environment where our people thrive. Now is an exciting time to join us. You'll be part of a high-performing, values-driven team where people are at the heart of everything we do – and in return for your talent, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and be proud of the difference your work makes.

About the role

Southern Cross is guided by purpose, powered by people and technology. We're here to help almost one million members across Aotearoa New Zealand live well for longer – work with real scale, real responsibility, and a real opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

What you'll do
  • Modernize Core Platforms: Partner with senior engineers to transition legacy on-prem services into modern, scalable, cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure.
  • Build & Integrate Shared Services: Develop, maintain, and operate key platform capabilities, including our Identity Platform, API Gateway (APIM), Domain APIs, and enterprise integration systems.
  • Deliver Migration Initiatives: Actively contribute to high-priority platform migrations, including transitioning legacy BizTalk integrations to Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management). Ensuring solutions are implemented in accordance with approved architecture designs, enterprise standards, and security requirements.
  • Leverage AI-Assisted Engineering: Actively use modern AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) in your daily workflow to accelerate delivery, draft boilerplate, generate unit tests, and refactor code efficiently.
  • Automate & Streamline Delivery: Build and support robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless, automated deployments, configuration management, and high platform availability.
  • Independent Troubleshooting: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues across distributed services, ensuring operational stability and minimal downtime for internal squads.
What you'll bring
  • Core Development Experience: Proven software engineering experience with C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework, alongside modern front-end capabilities in ReactJS, Angular, or JavaScript.
  • AI-First Mindset: Strong familiarity with AI coding assistants (such as GitHub / Microsoft Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex) and a proactive habit of integrating them into your day-to-day development lifecycle to boost velocity.
  • Cloud & Integration Skills: Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, particularly Logic Apps, Azure API Management (APIM), and cloud integration patterns.
  • DevOps Mindset: Practical experience working with automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and modern deployment practices.
  • Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the initiative to dig into complex technical issues and resolve them independently.
Bonus Points

Prior hands-on experience migrating legacy Microsoft BizTalk environments to Azure Integration Services (AIS) or managing enterprise API Gateways.

Who we are

Ngākau nui. Āhurutanga. Tikanga. Join a proud, diverse team that's always there, always real, always true. If you thrive in a caring, honest and open culture, we think you'll love working with us. We know our team's culture and wellbeing drive us forward. That's why we prioritise not only professional development but opportunities to thrive personally. We offer exceptional work/life balance, and our people are encouraged – and rewarded – for living well.

Southern Cross employee benefits include:
  • Five days of wellbeing leave per year
  • Health insurance for you and your immediate whānau
  • Life insurance cover and discounts on pet and travel insurance
  • Extra parental leave benefits and financial wellbeing support
  • Participation in our workplace wellbeing programme
  • The option to purchase flexi leave for study, volunteering, or supporting your whānau

title: Vil du bruke data til å løse utfordringer som virkelig betyr noe? Bli vår nye Data Engineer!
description:
Er du nysgjerrig, teknologidrevet og klar for komplekse utfordringer? Da vil vi høre fra deg!

I Bouvet hjelper vi virksomheter med å gjøre data tilgjengelig, pålitelig og verdifullt. Vi utvikler dataplattformer og analyseløsninger basert på moderne skyløsninger som Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure, AWS og Google Cloud.

Vi opplever stor etterspørsel etter kompetanse innen Dataplattform og Data Engineering, og søker flere dyktige Data Engineers som vil være med på å bygge løsninger som blir en sentral del av kundenes virksomhet.

Hva vil du jobbe med?

Vi forventer ikke at du kan alt, men erfaring med noe av dette er relevant:

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake
  • Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake og SQL
  • Python og SQL
  • dbt
  • Git, Azure DevOps og CI/CD
  • Docker og Kubernetes
  • Power BI

Dette er Plattform Innsikt og Analyse

Vi er 50 konsulenter basert i Oslo og ca. 250 på tvers av Bouvet, som har spisskompetanse i å:

  • Samle data i skybaserte økosystemer og plattformer
  • Analysere data ved bruk av avanserte algoritmer og maskinlæring
  • Kommunisere innsikt gjennom moderne rapporteringsverktøy

I tillegg leverer vi rådgiving innenfor Data Strategi, Data Governance og Sikkerhet.

Vi har prosjekter i gang med viktige samfunnsaktører som Statnett, Eidsiva Bioenergi, Oslo Kommune, Norges Vassdrag og Energidirektoriat, Integrering og Mangfoldsdirektoratet, DNT, Aker BP og Equinor.

Vi er teknologer og programmerere, ingeniører, økonomer, indøkere og et par engelskmenn som aldri dro hjem igjen. Vi jobber som arkitekter, utviklere, data scientister, analytikere, rådgivere, team leads og prosjektledere. Vi er en sosial gjeng hvor alle får utvikle seg faglig så mye de bare selv ønsker, aller oftest ved å lære av hverandre, og ikke så rent sjelden på ledende konferanser og faglige sammenkomster. Noen av oss er generalister, andre er spesialister. Fellesnevneren er at vi alle brenner for å bygge datadrevne organisasjoner og analyseverktøy ved hjelp av moderne teknologi.

Noen av våre prosjektreferanser:

  • Bærekraftig og datadrevet varehandel hos Vinmonopolet
  • Maskinlæringsmodeller holder strømmen på i Norge
  • Etablering av analyseplattform som automatiserer og effektiviserer data i Fagforbundet

Hos oss får du

Vi har selvfølgelig mange flere goder! De finner du i vårGulrotindeks på https://www.bouvet.no/bli-en-av-oss

Faglig utvikling og karrieremuligheter

Hos Bouvet får du mulighet til å utvikle deg i den retningen som passer dine interesser og ambisjoner.

Du kan fordype deg som spesialist innen Data Engineering, ta en rolle som løsningsarkitekt for dataplattformer, eller vokse inn i roller med større faglig eller kommersielt ansvar.

Jako Brigádník/brigádnice v H&M budete součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).

V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • Šance být součástí unikátní H&M společnosti a její kultury.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na DPP (300 hodin ročně), se sídlem v Opavě. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 02.10.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

title: Ombudsman, Scams
description:
We are looking for an Ombudsman to join our team and make fair, consistent and timely decisions for consumers.

The role will suit senior legally qualified professionals with a strong track record of significant achievement, particularly with a background in the banking, telcos and digital platform sectors. You are likely to be at a stage of your career where you have an interest in using your well-developed skills and experience in a role which contributes to good community outcomes.

Your role will be to make decisions, individually or as part of a panel, on standard and complex complaints in accordance with AFCA’s rules and fairness principles. The decisions are likely to make a real difference and influence the relevant industry as they are binding when accepted by the complainant.

You will provide professional and technical leadership across AFCA and to coach and mentor adjudicators, case workers and others. The role supports with engaging and influencing members, industry associations and consumer groups to improve industry standards.

This is a Board appointed role.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Legal qualifications and a significant track record of achievement at senior executive level in consumer resolution within a relevant industry or tribunal, EDR scheme, regulatory agency or private practice role
  • Strong analytical skills, the ability to quickly get to the heart of complex issues and to efficiently and independently handle a busy caseload, with a clear outcomes-focus
  • A demonstrated high level of written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with a wide cross-section of the industry sector and broader community
  • Determination, empathy and resilience to deal with conflict and difficult interactions
  • Gold AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

Titre du poste : Analyste de données en service (In-Service Data Analyst)

Lieu : Mirabel (4 jours par semaine en présentiel)

À titre d’analyste de données pour les aéronefs actuellement en service, vous ferez partie de l’organisation des Services à la clientèle, au sein de l’équipe d’Ingénierie en service (In-Service Engineering – ISE), qui soutient les réparations structurales et la performance de la flotte. Cette équipe exploite des données d’ingénierie et d’exploitation afin d’identifier des tendances, d’améliorer les stratégies de réparation et d’accroître la disponibilité des aéronefs à l’échelle de la flotte mondiale.

Le rôle

Votre rôle en tant qu’analyste de données consistera à extraire, analyser et visualiser des données liées aux réparations, à leur récurrence et à l’utilisation des pièces de rechange, afin de favoriser une prise de décision éclairée et l’amélioration continue des activités de soutien en service.

Responsabilités :

  • Extraire et analyser des données provenant de multiples bases de données d’ingénierie et de maintenance (réparations, dommages, performance de la flotte, utilisation des pièces de rechange);
  • Identifier les réparations récurrentes ainsi que les tendances et modèles ayant une incidence sur les structures des aéronefs;
  • Analyser la récurrence des réparations et les enjeux de fiabilité afin de soutenir les améliorations d’ingénierie et de réduire les interruptions opérationnelles;
  • Effectuer le suivi et l’analyse de la consommation et des tendances d’utilisation des pièces de rechange afin d’appuyer l’optimisation de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et des activités de maintenance;
  • Développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord interactifs et des rapports (Google Workspace / Looker Studio ou équivalent, tel que Power BI);
  • Traduire des données complexes en recommandations et informations exploitables;
  • Collaborer avec les ingénieurs et les parties prenantes afin de définir les besoins en données;
  • Soutenir les stratégies de soutien en service grâce à des recommandations fondées sur les données;
  • Assurer la qualité et la cohérence des données;
  • Contribuer aux initiatives d’amélioration continue.

Exigences

  • Baccalauréat complété;
  • Maîtrise de la suite Google (Google Sheets, Looker Studio, etc.) ou d’un outil équivalent;
  • Expérience dans le secteur aérospatial (atout);
  • Bilinguisme (le français est considéré comme un atout).

JobTitle: In Service Data Analyst

As the data analyst for aircraft that are currently off the ground (in-service) you will be part of the customer services organization, within the In-Service Engineering (ISE) team, supporting structural repairs and fleet performance. You’ll sit at the intersection of customer experience, regulation, payments, fraud and technology, working across teams to build reliable, scalable customer capabilities that support the broader FanMo ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a strong product thinker who can balance customer conversion with trust, fraud, compliance and operational complexity. You’re comfortable navigating complex regulated journeys and turning them into simple, reliable customer experiences.

  • Wallet experience
  • Deposits and withdrawals
  • Customer preferences and consent
  • Fraud and risk integrations
  • Conversion across onboarding and payments
  • Shared capabilities used across Sportsbook, Lottery and Fan Ecosystem

Within 12 months, you will have:

  • Simplified registration and verification
  • Improved onboarding and payment conversion
  • Reduced unnecessary customer friction
  • Improved payment reliability and withdrawal experience
  • Created reusable platform capabilities across verticals
  • Built strong Product, Technology, Compliance and Operations partnerships

  • Experience balancing customer conversion with trust, fraud, compliance and operational complexity.
  • Strong product craft across funnel optimisation, platform thinking, payments, regulated journeys, analytics and experimentation.
  • Experience working cross-functionally across Product, Technology, Compliance and Operations.
  • Experience owning complex customer journeys and shared platform capabilities end to end.
  • Experience leveraging AI to accelerate insight and delivery, while ensuring high-impact customer and regulatory decisions remain appropriately controlled.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in UAE or GCC markets, KYC or digital identity, wallets and payments, fraud or risk, gaming or other regulated products.

If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!

At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. In addition to technical expertise, we value excellent communication skills. Collaboration and effective teamwork are the cornerstones of our success, and we believe in fostering an environment where everyone’s voice is heard and valued.

To thrive in this role, we are looking for a Middle engineer with confident hands-on .NET/C# development, practical Angular experience, and the habit of clarifying incomplete requirements instead of waiting for a finished specification.

About the project:

You will join the team modernising a large US e-commerce platform in the durable medical equipment and mobility products space. The platform is being migrated from a legacy Adobe ColdFusion system to an Angular storefront served by a .NET 8+ backend, with a gradual re-platforming to Azure planned. The current production system is in maintenance while the frontend migration is around halfway through, and a new Order Management System is being built alongside it.

  • 4+ years of commercial experience in .NET development, including C# and ASP.NET Core.

  • Good experience with Angular and TypeScript, including developing and maintaining frontend components.

  • Experience working with REST APIs, backend services, and integrations between frontend and backend systems.

  • Understanding of SQL databases, data modeling, and writing optimized queries.

  • Experience with e-commerce platforms, CMS, or other complex business applications is a strong plus.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git, branching strategies, and standard development workflows.

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests; understanding of the testing pyramid.

  • Basic knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices. Experience with PCI-DSS-related systems is a plus.

  • Ability to investigate issues, troubleshoot problems, and independently find solutions.

  • Ability to clarify requirements with the team and ask relevant questions when requirements are unclear.

  • Willingness to use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude Code to improve development efficiency.

  • Upper-intermediate English or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively with international colleagues and clients.

  • At least 4 hours of daily overlap with New York time.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain features across the Angular storefront and the .NET backend.

  • Contribute to the migration of the legacy ColdFusion e-commerce platform to the modern stack.

  • Implement and support integrations with existing systems and services.

  • Participate in the development of the new Order Management System.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable production code, and investigate and fix bugs across front-end and back-end components.

  • Clarify requirements directly with the people who have the answers, estimate your tasks, and communicate blockers early.

  • Work with Azure-based environments and CI/CD pipelines, following the established engineering standards.

  • Use AI coding assistants responsibly for prototyping, development, debugging, and delivery efficiency.

  • Coach/psychologist consultation

title: Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa, skrátený pracovný pomer 30h týždenne, Banská Bystrica
description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ
Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

  • Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
  • Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
  • Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
  • Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
  • A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

  • Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
  • Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

  • Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
  • Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
  • Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

  • 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
  • Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
  • Športová karta Multisport,
  • Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
  • Rozsiahly program školení,
  • Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
  • Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
  • Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
  • Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
  • Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
  • Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
  • 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na skrátený pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 30 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Bánskej Bystrici.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 6,18 € brutto/hod., vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 04.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

title: QA Automation (Software Development Engineer in Test)
description:
24Slides is a leading presentation design company specializing in high-impact PowerPoint presentations. We are committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. We believe diversity drives innovation and success, and we strive to build an environment where every identity is valued. At 24Slides, we don't just celebrate differences—we make them central to our culture, ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive.

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to design automation frameworks and ensure high-speed, reliable releases. You will own the full automation lifecycle, from API testing to complex UI E2E scenarios.

You will bridge manual testing and software engineering, collaborating with the QA team to build a technical culture and explore Agentic AI. If you enjoy scalable test suites and optimizing CI/CD to keep feedback loops fast, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Automation Architecture & Execution
  • High-Speed E2E Frameworks: Develop and optimize Playwright E2E tests so key scenarios run in under 30 minutes.
  • Full Regression Testing: Build and scale UI regression suites across hundreds of scenarios with scheduled runs for stability.
  • API Automation: Implement scalable Python (or modern) tools for reliable API testing and backend resilience.
  • Test Cycle Optimization: Automate up to 60% of new scenarios to reduce manual regression effort.
  • CI/CD Integration: Maintain post-deployment testing within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaboration & Technical Innovation
  • Team Upskilling & Mentorship: Mentor manual QA through knowledge transfer and pair programming to build an automation culture.
  • AI-Driven Testing: Implement Agentic AI for self-healing scripts and automated exploratory testing.
  • Shift-Left Collaboration: Work with manual QAs and product teams early to design features to be automation-ready.
  • Quality, Governance & Analytics
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigate logs, databases, and network behavior to pinpoint the source of defects.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Track key quality metrics such as coverage, pass rates, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Code Standardization: Ensure clean, reusable, well-documented code across all automation repositories.

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience: In relevant fields, with hands-on experience applying learned skills to real-world projects and tasks.
  • Playwright Mastery: Strong experience developing and optimizing fast, robust E2E test suites using Playwright (TypeScript or Python).
  • Advanced Python: High proficiency in Python for building backend automation and advanced scripting.
  • API Automation: Expertise in designing and maintaining scalable API testing frameworks (using Python, Postman, or Newman).
  • Strategic Test Design: Ability to design multi-tier testing strategies (Crucial E2E vs. Full Regression) to optimize execution time.
  • CI/CD Integration: Hands-on experience integrating and managing automated tests within pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Jenkins).
  • Mentorship Skills: Strong ability to share automation knowledge by mentoring the partner and being willing to train colleagues.
  • English Proficiency: Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Tech Enhancements (Nice-to-Have): Experience or strong interest in Agentic AI for self-healing tests, Docker containerization, performance tools (k6/Locust), or SQL for data validation.
  • Core Soft Skills: Sharp analytical and critical thinking for root cause analysis, strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and excellent time management.

title: Web Developer (React/Typescript)
description:
Web Developer (React/TypeScript)

About Kongsberg Geospatial

Kongsberg Geospatial does challenging work that matters. We are an industry leading software company that has been delivering real-time geospatial technology solutions for Defence and Aerospace applications worldwide for over 30 years.

Since 2006, we have been a wholly owned subsidiary of Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace in Norway, and we are an integral part of many key programs there. Externally, our technology is relied upon and trusted for a wide range of applications including air defense, search and rescue, drone delivery systems, and autonomous vehicle tracking. Our team members make a real impact in people's lives.

Job description

Are you a software professional that enjoys creating solutions that customers love? Do you thrive on seeing projects from concept to delivery? Do you like working in smaller teams and seeing the entire solution?

Our team is growing and we’re seeking a Web Developer to support the design, development, and improvement of several new and existing web applications.

This is a 6-month full-time position with the possibility of extension.

This is a hybrid position located in Ottawa, Ontario.

What You’ll Create

We develop systems that integrate complex sensor interfaces, data, and equipment. We tie it all together using an assortment of middleware technologies and present it using innovative modern graphical user interfaces. Our user experiences provide application operators visualization of geospatial map and terrain data, imagery, video feeds, and sensor controls overlaid with real-time data.

We are seeking someone with front-end experience on several web application centric programs. As a member of a motivated and structured development team, you will contribute to the development and design of front-end web-based software (primarily built in React) while gradually expanding your skills in back-end development to become a full-stack developer.

Duties Include:

  • Design, implement, and unit-test new web application features from concept to delivery.
  • Promote software quality through peer design and code reviews.
  • Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies help continuously improve team practices.
  • Work directly with customers to create solutions that solve targeted operational needs.

You Have:

  • A Canadian security clearance or eligibility to obtain one.
  • A post-secondary degree or diploma in a field related to Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 0–3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience developing front-end components using React and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing web services using NodeJS.
  • Experience with version control.
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, and communication skills.

It will be great if you have:

  • Experience with Material UI.
  • Experience with web maps using OpenLayers.
  • Experience with Zustand.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Experience with UX and UI design.
  • Experience with communication & streaming protocols.
  • Experience and/or knowledge of OGC standards.

The base salary range for this role is $75,000 - $125,000. Individual pay is determined by a number of factors including job-related skills, experience, internal equity and relevant education or training.

Due to the volume of applicants, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. We appreciate your interest in Kongsberg Geospatial.

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please notify us during the application process.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer - Multi-Mission Planning Development
company: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
description:
Description

Are you passionate about applying your talents to address the difficult challenges facing our warfighters such as Operationalizing Artificial Intelligence to support Achieving Robust Homeland and Theater Defenses, Accelerating Warfighting Capabilities in INDOPACOM, or Enabling Space Superiority?

Are you searching for important work in Multi-Domain mission planning and decision dominance?

Do you love participating in dynamic software development, prototyping, and transition efforts that regularly provide our warfighters new capabilities?

Would you like to make impactful contributions to the prototyping and development of sophisticated tools in support of U.S. warfighters in the armed services?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

In A5C, we develop and deploy advanced planning capabilities and solutions directly into the hands of the warfighter, empowering them to design dominant defenses for maximum performance across multiple simultaneous multiple missions, multiple services, and multiple command echelon planning levels and domains.

We are seeking an enthusiastic team member with software engineering experience willing to take on exciting assignments and willing to learn about the complexity of military systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer your duties and tasks would include:

  • Designing, developing, testing, and reviewing cyber-hardened software written in C++ and Python within classified environments. Work includes object-oriented design, algorithm design, algorithm implementation from design specifications, code refactoring, software testing, software assurance, and associated documentation.
  • Conducting high-impact engineering activities that will support the development of multi-mission and multi-service planning capabilities to predict performance of U.S. military systems.
  • Helping develop multi-mission (Ballistic Missile Defense, Space Domain Awareness, etc.) simulation software for use in analysis and integration into mission planning software.
  • Document concepts, software, requirements, analysis results, and technical recommendations.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

  • Possess a BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related area.
  • Have 4+ years of experience in developing applications in C++ on Linux.
  • Have 1+ years of experience in coding with Python.
  • Have experience with Git or similar version control systems.
  • Are passionate about mentoring team members and providing meaningful code reviews.
  • Demonstrate strong organizational abilities.
  • Demonstrate excellent written, oral, and communication skills when collaborating with team members, sponsors, and users.
  • Are able to acquire an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately acquire Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

  • Possess an advanced degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Development, or a closely related area.
  • Have 7+ years of experience in software development with C++ on Linux.
  • Have used C++ build tooling such as CMake and Conan.
  • Have used Conda for package management.
  • Have a strong interest in modeling and simulation.
  • Have demonstrated knowledge of software profiling and optimization, testing, and static and dynamic code analysis.
  • Have experience working with software development pipelines such as GitLab CI/CD.
  • Already possess a Final Secret or Top Secret security clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation's most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. title: Research Assistant 2, HSS
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

The Department of Emergency Medicine is looking to bring on a Research Assistant 2 to support recruitment and implementation of an NIH-funded clinical research study conducted in the Emergency Department. The Research Assistant 2 will participate in designated recruitment periods, including weekend coverage, until the study enrollment goal is reached.

Responsibilities include notifying Emergency Department clinicians of study activities; identifying potentially eligible participants through the electronic tracking board and collaboration with ED clinicians; approaching patients and introducing the study; assessing current alcohol and cannabis use; screening participants for eligibility using standardized instruments (AUDIT-C and CUDIT-R); obtaining informed consent; administering baseline and post-intervention research assessments; delivering the study Brief Negotiated Intervention (BNI); conducting 30-day follow-up assessments; entering and maintaining study data in REDCap; maintaining accurate research documentation; coordinating participant follow-up and electronic incentive distribution; and participating in weekly research meetings.

The Research Assistant 2 will work under the supervision of the Lead Research Associate and Principal Investigator and will be responsible for conducting study activities in accordance with study protocols, Good Clinical Practice, and applicable human subjects research regulations.

Job Duties

Recruit, screen, and enroll eligible Emergency Department (ED) participants according to study protocol.

Obtain informed consent and administer standardized research questionnaire and study assessments.

Deliver the study Brief Negotiated Intervention (BNI) following the approved intervention protocol.

Assist with data organization, coding, and quality review as directed.

Conduct 30-day follow-up assessments and maintain participant retention (clinical research data collection and follow-up procedures).

Coordinate participant follow-up and distribute electronic participant incentives.

Participate in weekly research meetings and collaborate with the Lead Research Associate and Principal Investigator.

Work under the Lead RA for coordination and execution (team-based research coordination and support within structured protocols).

This position REQUIRES: occasional afterhours work as late as 12am midnight.

Required Skills and Abilities

1. Demonstrated experience obtaining informed consent. Demonstrated experience with participant recruitment. Proven ability to work with research protocols and clinical trials; adept at collecting and managing data.
2. Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication abilities, and experience working with diverse groups or patient populations.
3. Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word), electronic medical databases, and other relevant software.
4. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
5. Strong customer service orientation, with the ability to handle sensitive information confidentially and professionally.

Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Bachelor's degree in a related field such as psychology, neuroscience, or public health; experience administering structured clinical interviews or managing research studies.
2. Familiarity with research regulations, ethical guidelines, and Institutional Review Board (IRB) procedures.
3. Proven experience with data management software, such as REDCap, OnCore, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).
4. Prior experience in a clinical setting, working with subjects with psychiatric or cognitive disorders.
5. Completion of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training, with certification as a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or Clinical Research Professional (CRP) preferred.

PLEASE DISREGARD THE PRINICIPAL RESPOSIBILITES LISTED BELOW!!!

Principal Responsibilities

1. Researches and collects data through site or home visit intakes; library research; structured interviews; or through other means for research projects. 2. Interprets, synthesizes, and analyzes data using scientific or statistical techniques. Modifies and plans research experiments, procedures, tests, or survey instruments. Assists in research design. 3. Writes and edits material for publication and presentation. Reports on status of research activities. Oversees and instructs research and support staff on technical procedures, equipment operation, and laboratory maintenance. 4. Schedules and coordinates research activities. Identifies and recruits study participants. Orders and maintains inventory of supplies. 5. May assist in preparing financial information and monitoring budgets. 6. Performs additional functions incidental to research activities. Required Education and Experience Two years of related work experience in the same job family and a Bachelor's degree in a related field; or an equivalent combination of experience and education.

Background Check Requirements

All candidates for employment will be subject to pre-employment background screening for this position, which may include motor vehicle, DOT certification, drug testing and credit checks based on the position description and job requirements. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of the background check. For additional information on the background check requirements and process visit "Learn about background checks" under the Applicant Support Resources section of Careers on the It's Your Yale website.

Health Requirements

This role is a healthcare worker position. Healthcare workers (HCW) are defined as university employees working a healthcare setting who have the potential for direct or indirect exposure to patients, human research subjects or infectious materials including body substance, contaminated medical supplies, devices and equipment, surfaces, or air. HCW have specific health requirements that must be met prior to starting work, including MMR vaccine or immunity, varicella (chickenpox) vaccine or immunity, TB screening, COVID vaccine according to University policy, hepatitis B vaccine or immunity, and annual flu vaccination.

title: H&M Department Supervisor - The Farmes Market
description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
  • Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
  • Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
  • Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way


Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
  • Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions


Team & Development

  • Retain and share your knowledge and skills with the Store team
  • Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
  • Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
  • Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
  • Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed


Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
  • Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
  • Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
  • Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
  • Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
  • Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
  • Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

  • To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
  • You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
  • You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.


Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $23.56-$27.36 hourly**
EEOC Code: SLS
Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly


*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

title: Agent & DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Agent & DevOps Platform Engineer to join our team in Toronto, ON (Onsite). The ideal candidate will have strong hands‑on experience in AWS, Python, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps, along with practical experience building or integrating AI/LLM-based tools and agents. The role involves developing secure, scalable, and reusable cloud-native platforms, automation, pipelines, and AI-powered developer solutions in an enterprise environment.

Key Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud, CI/CD, or platform engineering.
  • Strong Python programming skills for automation, APIs, infrastructure tooling, and scripting.
  • Experience with AWS production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS IAM, including roles, policies, trust relationships, cross-account access, and least privilege.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, EKS, or ECS.
  • Strong experience with CI/CD, Git workflows, build automation, and release pipelines.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Experience building or integrating AI/LLM tools, agents, or developer platforms.
  • Understanding of LLMOps, including prompt management, tool use, agent architecture, evaluation, observability, and reliability.
  • Experience with cloud-native deployments and DevSecOps practices.
  • Working knowledge of an additional language/ecosystem such as Java, .NET, Groovy, or Node.js.
  • Strong problem‑solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain AWS-based developer and DevOps platforms.
  • Develop automation, infrastructure tooling, APIs, and production scripts using Python.
  • Build and manage scalable CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
  • Deploy and operate containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes/EKS/ECS.
  • Implement secure AWS IAM, authentication, and access‑control patterns.
  • Develop and integrate AI/LLM‑based agents and tools into enterprise developer platforms.
  • Apply LLMOps practices for agent evaluation, observability, reliability, and tool management.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code and reusable cloud deployment patterns.
  • Promote DevSecOps, security‑by‑design, secure defaults, and operational simplicity.
  • Create reusable platform patterns and solutions that can be adopted across multiple teams.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud, automation, identity, and platform issues.
  • Coach and support engineering teams through reusable code, pipelines, automation, and platform solutions.
  • Work effectively in ambiguous environments and turn experimental solutions into reliable production capabilities.

title: Monteur Glasvezel
description:
Je vindt hier een korte omschrijving van deze vacature. Nog vragen? Of benieuwd of dit een passende rol voor jou is? Neem contact met ons op!

Als Monteur Glasvezel werk je met veel vrijheid aan de netwerken van de toekomst. De ene dag trek je bekabeling door een kantoorpand en werk je die vakkundig af op aansluitpunten en panelen. De volgende dag sta je buiten om lassen te maken in een glasvezel-lasafsluiting of doe je nauwkeurig patchwerk in een telefooncentrale. Soms graaf je een handhole open om bij het netwerk te komen. Je levert strak werk en maakt graag je handen vuil.

Deze werkgever is een netwerk- en telecominfrabedrijf in Harderwijk. De organisatie ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt vaste en draadloze netwerken voor telecomaanbieders in heel Nederland. Je werkt in een team van vakmensen met korte lijnen en een nuchtere aanpak.

Jij bent een techneut die energie krijgt van glasvezel en graag zelfstandig op pad gaat. Je bent representatief, maakt makkelijk contact met klanten en vindt kwaliteit leveren de standaard. Je begrijpt dat een verbinding soms gewoon af moet voordat de klant weer verder kan. Daarnaast heb jij:

  • ervaring met lassen;

  • rijbewijs B;

  • affiniteit met zakelijke glasvezelnetwerken, of de bereidheid dit te leren;

  • de bereidheid om cursussen als monteur glasvezeltechniek, meettechnicus en VCA basis te volgen.

In deze rol is het essentieel dat je vloeiend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft vanwege de communicatie met klanten en collega's. Ook is de voorkeur dat je in de omgeving van de werkgever woont, in verband met (deels) werken op kantoor.

Kun jij je (deels) herkennen in deze vacature? Reageer dan vooral! We gaan graag met jou in gesprek om jou beter te leren kennen. Neem contact met ons op!

title: Pool Technician
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day’s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. title: Technology Business Partner
description:
About Z Energy

Z has a clear purpose: Powering better journeys, today and tomorrow. As one of New Zealand’s largest transport energy companies, we have a commitment to delivering safe, secure, and reliable transport energy – with the opportunity to deliver new journeys, with new energy solutions in a changing world.

We are proud to be the Kiwi contingent in the Ampol Group, an independent Trans-Tasman energy company, with trading offices across the globe, which are united behind our shared purpose. While many of the challenges and opportunities we face go beyond national boundaries, together we have the scale, influence, and capability to deliver for our customers, communities, and our people.

Technology, Digital & Data @ Ampol

Technology, Digital and Data (TDD) at Ampol are dedicated to empowering our business through technology-enabled differentiation, strengthening our foundations to build sustainable value for the future. Our team thrives on the challenge of innovation—dreaming up big ideas, questioning the norm, and tackling complex problems. Together, we are shaping a future that not only meets the needs of today but anticipates the demands of tomorrow.

Our approach is anchored in data-driven decision-making and advanced technology integration, allowing us to create seamless and personalized customer experiences that truly resonate. By prioritizing value-based decisions and outcomes, we ensure that TDD drives meaningful impact and measurable outcomes for the Ampol Group, leaving a lasting impact on our business and our customers.

About the role


The Hoa Umanga Hangarau Technology Business Partner – Z Energy will act as the strategic interface for Z to shape, prioritise, and deliver technology-enabled business value across the Z business. Offering a unique opportunity to influence every aspect of the technology environment for Z, this role will ensure alignment between business goals and innovative technology solutions. Working closely with Z Senior Leadership team, this role will shape demand, drive prioritisation, and foster trusted partnerships to shape roadmaps, drive digital transformation, and deliver measurable outcomes for the Z business.

You’ll take us further by:

  • Serve as a key strategic technology partner to Z, fostering deep alignment between technology direction and the commercial objectives of Z.
  • Build trusted relationships at the executive level, maintain ongoing visibility into Z strategy, and proactively identify opportunities where technology can unlock competitive advantage, enhance performance, and drive growth.
  • Provide strategic oversight to ensure technology solutions are user-centric, commercially viable, and tightly aligned with business objectives.
  • Champion a cross-functional approach that balances innovation with practical delivery, ensuring solutions meet both operational needs and long-term strategic goals.
  • Translate complex business needs into practical, scalable technology solutions, delivering commercial impact and enhancing efficiency.
  • Drive prioritisation and investment decisions that translate business vision into scalable, high-impact technology outcomes through robust business case development, ROI modelling, and benefits realisation frameworks.
  • Shape demand into structured needs with benefits, prioritising based on value and capacity, support the business cases and drive value realisation.

We’d love it if you have:

  • Proven business partnering experience in complex, multi-location or distributed operational environments.
  • Strong expertise in enterprise technology ecosystems, and digital technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate commercial and operational priorities into scalable, user-centric technology solutions
  • Experience shaping business demand into clear, actionable initiatives through business analysis, product management, or project delivery across varied industries
  • Proven ability to align technology initiatives with business strategy and deliver measurable outcomes, supported by strong commercial acumen and an understanding of ROI, trade-offs, and value realization
  • Experience in defining and delivering product and platform roadmaps that support strategic growth and operational excellence
  • Cross-functional leadership capability, with a history of building trusted partnerships with senior business and operations stakeholders and an ability to influence and advise at an executive level.
  • Strong background in systems integration, automation, and digital enablement to drive efficiency, resilience, and innovation
  • Ability to balance short-term tactical needs with long-term strategic vision in dynamic, high-growth environments
  • Deep understanding of how to leverage technology to improve customer experience, operational performance, and agility

And of course, you’ll be passionate about what matters to Z, embracing and living our values to help us deliver on our aspirations and broader commitment to Aotearoa New Zealand.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Z we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

What we can offer you

  • A competitive remuneration package including short-term incentive plan, medical insurance for you and your family, enhanced employer contribution for KiwiSaver
  • Generous leave provisions including enhanced sick leave, parental leave benefits and the option to buy additional leave
  • The balance of hybrid working, enjoy some of your week at home and some in our welcoming office space
  • The opportunity to contribute and be part of a supportive team that is here to make a difference
  • A chance to build your own capability through learning from some of the industry’s most knowledgeable people who have a desire to share their insights along with access to upskilling opportunities and career development across the organisation
  • Two days a year to do Good in your Hood, though our volunteering scheme, a chance for you to help others in your community in a meaningful way to you

The base salary range for this role is $191,000.00 to $235,500.00 per annum, plus 20% STI based on company performance, a 5% KiwiSaver employer contribution and health insurance through Southern Cross.

Why Z?

Z has always been a proud Kiwi company. We’re aspirational for our future, confident of our role in Aotearoa New Zealand’s success and deeply loyal to our customers, communities and people.

At Z we focus on achieving extraordinary outcomes by setting the appropriate context, rather than by telling our people what to do. By doing this, high performing and talented people deliver better results and are more personally fulfilled.

We’re distinctive in our approach and if you’re up for a challenge, we’d love you to be part of it. If Z sounds like a place you believe you can add value and grow your own capability, then make sure you read Our Why. This is our founding document and provides further insights in what it means to part of the Z whānau.

If Z feels like a good match for your head and your heart, come join us for one heck of a journey!

Whakauru | Apply

We care deeply for our people while pushing them to achieve their best as individuals and collectively as an organisation. Our flexible working approach and Rainbow Tick and Gender Tick accreditations - backed by our strong Group values, Whakatika Move as One, Whakaora Make it Happen, Whakamana Make it Count - have created an open and inclusive workplace that promotes personal development and is underpinned by a desire for our people and our communities to succeed.

One of the things we stand for at Z is Diversity & Inclusion. It is our belief that having a diverse workforce make it possible for our people to truly be themselves and deliver on our aspirations for Z.
