title: Program Coordinator, International Development
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview
Reporting to the Program Manager on the International Development team, the Program Coordinator (PC) provides comprehensive and high-level writing, research, data analysis, event planning, and project coordination support to frontline gift officers on the International Development Team to advance their mission to cultivate, solicit, and steward international donors and prospects. As a valued partner to the team’s development officers, the PC develops and enhances materials for donors that are accurate, compelling, and appreciative. The PC also works with gift officers to prepare briefing materials for Yale leaders in advance of their meetings with donors and prospects.

The PC drafts a wide variety of written materials, including comprehensive individual donor briefings, gift proposals, stewardship reports, gift agreements, and internal and external correspondence that conforms to the style and voice of the sender. Additionally, the PC coordinates with development colleagues and other offices campus-wide to develop or enhance proposals and briefings summarizing Yale activities worldwide and conducts research on individuals, corporations, foundations, governments and institutions using office files, databases, and internet search engines and resources, including sources in other languages relevant for international development.

The PC also provides high level support in data analysis, events, and internal administration. The PC designs, develops, and produces ad hoc reports and analyses by report generation and manipulation of information systems, including our primary alumni database. The PC also assists with arranging campus visits for international donors and prospects and coordinating and assisting with a range of event logistics, e.g., compiling and maintaining invitation lists, extending invitations, confirming attendance, ensuring attendance accuracy, preparing biographies for guest speakers, staffing selected events, and contacting vendors.

Other duties include ensuring the accuracy of gift acknowledgments and all information relayed to prospects; building strong relationships with staff and serves as a key contact on questions relating to various departmental needs; entering data into to the development database and ensuring accuracy of donor records; interacting with donors at the request of the Director and International Development officers in response to inquiries; and assisting with other administrative duties as assigned.

The following principal responsibilities are generic in nature. Applicants will find the information in this position focus to be most relevant to the needs of the position.


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Exceptional communication skills with special emphasis on writing ability and editing. Demonstrated research abilities. Writing sample required at time of interview.

2. Strong attention to detail, including identifying and errors in data and analyzing large volumes of information from disparate sources and synthesizing it in cogent and concise written form.

3. Professionalism, maturity, and an ability to work with confidential information and to interact with top level donors and Yale administrators. Comfort working with foreign names/addresses. and communicating with individuals in other countries.

4. Strong organizational skills. Ability to prioritize work, multi-task, especially on projects, prospects, and proposals in different parts of the world, and meet deadlines in a team-centered, time-constrained environment. Ability to initiate and see tasks through with minimal supervision.

5. Advanced knowledge of MS Word, Excel, database software and reporting, and the ability to conduct data analysis. Knowledge of PowerPoint and Adobe Acrobat.


Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Experience with development work

2. Familiarity with Yale.

3. Global orientation, experience working across countries and regions, and proficiency in more than one language.

4. Experience using Adobe InDesign.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Coordinates with other departments at Yale to develop or enhance proposals and briefings summarizing Yale activities, and to plan events. 2. Develops and maintains a log of Yale academic and programming activities having development potential for prospects and donors. 3. Coordinates and staffs events. Helps secure hosts and locations for events. Works with Special Events team to secure campus locations. Produces invitation and confirmation cards. Compiles and maintains invitation lists, extend invitations, confirms attendance, ensures attendance accuracy, prepares biography for guest speakers, prepares Event Flow documents, staffs selected events, and contacts vendors. 4. Conducts research on individuals, corporations, foundations, governments and institutions using office files, databases and internet search engines and resources, including sources in other languages when relevant for international development. 5. Drafts a wide variety of written materials including detailed biographical and business briefings, correspondence, proposals, endowed gift agreements and stewardship reports. 6. Designs, develops and produces ad hoc reports and analyses by report generation and manipulation of information systems, including our primary Alumni database. 7. Researches and investigates gift commitments using office files and databases. Ensures the accuracy of gift acknowledgments and all information relayed to prospects. 8. Builds strong relationships with staff and serves as a key contact on questions relating to various departmental needs. 9. Interacts with donors at the request of director and/or gift officers in response to inquiries. 10. Assists with the assignment of tasks to student workers. 11. May perform other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience Eight years of related experience, six of them in the same job family at the next lower level and a high school level education; or six years of related experience and an Associate's Degree; or two years of related work experience and a Bachelor's Degree; or an equivalent combination of experience and education. title: Data Engineer - AWS, Snowflake, DBT
description:
Individually we are people, but together we are Aviva. Individually these are just words, but together they are our Values – Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence.

At Aviva Canada, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. This role will be part of and a member of our Information Technology Enterprise Data Services Group. You will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, analysis, and implementation in a successful, and experienced team. You’ll be required to apply your depth of knowledge and expertise with both modern and legacy data platforms to develop data ecosystems that will meet business requirements and align with Aviva’s enterprise architecture goals and standards. Aviva has embarked on an exciting journey to modernize, craft, and build a next generation data platform to support the growing data needs of the business and to enable the capabilities of AI to drive business value.

We embrace a culture challenging the status quo and constantly look to efficiently simplify processes, technology, and workflow.

  • Design and Develop ETL Pipeline to ingest data into Cloud from different data sources (Files, Mainframe, Relational Sources, NoSQL, Hadoop Etc.) using Python and DBT.

title: Senior Software Engineer - .Net Azure
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

We are seeking highly skilled Senior Software Engineer specializing in.NET development to build and enhance scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. This role involves working with .NET Core, cloud-native technologies, microservices, modern frontend frameworks, and DevOps automation while ensuring security, performance, and reliability.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions that meet the needs of our organization and clients. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze requirements, develop efficient code, perform rigorous testing, and deliver robust software products. The ideal candidate has a strong background in software development, a passion for technology, and a drive for continuous learning and improvement.

At H&M, one of our core principles is "We are One Team." You will be part of a global team working alongside colleagues in Sweden.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement software solutions that align with project goals and meet quality standards.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using best practices and appropriate software design patterns.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements for software projects.

  • Collaborate with team members to identify and resolve technical issues and optimize software performance.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends to propose innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Contribute to the documentation of software designs, technical specifications, and user manuals.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

At H&M, you’ll be part of a global, cross-functional team focused on enabling data-driven decision making at the core of our customer offering. Our mission is to empower assortment teams to efficiently and accurately plan and adjust demand for articles across all markets and touchpoints, with the flexibility to swiftly adapt to changing circumstances.​

At H&M Group, you’ll be part of the Owned Communication Platforms which enables and maintains communication solutions that allow H&M to manage email, mobile push, SMS and WhatsApp at scale, ensuring consistent and coordinated communication, with high deliverability and scalable infrastructure.

You will work closely with a Product Manager (PM), Engineering Manager (EM), and Tech Lead to define, prioritize, and deliver frontend initiatives aligned with product and business goals. Together, you will ensure clear ownership, strong technical direction, and high-quality execution of deliverables.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with...

  • 6-9 years of hands-on experience in application development. Strong hands-on experience in C#, .NET, Web APIs and Microservices.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Azure in services such as App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Entra, AppInsights, Application Gateways, Storage accounts etc.
  • Strong experience in writing Unit tests, Integration tests with testing frameworks such as MS Test/N-Unit/X-Unit and use of mocking frameworks.
  • Experience working with SQL and Cosmos DB.
  • Experience working with SAFe/Scrum/Agile methodology.
  • Experience in creating and working with CI/CD pipelines using Github Actions and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep.
  • Good knowledge of Application and Cloud Security best practices
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prepare well-designed artifacts.
  • Ability to interact with business users for requirement elicitation, clarification, coordination, and explain/walkthrough solutions.

And people who are

  • Passionate about problem-solving and building scalable applications.
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Open to learning and adapting to new technologies and best practices.
  • Team players with strong collaboration and communication skills.

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

We offer all our employees at H&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: Software Engineer - Cyber Capability Development
company: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
description:
Description

Excited by the challenge of discovering, understanding, and exploiting the hardware and software that powers modern surveillance and autonomous systems?

Interested in applying AI, automation, and agentic systems to accelerate cyber analysis, vulnerability discovery, and exploit development against complex real-world technologies?


Ready to lead technical teams in turning cyber research into operational capabilities that give U.S. operators new ways to understand, disrupt, and defeat emerging threats?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

The Cyber-Physical Systems Development Group is seeking a software engineer to develop advanced cyber capabilities that address some of the toughest challenges facing the defense and intelligence communities. Our group focuses on technologies that sense, analyze, plan, communicate, and operate in the real world, including surveillance systems and uncrewed platforms. As these technologies become more pervasive and interconnected, they create new sources of intelligence as well as new vulnerabilities that can be leveraged to support national security operations. We tackle these problems through close collaboration, rapid experimentation, and a willingness to explore unconventional approaches-but we stay focused on outcomes. Our goal is to develop cyber capabilities that work in the real world and help U.S. operators understand, access, disrupt, and exploit these systems to gain decisive advantage!

As a member of our team, you will...

  • Develop software systems that create novel mission capabilities against complex cyber-physical systems and emerging technologies.
  • Apply AI and agentic AI to automate cyber operations, accelerate analysis, enable intelligent decision-making, and deliver operational effects.
  • Lead advanced research and development efforts by architecting technical solutions, managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, and transitioning innovative capabilities to government sponsors and operational users.
  • Shape the future of cyber-physical operations by identifying emerging technologies, engaging with sponsors, and defining new research directions that address evolving intelligence and operational challenges.
  • Grow technical excellence by mentoring engineers and fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another discipline relevant to the duties as described above.

  • 5 or more years of experience developing, analyzing, or exploiting complex software systems.

  • Experience managing technical projects and/or leading multidisciplinary teams.

  • Experience in cyber operations techniques such as hardware analysis, software and firmware analysis, network and protocol analysis, vulnerability research, reverse engineering, and/or exploit development.

  • Familiarity with autonomous or uncrewed platforms, command-and-control systems, sensing and surveillance technologies, internet-of-things products, wired/wireless networking infrastructure, mobile devices, or other similar software-defined systems.

  • Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages such as C, C++ or Python.

  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn new technologies and apply fundamental engineering principles to solve challenging technical problems.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Are able to obtain a Top Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline.
  • Advanced experience developing tools for network traffic analysis, protocol discovery, system characterization, or automated analysis of unfamiliar systems.
  • Advanced experience in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, exploit development, or analysis of embedded software and firmware.
  • Experience applying AI/ML, including agentic AI, to automate software engineering, cyber analysis, vulnerability discovery, reverse engineering, or other complex technical workflows.
  • Hold an active Top Secret security clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation's most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL's campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities athttps://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please .

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

title: VP of Risk Management - United Overseas Bank
description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values - Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

  • Lead the design, deployment, administration, and lifecycle management of the OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), ensuring high availability, scalability, security, and performance.
  • Plan and manage infrastructure deliverables related to OCP clusters, including upgrades, patches, platform enhancements, and capacity planning.
  • Collaborate with application teams, DevOps engineers, and security teams to onboard workloads, manage platform dependencies, and ensure smooth application deployment on OpenShift.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of OpenShift infrastructure, including cluster health monitoring, performance tuning, logging, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  • Drive automation initiatives for infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipeline integration, configuration management, and container orchestration best practices.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architects, Security Architects, Platform Engineers, and Cloud Teams to ensure compliance with organizational architecture principles, governance, and security standards.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation related to platform architecture, operational procedures, runbooks, and disaster recovery plans.
  • Support and manage platform-related testing activities (e.g., performance testing, failover testing, security testing) to ensure environment readiness.
  • Provide timely escalation and resolutions for infrastructure risks and issues that may impact system uptime, project timelines, or production stability.
  • Lead platform-related technical incident investigations and root cause analysis; implement preventive measures.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers in container platform operations, automation, and DevOps practices.
  • Coordinate infrastructure implementation activities, ensuring smooth production cutover and post-implementation support for platform changes.
Job Requirements

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on expertise with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Solid understanding of Linux systems administration (preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux).
  • Experience in managing OpenShift clusters across on-premise, hybrid cloud, or public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

title: Software Engineer - Forensics
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Drive the technical resolution and stability of Everpure's highest-stakes cloud storage deployments for top-tier hyperscale partners. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Hyperscale Product Escalations team (known internally as a Forensics Engineer), you will serve as the technical bridge between field telemetry and core engineering, diagnosing high-complexity distributed systems failures and creating automation that anticipates issues before they impact customer workloads. You will directly influence customer trust, enable multi-million dollar account success, and help architect the future of hyperscale storage solutions built for AI-driven infrastructure.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Root-Cause Investigations: Analyze complex system behavior, memory dumps, field telemetry, and low-level code across platform, firmware, and software layers to isolate and resolve critical failures in large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build System Health Automation: Design and deploy automated diagnostics, predictive health-monitoring services, and AI-assisted workflow tools that reduce manual triage time and prevent recurring failure patterns across growing global fleets.
  • Direct Hyperscaler Engineering Collaboration: Partner directly with technical teams at hyperscale customer organizations to solve deep integration challenges, ensuring platform reliability and unlocking major expansion opportunities.
  • Engineer Fleet-Wide Reliability Improvements: File, prioritize, and drive long-term engineering fixes from escalation findings back into core product roadmaps to continuously elevate system stability.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Systems & Storage Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in Linux systems engineering, platforms, or low-level firmware, along with a strong grasp of storage technologies (such as SSDs, NVMe, NAND, or distributed storage architectures).
  • Advanced Debugging & Software Engineering: Proven mastery of troubleshooting complex distributed systems using languages like Python, Go, or C++, paired with the ability to build automated tools for log analysis, telemetry, and system diagnostics.
  • Technical Communication & Problem-Solving: Ability to deconstruct intricate distributed systems failure modes into clear technical action plans, facilitating seamless collaboration with cross-functional SMEs and external engineering leadership.
  • Location & Work Environment: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

  • Design, build, test, integrate, enhance, and support production applications and regulated data systems
  • Engineer applications for secure configuration and secrets handling, health checks, structured logging, graceful failure, and supportability
  • Translate business, compliance, security, and operational requirements into maintainable technical solutions

Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD

  • Define application and platform infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep
  • Bring existing undocumented infrastructure under code and make environments rebuildable from source
  • Implement automated pipelines with build, test, approval, artifact, deployment, rollback, and drift-detection controls

Release Control and Audit Evidence

  • Deliver production releases through controlled, gated cutover with validated configuration and proven rollback
  • Maintain pipeline records showing what changed, when, by whom, under what approval, and with what result
  • Support privacy, cybersecurity, audit, and regulatory readiness reviews through reliable engineering evidence

Operational Resilience and Knowledge Transfer

  • Create runbooks, observability, alerting, and escalation paths for production applications
  • Consolidate release and hotfix practices into documented, repeatable processes
  • Reduce single-person dependency by enabling other team members to deploy, diagnose, support, and roll back systems

AI-Assisted Development Practice

  • Use AI-assisted development deliberately with defined review, verification, privacy, security, and quality controls
  • Review machine-generated changes to the same standards as human-authored code
  • Help establish transferable practices that improve delivery throughput without increasing defects or incidents

What You Bring

Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered
  • Progressive experience delivering and supporting production applications in cloud environments
  • Strong application development skills, including secure configuration, secrets management, health checks, structured logging, testing, and graceful failure
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or Bicep and automated pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Knowledge of Azure identity and access, networking fundamentals, observability, operational support, and cloud cost awareness
  • Strong Git and source-control discipline, including review, approval, artifact, and rollback practices
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools with sound delegation, verification, privacy, security, and quality controls
  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Experience in regulated or audited environments preferred
  • Familiarity with Databricks and SQL preferred
  • Experience supporting AML, compliance, or other high-accountability corporate applications preferred

title: DevOps Project Manager
description:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an equal opportunity employer, and embraces diversity in race, nationality, ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability, neurodiversity, and sexual orientation, to create a workforce that reflects the societies we operate in. Our continued commitment to Culture and Diversity is reflected in our people stories across our workforce and implemented through equitable workplace policies and processes.

TCS has been serving the Canadian marketplace for more than 35 years and today is the technology partner of choice for many of the country's leading organizations. As one of the largest IT services providers in Canada and globally, TCS is aiming to become the world's largest AI‑led technology services company and is enabling its clients to transform themselves across the full AI stack, from infrastructure to intelligence.

Rooted in the heritage and values of the Tata Group, TCS is focused on creating long‑term value for its clients, investors, employees, and the communities it serves. With a highly skilled workforce supporting customers from coast to coast, TCS has consistently been recognized as a Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute, including a recent top ranking at the country level.

TCS also sponsors 14 of the world's most prestigious marathons and endurance events, including the TCS Toronto Waterfront Marathon, reflecting its commitment to health, sustainability, and community empowerment.

DevOps Project Manager

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of a complex DevOps initiative, from mobilization and scope definition through implementation, rollout, stabilization, and handoff.
  • Create and maintain an integrated delivery plan covering squad deliverables, cross‑team dependencies, milestones, environments, testing, approvals, communications, rollout activities, and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate delivery across one or more DevOps squads and the infrastructure, cloud, security, ServiceNow, application, data, platform, quality‑engineering, and support teams required to complete the work.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, architects, engineers, Quality Engineers, security partners, and business or technology stakeholders to clarify outcomes, responsibilities, sequencing, and acceptance criteria.
  • Establish clear governance, meeting cadence, decision paths, delivery controls, and escalation mechanisms appropriate to the initiative.
  • Manage scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and changes, ensuring that ownership and target dates remain explicit.
  • Drive action closure and proactively resolve delivery gaps, conflicting priorities, resource constraints, access or environment blockers, data‑quality concerns, and integration dependencies.
  • Coordinate test planning, user acceptance, production‑readiness reviews, implementation activities, post‑implementation validation, and evidence or sign‑off requirements.
  • Prepare concise, decision‑focused status reporting for program and DevOps leadership, including accomplishments, upcoming milestones, forecast, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions required, and recovery actions.
  • Coordinate stakeholder communications, readiness activities, demonstrations, information sessions, support planning, and adoption activities where required.
  • Ensure deliverables, processes, decisions, and operational ownership are documented and transitioned to the appropriate teams.
  • Apply lessons learned and continuous‑improvement practices to strengthen delivery predictability and reduce manual effort or recurring operational risk.

What you need to succeed

  • Strong project‑management experience delivering complex technology initiatives involving multiple squads, platforms, and enterprise partner teams.
  • Demonstrated experience working on DevOps, software‑delivery, developer‑platform, CI/CD, security‑control, source‑code‑management, or engineering‑enablement initiatives.
  • Practical understanding of the software delivery lifecycle and the relationship between source repositories, build pipelines, security scanning, deployment orchestration, environments, approvals, and production support.
  • Ability to build integrated plans, identify the true critical path, manage interdependent deliverables, and hold multiple teams accountable for commitments.
  • Excellent risk, issue, dependency, change, and stakeholder management, with sound judgment about when to resolve, elevate, or seek a decision.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders and technical specialists, with the ability to translate technical delivery detail into clear business impact and decision points.
  • Excellent facilitation, written communication, executive reporting, organization, and follow‑through.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment where delivery depends on teams that may not report directly to the Project Manager.
  • Self‑directed, pragmatic, outcome‑focused, and comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous or evolving work.

Required experience

  • Experience with standard DevOps tools, practices, and the Enterprise Pipeline is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of tools or platforms such as Bitbucket or GitHub, Jenkins, CDD, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Checkmarx One, Snyk, Kosli, Grafana, Tableau, cloud platforms, and infrastructure or deployment technologies.
  • Experience coordinating security‑control implementation, vulnerability‑management workflows, exception processes, compliance evidence, release gating, or production‑readiness activities.
  • Experience with application inventories, application portfolio identifiers, repository metadata, data reconciliation, database updates, dashboards, ETL processes, or data‑quality remediation.
  • Experience supporting releases across Dev, Stage, and Production environments and coordinating technical testing, business validation, implementation, and post‑implementation verification.
  • Experience with Jira and/or Planview AgilePlace.
  • Project‑management certification or formal Agile delivery training is an asset, but demonstrated delivery experience is more important than certification alone.

Salary Range

CA$ 100,000 - CA$ 120,000 Per Year

title: Senior Cost Controller.Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Description

Operational Cost Control & Rig Reporting

  • Oversee the preparation and review of rig-level accounts, operational cost reports, and financial analyses for assigned assets to ensure accurate cost recognition, financial visibility, and reporting integrity.

  • Monitor operational expenditures, cost allocations, accruals, and rig-related financial activities to ensure compliance with approved budgets, accounting standards, and finance procedures.

  • Analyse operational and financial performance across assigned rigs and assets to identify trends, variances, risks, and cost optimization opportunities.

  • Prepare and present operational cost analyses, rig performance summaries, and financial reports to management to support consolidation and decision-making activities.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities for operational assets by coordinating with Operations, Technical, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.

  • Review budget utilization, forecast assumptions, and operational spending trends to support effective financial control and planning accuracy.

  • Conduct financial analyses, profitability assessments, and operational performance evaluations to support business planning and operational decision-making.

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance financial models, reporting schedules, analytical tools, and multi-year financial plans aligned with the company’s strategic objectives to support cost control, operational planning, forecasting accuracy, and business performance monitoring activities.

  • Review rig-level monthly Profit & Loss accounts, prepare and validate monthly accruals, and ensure accurate recognition of operational costs and financial transactions to support reporting accuracy and financial integrity.

Billing & Revenue Support

  • Oversee billing activities for assigned operational assets by reviewing cost data, supporting documentation, and contractual requirements to ensure accurate invoice preparation and timely billing.

  • Review and validate invoices, charge calculations, and supporting financial information prior to issuance to ensure billing accuracy and compliance with contractual terms.

  • Coordinate with Finance, Operations, and Commercial teams to resolve billing discrepancies, cost allocation issues, and operational reporting matters.

Reporting & Business Partnering

  • Analyse monthly financial results, variance analyses, operational dashboards, and management reports related to assigned assets and operational activities to identify key performance drivers, operational trends, financial risks, and performance improvement opportunities.

  • Partner with Operations, Technical, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and other departments to support financial planning, operational reporting, and business performance initiatives.

  • Deliver comprehensive management reporting, including financial analyses, variance reporting, and key performance indicators (KPIs), while providing actionable financial insights and recommendations that support operational efficiency, cost optimization, and business performance improvement.

Systems, Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards, finance procedures, reporting requirements, and internal control frameworks across assigned activities.

  • Utilize ERP and financial reporting systems effectively to support accurate reporting, cost tracking, and financial analysis activities.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to cost control methodologies, operational reporting processes, and financial system utilization.

Leadership & Team Support

  • Guide, organize, and support junior cost control staff by providing technical direction, reviewing work outputs, and supporting day-to-day operational activities.

  • Promote collaboration, reporting discipline, and adherence to finance procedures within the cost control function.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Kensington delivers the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that’s tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure that they enjoy the authentic best of their destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime!

We achieve this because of our extraordinary people, passionate experts with deep knowledge of their destinations. They are what enables us to deliver remarkable experiences in over 120 countries worldwide, and across each of our businesses – Private Touring, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Expeditions, Ultraluxe Land, Private Jets, and Air.

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com.

We are hiring at two levels. We welcome applications from both Frontend Developers and Senior Frontend Developers. The level offered will be based on the depth of the candidate’s experience, technical expertise, scope of ownership, and ability to lead work independently.

This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON.

OUR ORGANIZATION

Kensington and TripArc, as part of the Range Group, deliver the world’s most personal travel experiences. We bring to life each client’s desire to travel in a way that is tailored specifically for them, in the company of local private guides who ensure they experience the authentic best of each destination. The result is a unique journey rich in memories that last a lifetime.

We achieve this through extraordinary people with deep destination expertise across more than 120 countries and across our Tours, Cruises, Villas, Yachts, Jets, and Air brands.

To learn more about Kensington, visit kensingtontours.com.

To learn more about TripArc, visit triparc.com.

THE ROLE

Kensington and TripArc are expanding their development team to support projects and initiatives across kensingtontours.com, campaign landing pages, microsites, booking and enquiry flows, and related digital properties. You will work in a modern frontend stack that includes Next.js, React, Contentful, and Amplitude while helping complete a migration from a legacy Angular application and supporting a full brand redesign.

At either level, you will create performant, accessible, responsive experiences for high-traffic, revenue-generating pages and use measurement to understand whether what you ship is working. The scope of ownership will be aligned to your experience:

  • Frontend Developer: You will build and maintain features within established patterns, implement experiments and analytics tracking, contribute to Contentful integrations and the design system, and grow your capability in conversion, performance, and technical discoverability through coaching and code review.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: You will own frontend conversion, experimentation, performance, and technical discoverability as a practice. You will set standards, make architectural decisions, partner directly with senior marketing and digital stakeholders, mentor developers, and translate commercial goals into measurable, maintainable technical solutions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Build high-quality frontend experiences

  • Design, build, and maintain features in our modern frontend application using Next.js and React, including Contentful integrations.
  • Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into performant, accessible, responsive, mobile-first experiences and raise questions where requirements are unclear.
  • Build reusable components against our design system and contribute to the component library as we move into a full rebrand.
  • Configure or architect content models and CMS structures so marketing partners can build and update pages without developer support.
  • Maintain our legacy Angular application during migration and help retire it cleanly.
  • Write maintainable code, participate in code review, estimate work honestly, identify risks early, and document solutions for technical and non-technical partners.

Improve conversion and measurement

  • Implement and instrument experiment variants on high-value pages, including event tracking, funnel visibility, and analytics needed to assess results.
  • Partner with marketing and digital stakeholders to translate commercial hypotheses into testable changes with clear success criteria.
  • Use experiment results and analytics to report whether changes worked and identify where users drop out of key journeys.
  • For Senior candidates: own the experimentation practice, design tests, establish staged rollout and rollback guardrails, and ensure results are measured honestly.

Protect performance and discoverability

  • Build experiences that meet expectations for Core Web Vitals, accessibility, application security, crawlability, and search discoverability.
  • Use appropriate rendering strategies and frontend patterns based on content volatility, speed, performance, and crawlability.
  • Support technical SEO through semantic structure, structured data, internal linking, redirects, URL changes, and migration safety.
  • For Senior candidates: set and defend performance budgets, own production performance improvements, and build the technical foundations for SEO, AEO, and GEO.

Collaborate and lead at the appropriate level

  • Communicate clearly with engineering, design, content, SEO, marketing, and digital partners.
  • Bring forward options, trade-offs, risks, and evidence rather than presenting only one answer.
  • For Intermediate candidates: learn actively from code review and technical direction, ask questions early, and take increasing ownership of defined areas.
  • For Senior candidates: define frontend standards and architectural patterns, review code, mentor developers, and act as a senior technical voice with business stakeholders.

MUST-HAVE

For both levels

  • Professional experience building and supporting web applications in production environments with real user traffic.
  • Strong component-based development experience with React and hands-on experience with Next.js.
  • Solid frontend fundamentals, including component architecture, state management, routing, rendering lifecycle, and frontend performance.
  • Strong modern CSS skills and experience building responsive, mobile-first user interfaces.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub and working within a modern CI/CD pipeline.
  • Ability to translate designs into accessible, responsive, production-ready experiences and familiarity with Figma-based design handoffs.
  • Working knowledge of the web-platform fundamentals that affect commercial outcomes, including accessibility, SEO, Core Web Vitals, analytics, and application security.

For Frontend Developer

  • 3-5 years of professional web development experience building and supporting production web applications.
  • Solid React development experience with hands-on experience using Next.js.

For Senior Frontend Developer

  • 6+ years of professional frontend development experience, including significant work on high-traffic, revenue-generating websites or applications.
  • Deep expertise in React and Next.js, including component architecture, state management, routing, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Production experience with rendering strategies such as SSR, SSG, and ISR, and the ability to select the appropriate approach based on business and technical requirements.
  • Experience integrating headless CMS platforms, preferably Contentful, including designing scalable content models and schemas.

NICE TO HAVE

  • A/B or multivariate testing tools such as Amplitude, Optimizely, VWO, or LaunchDarkly.
  • Analytics and tag implementation using Amplitude, GA4, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent tools.
  • Performance tooling such as Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, WebPageTest, and Chrome DevTools.
  • Technical SEO tooling such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, or Botify.
  • Image and media optimization at scale, including modern formats, responsive delivery, CDN behaviour, and Cloudinary.
  • Personalization or content‑variant delivery and an understanding of caching and indexing considerations.
  • Internationalization and hreflang for multi‑region sites.
  • Angular 9+, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury, or high-content-volume ecommerce.

OUR TECH STACK

  • React, GraphQL, and Next.js for the modern application.
  • Angular, .NET Core, and C# for the legacy application.
  • Contentful and Cloudinary.
  • Amplitude for analytics and experimentation.
  • Azure DevOps.

COMPENSATION

We provide a competitive compensation package with a strong pay-for-performance rewards approach. Employees have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and compensation tied to business and individual performance. The expected compensation range for this position is:

  • Frontend Developer: $90,000 to $110,000 CAD.
  • Senior Frontend Developer: $110,000 to $125,000 CAD.

The actual compensation may vary depending on local market conditions, geography, and relevant job‑related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. #LI-Hybrid

We are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. If you require accommodation due to a disability at any stage of our hiring process, please advise us when completing your application.

The Range Group may use artificial intelligence throughout the recruitment process to screen, assess or select applicants for this position. These tools assist our hiring team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by the hiring team. We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Analytics Engineer, Risk
description:
About Us

Propel (TSX: PRL) is the fintech company building a new world of financial opportunity by facilitating access to credit for consumers underserved by traditional financial institutions. Through its AI-driven platform, Propel evaluates customers in a more comprehensive way than traditional credit scores can. Our revolutionary fintech platform has already helped consumers access over one million loans and lines of credit and over one billion dollars in credit.

To build a new world of opportunity we bring together the brightest talent to help us build opportunities. We are entrepreneurs and believe in measuring success through results and growing within; talent and hard work never goes unnoticed. At Propel, we are here to change the way employees, customers and shareholders succeed together.

We are a team of passionate entrepreneurs, who foster curiosity and growth in our employees. Our culture is why we have been so successful and why our employees choose Propel to build their careers. It is also why we are one of North America’s fastest growing companies and a Best Place to Work.

Join us as we change the way employees, customers and shareholders succeed together.

About You

You thrive in a vibrant, entrepreneurial organization where your ideas are valued. You are motivated by goals, a self-starter, and enjoy wearing multiple hats in a fast-growing fintech environment.

You are a builder at heart—someone who prefers creating reliable data pipelines over another dashboard. You thrive on owning the “plumbing” that delivers clean, timely data to machine learning models and enjoy turning manual, messy processes into repeatable automation. As the Analytics Engineer, Risk, you’ll join the Model Development team within Risk, working closely with the Manager, Model Development, Data Scientists, and Model Developers. This highly technical, hands‑on role focuses on the data infrastructure supporting credit risk models, including ETL pipelines for model training and scoring, standardized ingestion of new data sources—including UK data—and day‑to‑day delivery of stable production data. You’ll work primarily in Python and SQL with tabular, time‑series, and, as we grow, graph‑structured data such as Neo4j.

Responsibilities

  • Own the integration of new data sources, into Propel’s model-ready data standards, ensuring consistent schemas, definitions, and quality across regions (CA/US/UK)
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL pipelines that prepare and deliver data for model training, retraining, and scoring across multiple model types, including survival, classification, and regression models
  • Build and maintain pipelines within the shared ETL/orchestration framework for model development, following the templates and patterns established by the Model Development team so new models can be onboarded quickly
  • Build feature engineering and data transformation logic for tabular and time-series data, using tools such as tsfresh or similar
  • Monitor the health and stability of data pipelines feeding models in production; proactively identify and resolve data drift, quality issues, and pipeline failures
  • Write clean, well-tested, production‑grade Python code, including scripts and reusable packages or modules, that other team members can build on
  • Work with containerized model deployments using Docker and Kubernetes, as well as cloud infrastructure such as AWS and S3 for data storage and workflow orchestration, with support from our Infrastructure team
  • Query and transform data from relational databases and data warehouses using SQL.
  • Document data sources, pipeline logic, and transformations clearly so pipelines are auditable, maintainable, and easy to hand off
  • Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Model Developers to translate model requirements into scalable, production‑ready data pipelines, and with the Business Analytics Engineering and Infrastructure teams where pipelines intersect with broader data platform work

Requirements

Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands‑on Python skills and comfortable writing production-quality, testable, reusable code
  • Familiarity with common data and ML libraries such as pandas, NumPy, and scikit‑learn
  • Experience building or maintaining ETL or data pipelines
  • Experience with pipeline or workflow orchestration tools such as Metaflow, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar is a plus
  • Comfortable working with different data shapes: tabular and time‑series data
  • Solid SQL skills for querying and transforming data into relational databases such as MySQL and/or data warehouses
  • Understanding of the ML data lifecycle, including feature engineering, training and scoring data preparation, and model monitoring and drift concepts
  • Experience with version control using Git and basic CI/CD practices
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with Data Scientists, Model Developers, and Infrastructure/Engineering stakeholders
  • Experience in fintech, credit risk, or another regulated or data‑intensive industry is a plus
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot to accelerate day‑to‑day engineering work is an asset

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to graph data or graph databases such as Neo4j (nice‑to‑have)
  • Snowflake experience (nice‑to‑have)
  • Exposure to Docker, containerization, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS, S3, EKS, or similar services (nice‑to‑have)

Benefits To Joining Propel

  • Growth and opportunity – we pride ourselves on promoting from within
  • Incredible company culture
  • Competitive salary and health benefits
  • Comprehensive vacation package
  • Group health and dental benefits
  • Group RRSP program
  • Support for new parents
  • Diverse and inclusive workplace

Salary Range

$70,000 - $100,000

Final compensation is determined by market conditions, location, and the candidate’s experience, skills, and education. This role may also be eligible for performance‑based incentive programs and total compensation may include variable incentives, such as bonuses and commissions.

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Our Culture

Propel brings together the brightest talent to build opportunities. We are entrepreneurs who measure success through results and growth from within; talent and hard work never go unnoticed. Our team fosters curiosity and growth, making Propel one of North America’s fastest‑growing companies and a Best Place to Work.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Propel welcomes and encourages applications from all groups, including Indigenous peoples, women, visible minorities, persons with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities, and those with intersectional identities. Should you require accommodation throughout any stage of the recruitment and selection process, please specify your requirements when submitting your application and we will work with you to meet your needs.

AI Disclosure

We use AI to assist in reviewing applications and assessing candidates. These tools support our recruitment team, however, all hiring decisions are made by our trained hiring managers and recruitment professionals, not AI.

title: DevOps Engineer Intern - PEY
description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services. This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation. Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

About The Role:

You will work closely with the development and product management teams to monitor the quality and performance of the software that runs on the Wafer Scale Engine (WSE), the world’s largest and fastest AI computer.

  • Build and improve automation for software build, test, deployment, and validation workflows across cloud and datacenter environments.

Why Join Cerebras

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. Find out more about what it's like to work at Cerebras here!

Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.

title: Head of Growth Product & Optimisation
description:
Title: Head of Growth Product & Optimisation
Location: Remote in UK or Hybrid (with occasional travel to our central London office)
Position: Permanent
Reporting to: Founder


About PetLabCo.


PetLabCo.® is the world leader in DTC pet supplements, with nine-figure revenue and ambitious plans for continued global expansion. We make science-backed supplements, health care and treats that millions of dog owners love, powered by a performance marketing engine spending at serious scale across paid social and beyond. Behind that engine we're building a brand that dog owners recognise and trust, which is what turns a strong first purchase into a long relationship. Our team is vibrant, fast moving and customer obsessed. High performers are valued here and they're rewarded, which makes this the ideal place for an ambitious, hardworking animal lover who wants to move their career forward quickly.

About the role…
Positioned within the Growth department, we move fast, test constantly and we're aggressively integrating AI across our entire growth stack. This is a senior role that asks for comfort with both strategic direction and hands-on execution. You'll own a complex, always-on trading and optimisation programme, balancing the immediate performance opportunities against the longer-term initiatives that compound value. Thriving here means knowing when to zoom out to shape direction and when to dive deep to drive the outcome.


Reporting to the founder, you'll lead the scope and delivery of our DTC growth roadmap across the US, Canada and UK. You'll be accountable for end-to-end performance, keeping strategy and optimisation tightly connected and commercially impactful.

What you'll own…

  • Experimentation at scale - Experimentation is our decision engine here and not just a side project.
    You'll use data, insight and structured testing to shape the roadmap, prioritise opportunities and
    prove impact. Deep experience designing, running and scaling experiments in a live trading
    environment is essential.
  • Product and optimisation through a trading lens - You'll set the top standard for on-site customer
    experience, with expert ownership of suggested change requests designed to improve the customer
    experience and drive revenue. We treat the site as a trading floor, not a static asset.
  • Optimising for LTV:CAC - As a subscription-led business we optimise for profitable long-term
    lifetime value, not just short-term wins. You'll treat LTV:CAC as the real measure of ROI, which asks
    for a genuine understanding of the full customer journey and strong analytical capability.
  • Growth marketing and landing page optimisation - You'll bring real fluency in growth marketing
    mechanics and proven experience optimising landing pages in a paid social environment, with an eye for operational efficiency as well as top-line growth. That said, it won't just be that. As a hands- on role, you'll also own other areas of the experience that support acquisition and retention.
  • Data and funnel fluency - You'll be highly data literate, with funnel dynamics and best practice
    CRO as a second language.
  • Leading the team - You'll inherit a high performing, driven and ambitious team, with each person
    owning their own product area. Your job is to drive performance while keeping them engaged and
    happy, leading through enablement and encouragement and leaving them empowered to succeed.

Your day to day will look a little like this

  • Monitor growth metrics and business performance, turning what you see into clear recommendations and action
  • Get into the pages themselves, assessing journeys and interrogating funnel behaviour to understand why the numbers move, not just that they did
  • Handle the commercial side of ecommerce, from pricing assessments and promo opportunities to the risks that need spotting and acting on
  • Lead multiple growth projects from first idea through to delivery, making sure they land what they set out to
  • Move comfortably between short term trading wins and longer term strategic growth
  • Own initiatives end to end, covering sprint planning, briefs, measurement and the decision that follows

  • Act as the voice of the business in a cross-competence agile team, turning planning needs into a new tech tool.​
  • Drive stakeholder engagement across a broad landscape – from Global Marketing and Commercial teams to Sales Markets in 26 countries.​
  • Use your marketing planning expertise to validate ideas and sanity-check what the team is building.​
  • Help shape and design a product that our colleagues love to use!
  • Lean into exploring how AI can strengthen planning and decision-making as the product evolves.​

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

This is a start-up-style project within H&M: small in team size, big in ambition. You’ll work day-to-day with Product, Tech, and Business colleagues, acting as the business anchor as the team builds and iterates together.​
You'll join the Marketing Insights & Steering area within the Marketing Domain, where we enable data-driven decision-making across H&M's global marketing organisation. Our team plays a central role in understanding the impact of marketing, ensuring that investments across channels, markets and customer touchpoints are measurable, optimised and aligned with business goals.

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with…​

  • Proven experience as a Business Expert or subject-matter expert in marketing or commercial planning.​
  • Comfortable working with complex and ambiguous processes, and breaking down solutions into deliverable stages.​
  • A track record of aligning stakeholders at both global and local levels.​
  • Fashion retail experience is a bonus, though not a requirement.​

And people who are…​

  • Passionate about building technology that solves real business problems.​
  • Skilled at communicating complex ideas simply, and at influencing without formal authority.​
  • Driven by outcomes – focused on the impact your work has for colleagues and customers.​
  • Collaborative and pragmatic, energised by ambiguity rather than daunted by it.​

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

  • Staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
  • Included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
  • Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to Swedish market.
  • 30 days vacation, health care allowance and good work-life balance.
  • Additional perks and discounts from Benify.

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a fulltime permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.

Apply as soon as possible by sending in your CV in English. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. ​We are eager to meet you!

title: Subsea Supervisor (Rio de Janeiro)
description:
QHSE

Responsible for/ensure:
• To make sure that you and your team work safe every day, every hour and every minute, no exception.
• Compliance with the Seadrill Code of Conduct.
• Compliance with applicable internal and external governing requirements.
• That any operations do not exceed the limitations of the unit or its equipment.
• Daily detailed planning is conducted for all upcoming operations.
• Good and clear communications with all involved parties.
• That subsea equipment certification at all times is valid and available onboard
• Compliance with Seadrill training, certification and competence requirements.
• That all relevant personnel are adequately trained in handling emergencies.
• That all emergency equipment is in good condition and configured as required.
• Non-compliances are promptly acted on and reported to the direct supervisor.
• Training and competence assessments as assigned and/or required are performed.
• Compliance with the standard for tidiness and cleanness.
• Assume the safety role as per station bill and emergency preparedness plan.

Participate in:
• Meeting activities in a proactive and constructive manner.
• Training and competence assessments as assigned and/or required.

JOB SPECIFIC

Responsible for/ensure:

  • That clear daily operational guidelines are provided to all direct reports.

  • All relevant governing documents are adhered to by direct reports.

  • Visible leadership by spending time in the field and monitoring daily operations.

  • Thorough handovers are provided at each daily change of shift.

  • Subordinates are trained in order to make them suitable for a higher position.

  • Other duties are performed as required and/or directed by his/her direct supervisor

Assist with:

  • BOP latching/unlatching operations.

  • Budgetary control of the department.

  • Well kill operations as per instructions from Seadrill supervisors.


EQUIPMENT & SYSTEMS

Responsible for/ensure:

  • Conducting daily control of all well control equipment and systems.

  • Conducting daily control of all subsea support systems.

  • Conducting equipment function and pressure test as per procedures or as directed.

  • Sufficient stock of subsea equipment spare parts and materials is maintained.

  • Managing equipment preparation for future drilling operations.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the daily control / maintenance of well control equipment: BOP, MUX control system, riser, slip joint, riser tensioning system, kill/choke manifold, compensating equipment and all other associated well control equipment;

  • Professional knowledge of hydraulic, electric IT components and configurations for subsea BOP Equipment;

  • Demonstrate proficient technical understanding of engineering, industry standards and the company management system;

  • Reviews and approves BOP, riser and riser tension configurations;

  • Plans and supervises the deployment, pressure testing and maintenance of BOP;

  • Responsible for the operation and maintenance of the BOP handling systems;

  • Plan, witness and maintain records of pressure test;

  • Responsible for subsea equipment interfaces between client and subcontractor’s equipment;

  • Assist in running and testing the wellhead, casing hangers and seal assemblies;

  • Confirm that all well specific space out measurements are calculated, verified and clearly posted on the rig floor and other relevant areas;

  • Ensure the riser and tensioning system are deployed, operated and recovered in accordance with well specific operating guidelines and engineering riser analysis;

  • Maintain accurate records of the maintenance history of all subsea equipment in the company maintenance management system and coordinate planning and implementation;

  • Responsible for ensuring that the subsea department are conversant with relevant rig specific procedures, that they are understood, utilized and updated accordingly;

  • Oversee the inventory of subsea spares, oils and operating fluids;

  • Communicate equipment problems or breakdown with Technical Field Support group and equipment vendor(s);

  • Responsible for maintaining up-to-date documentation package and drawings of subsea equipment on board.

  • Maintain the accuracy of the documentation package and drawings and participate in the

  • management of change process together with the shorebased office

  • Develop and compile comprehensive subsea procedures and checklists

  • Demonstrate cost control awareness of subsea equipment and inventory. Assist with the preparation of the budget;

  • Jointly review the results of regular pressure and function testing along with OIM & DSL to ensure the BOP is maintained and ready for deployment;

  • Conduct performance appraisals for subordinates. Recommend promotion, development or disciplinary action;

  • Mentor, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work in their current job positions and where appropriate coached and prepared for the next position;

  • Actively participate in weekly rig and departmental safety meetings;

  • Ensure that approved rig operating procedures are adhered to at all times. Report all unsafe activities, situations, and potential hazards to supervisor;

  • Actively participate in the Safety Management Systems;

  • Ensure housekeeping is maintained in assigned areas;

  • Effectively use all safety and environmental tools employed by Seadrill (5-point check, STAR cards, PTW etc.);

  • Perform all emergency duties as per designation on the station bill and on the applicable emergency response plans;

  • Comply with the training matrix for the position;

  • Comply with the Competence Assurance Program in a timely manner as per Seadrill requirement;

  • Conduct performance appraisals for subordinates. Recommend promotion, development or disciplinary action;

  • Ensure that the Subsea Department has at all times the necessary supplies and spare parts for operation and maintenance of all the subsea related equipment onboard in accordance with the Company’s inventory policy. Care should be taken into consideration when reordering spares and max/min levels should be followed and adhered to;

  • Review and, as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and TBRA´s;

  • Review and, as required, perform all duties related to safety controls among all tasks performed by himself and or working group;

  • Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities as Technical Section Leader or, onshore, Technical Leader or Subsea Superintendent for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes;

  • Perform, if required, the same duties as of the Subsea Engineer;

  • Keep up own certification and medical certificates up to date;

  • Lead incident investigations on board;

  • Ensure familiarity and perform operations risk assessing and supporting rig heading changes;

  • As per Seadrill training and competence directives.

  • Be able to communicate in English and Portuguese

  • Valid Supervisor Well Control certification;

  • For Brazilians, high school diploma as a minimum is required (Mechanic preferred)

  • For Brazilians, valid mechanical technician certification (with valid CREA) or 3rd Engineer or higher rank marine license.
